If you’ve spent time cite-checking for a law review or journal, this is that skill applied to a new context. No prior AI experience is required — your Bluebook fluency and editorial judgment are what matter. Scope of Work Review existing Bluebook and pincite grading rubrics, and flag rules that are unclear, incomplete, or would be applied inconsistently by different editors. Create sample cite-checking tasks: source material paired with citations containing realistic errors, along with the correct answer and an explanation of the rule involved. Build tasks across a range of citation types and difficulty levels, from straightforward formatting errors to subtle pincite and source-support problems. Apply Bluebook rules consistently across all submissions. Flag ambiguous cases to project coordinators instead of resolving them silently. Deliver assigned work on schedule and at the required quality level. Preferred Qualifications Current law student (2L, 3L) or recent JD graduate. Law review or law journal experience, ideally including a cite-checking or source-collection role. Strong working knowledge of The Bluebook, including pincites, short forms, signals, and parentheticals. Able to explain why a citation is wrong, not just that it is — the reasoning matters as much as the correction. Careful and consistent across long sessions of detailed review work. Comfortable working independently and meeting deadlines without close supervision. Experience as a journal editor, articles editor, or executive editor is a plus. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user. Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these: Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC). NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0. JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors. A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching. Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us. A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role. Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region. Nice to have: Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite). Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP). Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD. Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor. Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope. Integration Engineer Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards. Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces. Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team. Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions. Senior Integration Engineer Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards. Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments. Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow. Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases. Why BLP Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live. Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards. Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares. Team: regular team events. Practical information Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe. description: Job Summary We are seeking a Research Operations Analyst to support a multi-year mineral title consolidation program for one of the largest royalty funds in the United States. This is a program-scale, long-term engagement that spans the full retitling pipeline- from title research through revenue recovery . The role begins with a strong focus on chain-of-title research , but is designed as an entry point into a broader operational career path across adjacent functions including curative resolution, owner communications, recording operations, and revenue administration . The ideal candidate combines the analytical rigor of a legal researcher , the precision of a data analyst , and the operational adaptability to learn and execute across evolving workflows. Key Responsibilities Conduct structured chain-of-title research for owner/fund pairs, tracing ownership histories from current ownership back to origin. Review and interpret legal documents including deeds, probate filings, court orders, affidavits, conveyance instruments, and powers of attorney . Cross-reference ownership data across multiple sources (county records, ownership registers, transfer histories) to verify accuracy and identify discrepancies. Identify and document title gaps, ownership defects, missing documents, inflated decimals, and chain breaks , and flag issues for review and resolution. Classify ownership records using the program's A/B classification framework (clean title vs. curative required). Enter research findings into structured databases using defined workflows and validation protocols. Assemble and maintain complete evidence packs , including supporting documents, source references, and classification rationale, with proper version control. Ensure all research outputs meet quality standards , targeting a 90%+ first-pass acceptance rate , and participate in quality control audits. Navigate and extract data from county clerk and recorder systems across multiple jurisdictions, adapting to varying formats and access methods. Use land records aggregator platforms where direct county access is limited or incomplete, and document county-specific access constraints. Maintain consistent productivity against defined throughput benchmarks, with improving efficiency over time. Follow established research methodologies, SOPs, and workflow protocols, and incorporate feedback to continuously improve accuracy. Cross-train into additional operational functions over time, including curative resolution, owner communications, recording operations, operator engagement, and revenue transition workflows , following structured training and competency assessments. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Law, Business, Finance, Political Science, Public Administration , or a related field. Strong analytical and research skills with exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy across high-volume work. Ability to read, interpret, and extract information from legal and property-related documents . Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and comfort working with structured databases. Strong written communication skills to document findings, flag issues, and assemble structured evidence files . Ability to manage multiple workflows simultaneously while maintaining organization and meeting productivity targets. Self-disciplined, reliable, and comfortable working within structured processes and defined methodologies . Strong learning agility and adaptability as responsibilities expand across the operational pipeline. Fluency in English is required; French, Arabic, or Urdu is a plus. Nice to Have Experience in title research, legal research, land records, real estate transactions, or property administration . Familiarity with U.S. county records systems, land data platforms, or document aggregator services . Understanding of property ownership structures, mineral rights, or chain-of-title concepts . Experience in data entry, document review, or compliance-driven environments with quality standards . Exposure to oil & gas operations, royalty administration, or mineral interest management . Experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams across multiple time zones . Originally posted on Himalayas

title: PhD Scholarship (Rural Healthcare and Intellectual Disability), School of Medici
description: The University of Notre Dame Australia is a Catholic university with campuses in Fremantle, Broome and Sydney. The Objects of the University are the provision of university education within a context of Catholic faith and values and the provision of an excellent standard of teaching, scholarship and research, training for the professions and the pastoral care of its students. PhD Scholarship,Full-Time, budgeted $42,440 for 3 years not indexed annually. Proposed start date January 2027. About the Scholarship This scholarship is based at the School of Medicine (Sydney campus) at the University of Notre Dame Australia . The applicant does not need to be on site. There is limited scope for the successful candidate to design their own research question, but it must be aligned with the wider project goals of examining the healthcare needs of rural people with intellectual disability as they grow older. It is well established that there are substantial inequalities in service provision for people with intellectual disability, particularly in non-metropolitan Australia. The complex needs of this population remain largely hidden and overlooked within the wider research agenda, leading to both inequality and inequity. The successful candidate would be working within an established research group including experienced disability researchers acrossa number ofuniversities, other PhD candidates, disability support organisations and people with lived experience of intellectual disability. The project is also overseen by a dedicated project manager to support administrative process and day-to-day activities. The PhD scholarship will support the mixed method research component of the MRFF-funded project that will explore polypharmacy in older people with intellectual disability and include quantitative analysis of survey data and follow up interviews with older adults with intellectual disability and their carers - across regional and rural regions of Australia. Findings from this research willinform the development and evaluation of a nurse-led intervention in the project's final stages. The work is embedded within a co-designed, participatory research approach that prioritises lived experience and community partnership. Duration of the candidature Please note that the standard duration of candidature is 3 years full-time. If the extension of candidature is approved, the stipend will not be extended. Eligibility This opportunity is available for Domestic students only. Applicants are required to have completedaBachelor’sdegree with Honours (First Class or Upper Second Class) or aMastersby Research, in a relevant field of healthcareand be based in Sydney.Specific eligibility criteria for the PhD can be found here:Doctor of Philosophy (Medicine) | Notre Dame 2027 Applications Preference to commence Semester 1 2027. Deadline to submit your EOI is the13stof November 2026. Why choose UNDA As a PhD candidate at Notre Dame University, you will embark on an intellectual journey guided by expert academic supervisors, working closely with them to shape, refine, and execute a significant research project that contributes original knowledge to the field. Enquiries Expressions of interest or enquiries related to the research topic, should be directed to Dr Giselle Gallego . Please submit the following documents: Previous academic transcripts and certificates. Research proposal outlining study objectives. Two letters of recommendation. CV/Resume. Any additional supporting documents. Originally posted on Himalayas

This is a player-coach role — you'll set strategic direction while staying hands-on with engagement scoping, tradecraft, and tooling decisions. You'll report to the Director of Global Security Services. Translate offensive findings into risk language that engineers, VPs, and non-technical stakeholders can act on. Design repeatable processes and metrics that communicate the team's value in terms of risk reduction, not just finding count. We're excited about you because you… 7+ years of offensive security experience (red teaming, adversary simulation, penetration testing) with at least 3 years managing offensive security practitioners. Deep, hands-on red team expertise — you speak fluently about TTPs, attack chains, tradecraft, and tooling because you've done the work, not just managed it. Demonstrated player-coach balance between technical depth and management responsibilities. Track record of shaping security strategy beyond your own team — influencing engineering, product, or infrastructure organizations to prioritize and act on findings, not just document them. Experience with cloud-native offensive operations (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, containerized microservices, CI/CD pipelines) and building or directing custom offensive tooling as engineered software, not just scripts. People-first leadership — you coach, develop careers, provide honest feedback, and build team culture where offensive security practitioners grow. Purple team experience — collaborative detection validation with blue team/DFIR partners. Monitor client wellbeing by communicating with clients, workers, family members, supporters, and providers. Identify early signs of deterioration (physical, cognitive, emotional, social) and escalate promptly. Support updating of risk profiles, safety plans, and care plans following clinical direction. Assist in implementing and tracking risk mitigation strategies over time. Review client notes regularly to identify changing needs or risks. Coordination of Services, Rostering & Scheduling Coordinating the safe, timely commencement of services following onboarding. Communicating service preferences, cultural needs, worker preferences, and schedule options to the rostering team Communicating with support workers, allied health clinicians, nursing staff, and external providers about client needs and wellbeing. Promote a safe reporting culture free from fear of retaliation. Support WHS, infection control, safe environment practices, and hazard identification. Participate in quality audits, reviews, incidents follow-up, and improvement activities. Liaise with external providers to ensure coordinated, high-quality service delivery. Participate in multidisciplinary meetings, internal case discussions, and handovers. Promote Sensible Care services ethically and professionally What﻿ You'll Do: Essential Excellent Co

description: About Clarity Pediatrics Clarity Pediatrics is building a new model for pediatric chronic care — one that brings affordable, science-backed care to the 1 in 3 kids with chronic conditions. title: Senior Product Manager / ML Models
description: At Quartermaster AI, we believe the ocean should be a safe and sustainably managed resource for all. By leveraging cutting-edge AI and robotics, we unlock capabilities that were only recently impossible. Our distributed open-ocean systems enable every vessel to sense, compute, and communicate, enhancing maritime domain awareness for those who need it most. Job Description: We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, ML Models to own the product strategy for the machine learning models that power our maritime domain awareness products. You will sit between our customers, our Machine Learning Engineers, and our company leadership. You will turn ambiguous operational problems into a clear model roadmap, help the team iterate on those models until they work in deployments, and make sure what we build fits a cohesive technical roadmap across hardware, software, data, and ML. This is a high-ownership role for someone who is equally comfortable in a model evaluation review and in a briefing with a senior executive or customer. Key Responsibilities: Spend time with users, analysts, and partners across a wide variety of customer markets to understand how they detect, track, and decide about maritime activity today. Turn what you learn into prioritized problem statements, user journeys, and measurable success criteria. Define the model portfolio, covering what to build, in what order, and to what performance bar. Turn customer outcomes into model requirements: target metrics, acceptable error modes, latency and compute budgets at the edge, data needs, and evaluation datasets. Work day to day with Applied ML and RF ML Engineers on experiment design, evaluation methodology, error analysis, and release criteria. Decide when a model is good enough to ship and when it needs another iteration. Hold a high bar for quality and a clear picture of what "better" means to customers. Communicate model strategy, progress, tradeoffs, and risks to the C-suite, the board as needed, and customers and partners. Make complex technical topics understandable and decision-ready. Own execution from ideation through launch and ongoing performance monitoring. Build feedback loops from fielded systems back into data collection, labeling, and retraining. Establish metrics, experimentation practices, and evaluation standards that let the team ship models faster and with more confidence. Qualifications (Preferred): Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in product management, program management, or technical leadership roles, including at least 2 years taking technical products from conception to launch. Experience defining requirements, success metrics, and evaluation approaches for ML or AI-powered products, working directly with ML engineers and data scientists. Experience running experiments and using data to drive product decisions (A/B testing, offline evaluation, or similar). Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams of engineers, researchers, designers, and operators without direct authority. Track record of briefing senior leaders, including executives or customers, on complex technical topics and shaping decisions. Working fluency in Python and SQL sufficient to analyze data and engage in technical depth with engineers. MS in an engineering or technical discipline, or both. Hands-on experience with applied ML, such as predictive modeling, recommendation or ranking systems, or LLM/agentic pipelines, and familiarity with frameworks such as scikit-learn or TensorFlow. Background or familiarity with maritime, defense, aerospace, or national security environments, and comfort translating operational needs into technical requirements. Work Environment: This is a remote position with collaboration via online tools. Flexible working hours with occasional deadlines requiring high availability. Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact. Benefits : Competitive salary Flexible work hours and the option for remote work. Opportunities for professional development and continued education. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: NVIDIA is widely recognized as one of the most desirable employers, with some of the most talented people in the world working for us! We believe open-weight models are foundational to American AI leadership and cybersecurity, and that trust in AI grows through participation, transparency, and broad scientific scrutiny. Our AI Safety & Security Engineering team builds and evaluates AI-powered tooling that helps find, validate, and patch software vulnerabilities. The agent harness and the platform it runs on are the substrate everything else builds on. We are looking for a Harness/Platform Engineer to build that foundation. You will play a critical role in making the program's work possible, repeatable, and trustworthy. When a researcher runs an experiment, your platform decides whether the result can be reproduced tomorrow. Our current direction builds on NVIDIA NeMo agent tooling, and you will help shape where it goes. You will keep the whole loop visible, from environment to run to result. You will work closely with security research and evaluation engineers, learning their workflows and smoothing their paths. Good platform work here looks like fewer surprises: environments that behave, tooling that stays versioned, and runs that repeat. When something breaks, you will debug it with the people who felt it first. You will treat researcher time as precious and remove friction wherever you find it. What You'll Be Doing: Harness development:Design, implement, and maintain the agent harness. Evaluation infrastructure:Build the systems we use to run and reproduce experiments. Reproducibility:Own environments, tooling, and repeatable runs. Collaboration:Partner with security and evaluation engineers on their workflows. What We Need To See: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years of software engineering experience. Technical core:Strong Python engineering plus comfort with containerized environments and CI/CD. Infrastructure familiarity:Experience with agent frameworks, LLM orchestration, ML infrastructure, or evaluation harnesses. Reproducibility instincts:Care for versioned tooling and repeatable results. Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: NeMo experience:Hands-on work with NVIDIA NeMo or similar agent frameworks. Security context:Exposure to security tooling or vulnerability research. Developer experience:Building internal tools other engineers enjoy using. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 15, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. title: Senior Creative Copywriter
description: About this Role We're looking for a Senior Creative Copywriter to bring Valerie's portfolio of consumer and eCommerce brands to life through exceptional writing, original ideas, and distinctive brand storytelling. This is a creative role first and foremost. You'll develop brand voices, campaign concepts, messaging frameworks, social content, performance ads, website copy, and CRM campaigns that connect with audiences while driving business results. You'll work across multiple brands and international markets, collaborating closely with Creative Directors, Designers, Brand Growth Pods, Performance, and Web & Digital Experience teams. We want someone who can move seamlessly between building a brand's long-term identity and writing sharp, commercially effective copy for everyday campaigns. Great copy starts with human insight, originality, cultural understanding, and a genuine command of language. AI can support your process, but we want someone who can think independently, challenge generic ideas, and create work that feels distinctly human. Success in this role means distinctive brand voices, original creative concepts, culturally relevant messaging, exceptional writing quality, faster creative delivery, fewer revisions, and copy that contributes to both brand building and commercial performance. You could be a great fit if... You see copywriting as a craft and care deeply about the quality, originality, and impact of your words. You can turn consumer insights and brand strategy into compelling stories, campaign ideas, and messaging. You have a strong conceptual mind and enjoy contributing ideas beyond the brief. You understand how to balance brand storytelling with performance marketing and commercial objectives. You have an exceptional command of English, including nuance, humour, idioms, and cultural references. You can adapt your writing for different brands, audiences, platforms, and international markets. You know how to make product benefits compelling without making the copy sound forced or salesy. You challenge generic messaging and know when something sounds artificial, overused, or off-brand. You're comfortable managing multiple brands and briefs without compromising on quality. You enjoy collaborating with creative, design, strategy, and performance teams and can confidently explain your creative choices. You use AI thoughtfully for research and exploration but can develop strong creative work independently. You're proactive, receptive to feedback, and take ownership of your work from the first idea to final delivery. Requirements 5–7+ years of experience in creative copywriting, ideally within advertising, branding, creative agencies, or consumer-focused businesses. An exceptional portfolio demonstrating original thinking, strong writing craft, and versatility across different brands and formats. Outstanding written English, with a sophisticated understanding of tone, storytelling, grammar, and language. Strong cultural understanding of English-speaking markets, particularly the US, UK, and Australia. Experience developing brand narratives, tone-of-voice guidelines, messaging frameworks, and brand books. Proven ability to conceptualise and write campaign ideas, headlines, taglines, and product launch messaging. Hands-on experience writing for organic social, paid advertising, creator content, websites, landing pages, eCommerce, and CRM. Understanding of how copy contributes to brand building, customer acquisition, engagement, and conversion. Ability to adapt messaging for platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Google, and YouTube. Good understanding of SEO, CRO, creative testing, and performance-led messaging. Excellent editorial judgement, attention to detail, and ownership of final copy quality. Ability to collaborate with Creative Directors, Designers, Strategists, and Performance specialists. Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple brands, deadlines, and competing priorities. A collaborative, proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and incorporate feedback. Genuine curiosity about language, culture, advertising, and consumer behaviour. Ability to use AI as a supporting tool without relying on AI-generated drafts as a substitute for original creative thinking. Bonus Points Experience working with eCommerce, D2C, lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wellness, or other consumer brands. Experience building brands from the ground up or working in fast-growing, founder-led environments. Experience developing creative territories and integrated campaigns across multiple channels. Experience writing for international audiences and adapting messaging across markets. Experience collaborating with performance teams on creative experiments, A/B testing, and messaging optimisation. Familiarity with creator partnerships, influencer campaigns, and short-form video scripts. Experience building copywriting guidelines, editorial standards, and reusable messaging frameworks. Experience using AI tools and automation to improve research, ideation, and creative workflows while maintaining originality. You probably shouldn't apply if... Your experience is primarily limited to content execution, blogs, or SEO articles without strong creative copywriting. You rely on templates, familiar advertising clichés, or AI-generated drafts rather than developing original ideas. You struggle to demonstrate your writing ability through a strong portfolio. You have limited experience developing brand voices, campaign concepts, or messaging frameworks. Your writing is grammatically correct but lacks personality, nuance, cultural understanding, or originality. You focus only on creative expression without considering the audience, business objective, or commercial outcome. You struggle to adapt your writing for different brands, platforms, or international audiences. You prefer working on one brand or brief at a time and find multiple concurrent projects challenging. You're uncomfortable explaining your creative decisions, collaborating with other teams, or incorporating feedback. You view copywriting as simply putting words together rather than solving communication and brand challenges. The best time to join Valerie was yesterday. The next best time is now 🤓 👋 Our Hiring Process We want interviews to be valuable for both sides. Throughout the process, you'll meet the people you'll work with, learn more about the role, and get a chance to understand how we think and operate. Our process typically includes: Introductory conversation with our Talent team <> 30 mins Hiring Manager interview <> 30-45 mins Role-specific assessment or practical exercise (where applicable) Cross-functional or stakeholder interviews <> 30-45 mins Final conversation with leadership <> 30-45 mins We'll always let you know what to expect before each stage. 💪🏾 What You Can Expect Meaningful work with visible impact High ownership from day one Collaboration with experienced founders, operators, and specialists A team that values curiosity, initiative, and continuous improvement Competitive compensation and the tools you need to do your best work Opportunities to grow as Valerie grows Valerie is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We hire based on skills, potential, and the ability to contribute to our team. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: Talent Acquisition Specialist Snapshot Curvion Blue is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and attract high-performing sales talent. This isn't a traditional HR recruiting role where you're posting jobs, waiting for applications, and hoping the right person wanders into the funnel. You're going to be responsible for building and managing talent pipelines for sales roles across our business, with a heavy focus on identifying A-Players who can perform in high-ticket sales environments. The ideal candidate has experience in Talent Acquisition or recruiting and understands how to source, qualify, interview, and move candidates through a high-volume hiring process. Bonus points if you've actually sold before. Extra bonus points if you've sold high-ticket. We want someone who understands salespeople because they've been one, worked closely with them, or recruited them extensively. Position Overview As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will own recruiting across Curvion Blue 's sales organization and help us continuously build a bench of exceptional talent. You'll work closely with leadership to understand what "great" looks like for each role, then take that profile into the market and find the people who match it. This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who enjoys sourcing, talking to candidates, assessing talent, and moving quickly. You will be responsible for the full recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, candidate outreach, screening, interview coordination, candidate evaluation, pipeline management, and offer management. More importantly, you'll become an expert in identifying the difference between someone who sounds like a great salesperson and someone who can actually perform. Your Core Responsibilities Talent Sourcing Build proactive talent pipelines for closers, setters, sales leaders, and other revenue-generating roles. Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, communities, databases, and creative outbound strategies. Develop targeted sourcing strategies based on role requirements and candidate profiles. Continuously build talent pools rather than starting from zero every time a role opens. Candidate Qualification Conduct recruiter screens to evaluate experience, communication, motivation, sales ability, and overall fit. Identify candidates with demonstrated performance rather than relying solely on resume keywords. Assess candidates against defined scorecards and role-specific success profiles. Understand sales metrics, quotas, KPIs, close rates, lead flow, revenue, and other performance indicators. Identify red flags and know when to move a candidate forward versus cut them from the process. Sales Talent Acquisition Become deeply familiar with high-ticket sales roles and the characteristics of top-performing setters, closers, sales directors, and sales leaders. Understand the difference between legitimate sales experience and resume fluff. Build relationships with high-performing sales professionals and maintain a warm talent network. Help Curvion Blue become known as a destination for high-performing sales talent. Candidate Experience Own candidate communication throughout the recruiting process. Keep candidates engaged, informed, and moving through each stage. Represent Curvion Blue professionally and enthusiastically. Create a candidate experience that reflects the level of talent we want to attract. Recruiting Operations Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline stages in our ATS. Track recruiting metrics including pipeline volume, conversion rates, time-to-fill, source performance, and quality of hire. Coordinate interviews, skills assessments, roleplays, and other evaluation stages. Partner with hiring managers to continuously improve the recruiting process. Identify bottlenecks and recommend ways to improve recruiting efficiency. Hiring & Onboarding Partnership Support offer creation and candidate closing. Help ensure strong candidates remain engaged through acceptance and start date. Partner with the team to identify early indicators of successful hires. Track quality of hire and use performance data to improve future recruiting decisions. You SHOULD Apply If You have 1+ years of Talent Acquisition, recruiting, or full-cycle recruiting experience. You have experience recruiting salespeople, preferably revenue-generating roles. You know how to source candidates rather than relying exclusively on inbound applicants. You're comfortable conducting candidate screens and making recommendations to hiring managers. You can quickly identify whether someone's experience actually matches what they're claiming. You are highly comfortable talking to salespeople. You understand performance-driven environments and aren't intimidated by metrics. You can manage multiple open roles without losing track of candidates or details. You're organized, responsive, and operationally strong. You're comfortable working in an environment where priorities can move quickly. You can communicate professionally with candidates at every level. You're proactive. If you see a recruiting problem, your instinct is to solve it rather than wait for someone to tell you what to do. BIG BONUS POINTS You have past sales experience. You have high-ticket sales experience. You've been a setter, closer, AE, sales manager, or sales leader. You've recruited high-ticket closers or setters before. You've worked in coaching, consulting, SaaS, agency, or other performance-driven sales environments. You understand sales compensation structures and can speak intelligently about earning potential with candidates. You have an established network of sales talent. You've recruited for remote sales organizations. You SHOULD NOT Apply If You only want to work inbound applications. You don't enjoy outbound sourcing. You need every step of your day mapped out for you. You don't like metrics or performance accountability. You're uncomfortable making judgment calls on candidates. You struggle to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. You view recruiting as simply scheduling interviews and forwarding resumes. You don't enjoy talking to people. You're looking for a slow-moving corporate environment with six approval layers before anything gets done. You have never recruited before and are looking for your first opportunity in Talent Acquisition. Long-Term You become one of the people Curvion Blue relies on to answer: "We need five great salespeople. Where are they?" And your answer is: "Already working on it." The Person We're Looking For We're not looking for someone who simply wants to "work in HR." We're looking for a talent hunter. Someone who enjoys the chase. Someone who can look at a LinkedIn profile and immediately start thinking: "This person might be good. Let me find out." You should enjoy talking to people, asking good questions, spotting potential, and figuring out what makes someone tick. You should be competitive enough to care about winning the search, analytical enough to care about hiring quality, and organized enough to keep the machine running. If you've sold before, you'll probably have a natural advantage here because you already understand how to build rapport, overcome objections, create urgency, and influence decisions. If you've sold high-ticket , even better. You already understand the world our candidates operate in. At Curvion Blue , we're building revenue engines for our clients. That requires exceptional people. Your job is to help us find them. Schedule: Monday to Friday 9AM - 6 PM (specific to your time zone) Compensation Range: $50K - $80K Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Electrical Engineer, Robotics
description: About Menlo Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable -- turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place. The Role As an Electrical Engineer, you will own the design, integration, and bring-up of the electronic systems that power Asimov. From power distribution to motor control to sensor integration, you will work across schematics, PCB layouts, harness design, and hardware debug -- ensuring every electrical decision holds up in the field and integrates cleanly with the broader mechanical and firmware stack. What You'll Do Design and review schematics and PCB layouts for power distribution units, motor driver boards, and actuator control electronics Integrate wiring harnesses, PCBA enclosures, and motor controllers into mechanical assemblies from the ground up Lead bring-up of power systems, sensors, and actuator subassemblies; diagnose and resolve issues across multiple hardware revisions Define and run electrical and system-level test protocols, analyze failure modes, and iterate based on test data Work closely with firmware and controls teams to ensure electrical design choices support stable, low-latency control loops Apply expertise in connector selection, grounding strategies, harness routing, and EMI suppression to ensure robust and field-reliable hardware Contribute to Menlo 's open-source design efforts, including PCB schematics and manufacturing documentation for the broader robotics community What You'll Bring 3 or more years of hands-on electrical engineering experience on high-complexity electromechanical products Solid understanding of electrical and electronic systems, including motor drivers, sensors, and embedded hardware integration Deep familiarity with low-voltage (under 60V) DC power systems, DC-DC converters, MOSFET gate drivers, current-sense amplifiers, and passive network design Proficiency using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and CAN/UART sniffers for in-depth hardware debug Expertise in connector selection, grounding strategies, harness routing, and EMI suppression techniques Strong communication skills to drive alignment across firmware teams, mechanical engineers, and leadership Bonus points for: Experience with bipedal or humanoid robot hardware or legged locomotion platforms Familiarity with CAN bus, motor controllers, and how electrical design choices affect firmware and control integration Scripting experience in Python for hardware automation and data analysis Familiarity with sim-to-real workflows and how hardware decisions affect locomotion policy training and transfer Why Join Menlo ? You will be part of a tight-knit team defining the next generation of humanoid robots. With genuine ownership of the mechanical systems that bring Asimov to life, you will see your designs go from CAD to real-world deployments. If you thrive in fast-paced, open-collaborative environments, let's build the future of robotics together. A Note on AI You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. Equal Opportunity and Accommodations We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know. Originally posted on Himalayas

Key Responsibilities The Ad Operations Team Lead is a first-line people manager responsible for the day-to-day supervision of a team performing standard digital advertising operations. The role plans coverage and workloads, monitors delivery and quality, coaches employees, manages escalations, and communicates with internal stakeholders and assigned clients across campaign setup, trafficking, monitoring, reporting, quality assurance, optimization support, and related activities. The position requires at least three years of hands-on Ad Operations experience, with five or more years preferred, and demonstrated experience supervising, coordinating, or leading an operational team. This is primarily a managerial role rather than a production role; the Team Lead may demonstrate procedures, validate complex work, or provide limited coverage when necessary while remaining accountable for team performance, employee development, process adherence, and client service. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Team Supervision and Workforce Coordination Direct daily team activities, assign and prioritize work, monitor task queues, and ensure deadlines and client commitments are met. Manage schedules, attendance, leave coordination, shift handoffs, workload coverage, and staffing risks with the appropriate manager or support functions. Set performance expectations; provide feedback, coaching, and documented follow-up; and support corrective action and formal performance reviews when required. Track workload, capacity, utilization, productivity, and employee availability, and reallocate resources as operating needs change. Operational Delivery, Quality, and Performance Management Maintain accountability for team accuracy, quality assurance, turnaround times, service levels, task completion, productivity, and operational reliability. Review dashboards, trackers, error trends, delivery risks, and recurring issues; coordinate corrective actions and communicate material risks promptly. Ensure adherence to approved procedures, quality checklists, escalation paths, information-security requirements, and client-specific instructions. Perform Ad Operations tasks when necessary to maintain service continuity, provide coverage during employee absences, or support periods of increased workload, while ensuring that team supervision and operational management remain the role's primary responsibilities. Client Communication and Escalation Management Represent the team in governance meetings, status calls, and operational reviews, providing clear updates on delivery, quality, staffing, risks, and action items. Coordinate escalations, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, documentation, and issue resolution. Collaborate with Operations Managers, subject matter experts, quality assurance, Training Specialists, and other stakeholders, including campaign-performance discussions when relevant. Employee Development, Training, and Skill Management Partner with the Ad Operations Training Specialist on onboarding, nesting, refresher, remedial, and cross-training, and reinforce learning through coaching and calibration. Conduct skill set reviews, identify capability gaps, maintain skills records, and develop coaching, cross-training, coverage, and readiness plans. Participate in client-led and platform-specific training, ensure attendance, and maintain accurate records of procedures, materials, decisions, and follow-up. Qualifications and Requirements: Bachelor's degree or higher in any field from an accredited institution is required. A minimum of three years of hands-on Ad Operations experience is required; five or more years of relevant experience is preferred. Experience supervising, coordinating, or leading an operational team is required, including work allocation, schedule or coverage management, coaching, performance feedback, and follow-up. Hands-on experience with at least one relevant platform is required, such as Google Ad Manager, Campaign Manager 360, Display & Video 360, FreeWheel, The Trade Desk, Google Ads, Search Ads 360, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Operative, or an equivalent platform. Intermediate or higher Microsoft Excel proficiency, including formulas, sorting, filtering, formatting, structured data, and reporting; working knowledge of Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams; and the capacity to learn quickly. Strong written and verbal English, people-leadership, client-facing, coaching, and interpersonal skills. Exceptional attention to detail, judgment, organization, and time management, with the ability to interpret metrics, manage priorities, document decisions, and resolve or escalate issues. Preferred Experience and Knowledge: Experience across multiple digital advertising channels or platforms and leading a client-dedicated, distributed, or shift-based team. title: Sr. Casualty Claims Representative
description: Company Overview Recognized as a Milwaukee Journal Sentinel Top Workplace for 14 consecutive years, including three years of being honored as number one! Join us at West Bend, where we believe that our associates are our greatest asset. We hire talented individuals who are conscientious, dedicated, customer focused, and able to build lasting relationships. We create and maintain an environment where you feel a sense of belonging and appreciation. Your diversity of thought, experience, and knowledge are valued. We’re committed to fostering a welcoming culture, offering you opportunities for meaningful work and professional growth. More than a workplace, we celebrate our successes and take pride in serving our communities. Job Summary Handle moderate to complex casualty claims independently, including Construction Defect, General Liability (Injury and Property Damage), Commercial Transportation, and Auto Bodily Injury claims. Work Location This position offers both remote and hybrid work locations. Candidates who reside within 50 miles of an office location (West Bend, Madison, Appleton) will be offered a hybrid work schedule. Candidates who are fully remote (beyond 50 miles) may occasionally be asked to travel to an office location for in-person engagement activities such as team meetings, training and corporate events. Responsibilities & Qualifications At West Bend, we believe claims handling is more than managing files. It's about helping customers navigate challenging situations while delivering expertise, sound judgment, and exceptional service. We're looking for an experienced claims professional to independently manage complex casualty claims and serve as a trusted technical resource within our claims organization. What You'll Do Investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve moderate to highly complex casualty claims from initial loss through final disposition. This role handles a diverse and challenging caseload that may include: Construction Defect claims General Liability claims involving bodily injury and property damage Commercial Transportation and Trucking claims Commercial and Personal Auto Bodily Injury claims High-exposure and litigated casualty losses You'll independently evaluate coverage, liability, damages, and claim exposure while ensuring compliance with policy provisions, legal requirements, and department standards. Responsibilities include: Conducting thorough investigations and analyzing evidence to support claim decisions Evaluating policy coverage, liability, damages, and risk exposure Establishing and maintaining appropriate claim reserves Negotiating settlements and resolving complex claims efficiently and effectively Managing litigated files and partnering with defense counsel on claim strategy Preparing reservation of rights, coverage position, and denial letters Reviewing contracts, indemnification agreements, and risk transfer provisions Collaborating with insureds, claimants, attorneys, expert vendors, law enforcement, and other stakeholders Analyzing accident reports, driver records, electronic logging data, medical records, and other claim documentation Serving as a technical resource and mentor to team members by providing guidance, coaching, and training Delivering exceptional customer service while maintaining quality, audit, and compliance standards What You'll Bring to the Role Significant experience handling casualty claims, including complex bodily injury exposures Prior commercial trucking and transportation claims experience preferred Experience managing litigated files and working directly with attorneys Strong coverage analysis, liability evaluation, and investigative skills Advanced knowledge of policy interpretation, contracts, risk transfer, and indemnification agreements Sound negotiation, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities Ability to manage multiple complex claims while maintaining strong customer relationships Excellent verbal and written communication skills Insurance designations or coursework such as CPCU, AIC, AINS, ARM, SCLA, or similar professional education are a plus Why You'll Love It Here You'll join a collaborative team that values expertise, supports professional growth, and trusts you to make an impact. Here, you'll tackle meaningful and challenging claims, serve as a technical leader for others, and help deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers. Share in Our Success At West Bend, we believe great work should be rewarded. In addition to competitive compensation and outstanding benefits, eligible employees can earn an annual Performance Bonus Plan payout of up to 18% of base salary , based on both company and individual performance. When you help drive our success, you'll share in the rewards. Salary Statement The salary range for this position is $70,000-$90,000. The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity. Compensation decisions are made by West Bend and are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate. Benefits West Bend offers a comprehensive benefit plan including but not limited to: Medical & Prescription Insurance Health Savings Account Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Short and Long Term Disability Flexible Spending Accounts Life and Accidental Death & Disability Accident and Critical Illness Insurance Employee Assistance Program 401(k) Plan with Company Match Pet Insurance Paid Time Off. Standard first year PTO is 17 days, pro-rated based on month of hire. Enhanced PTO may be available for experienced candidates Bonus eligible based on performance West Bend will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act for Colorado employees, in accordance with its plans and policies. EEO West Bend provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, and promotion. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Firmware Security Architect, Networking
description: NVIDIA Networking product security team is looking for an outstanding technical security architect with hands-on experience to help us improve the security posture of NVIDIA networking products. In this role you will partner with firmware, hardware, and architecture teams on the security architecture, to reduce risk, threats, and vulnerabilities while driving new security features that affect millions of devices all over the world! What you'll be doing: Be involved in the security architecture of NVIDIA Networking firmware — trust boundaries, privilege separation between firmware domains, device identity and key storage, secure boot and chain of trust, and secure update and anti-rollback flows. Perform security threat modeling of firmware and embedded subsystems across NVIDIA Networking products. Analyze complex firmware and hardware/firmware interactions to identify security weaknesses, including boot flows, privileged execution environments, and host- and network-facing management interfaces. Define security features and mitigations spanning the full device lifecycle — provisioning, attestation, debug authorization, runtime hardening, and field update. Guide the engineering teams throughout the implementation. Translate threat models into actionable security requirements and architectural decisions, and review designs and implementations against them. Partner with hardware and ASIC architects to specify the security primitives firmware depends on, and define how they are used across the product line. Drive secure development practices for firmware — memory-safe coding patterns in C, static analysis, and fuzzing of firmware-exposed interfaces — and make sure development processes meet security and coding standards. What we need to see: Academic degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Demonstrated experience of 8+ years in product security, firmware security, or security research, including hands-on work with embedded or firmware codebases. Experience defining security policy models — authorization schemes, RBAC, and administrative role separation — including how policy is expressed, enforced, and administered in production. Familiarity with applied cryptography (including secure boot, code signing, and attestation), threat modeling, common attack vectors, and mitigation techniques. Ability to work independently, and collaboratively in a constantly evolving environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ways to stand out from the crowd: M.Sc. or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, or related technical field. Experience with hardware/software interfaces in networking devices — register and MMIO programming models, DMA, mailbox and doorbell mechanisms, PCIe configuration and management interfaces, and the firmware that drives them. Experience with hardware roots of trust and hardware-enforced isolation (MPU/MMU, secure enclaves, fuse/OTP-based provisioning) in SoCs or ASICs. Hands-on experience with networking software — device drivers, control plane, management interfaces, or embedded network operating systems — and an understanding of how these components interact with firmware. Familiarity with high-scale deployment, the data center security ecosystem and its operational challenges. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our special engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. title: Accelerated Computing Research Intern
description: NVIDIA is searching for a MSc/PhD candidate to join our growing software architecture team. The ideal candidate will be conducting innovative research at the intersection of Networking, Security, and Communications, and working alongside top authorities in these fields. With incredible resources at your disposal, you will be able to impact, contribute and advance these exiting domains. Topics include but are not limited to remote direct memory access, hardware offloading and acceleration, AI for networking and security, storage management, cryptography, and architecture. With its unique open culture, NVIDIA is one of the best industry labs to do Accelerated Computing research. DPU Data-Processing Units are the smallest form of a data center, and provide the foundation to implement accelerated computing, where both processing and networking experience a performance boost through the utilization of dedicated processors. DPUs started out as the engine for accelerated networking, but now they can run AI inference and training on-board, deep packet inspection and cryptography accelerations among others thanks to onboard GPUs and acceleration engines. Join us to research next-generation accelerated data-center architectures in a unique internship with NVIDIA partnership. What you’ll be doing : Be at the forefront of modern data center research Partner and collaborate with forward-thinking industry leaders and external researchers Participate and speak at conferences and events Publish original research Work with intelligent networking machines powered by AI systems that can learn, reason and interact with other network components What we need to see: Pursuing a PhD or a MSc Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or Computer Engineering General computer science background, preferably in algorithm design, system programming, networking, operating system, and computer architecture. Strong programming (C/C++/Python) and software development skills Low-level Linux Good communications skills NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love the challenge of crafting the highest performance & lowest power silicon possible? If so, we want to hear from you. Come, join our Networking Research Team and help build the real-time, cost-effective computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field. Originally posted on Himalayas

Qualifications: Proven experience in demand planning, inventory management, and supply chain operations, preferably in e-commerce. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and generate actionable insights. Experience managing inventory for the Amazon Marketplace, including knowledge of FBA (Fulfilled by Amazon) and related processes. High attention to detail and organizational skills. Experience working with international suppliers, especially from China, is a plus. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. description: Role Title: Bluebook Citation Specialist (Law Students & Recent JDs) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote Opportunity Snapshot Pay: $50–80/hour You’ll need: Current or recent law school enrollment, hands-on Bluebook experience, and law journal or law review editing experience Your tasks: Review citation-checking rubrics and build sample cite-checking tasks Job Description micro1 is engaging law students and recent law graduates with law journal experience to support a legal citation project. Create sample cite-checking tasks: source material paired with citations containing realistic errors, along with the correct answer and an explanation of the rule involved. Build tasks across a range of citation types and difficulty levels, from straightforward formatting errors to subtle pincite and source-support problems. Apply Bluebook rules consistently across all submissions. Flag ambiguous cases to project coordinators instead of resolving them silently. Deliver assigned work on schedule and at the required quality level. Preferred Qualifications Current law student (2L, 3L) or recent JD graduate. Comfortable working independently and meeting deadlines without close supervision. Experience as a journal editor, articles editor, or executive editor is a plus.
