Job Title: IT Project Manager (PMP), Rural Health Transformation Program Work Arrangement: Fully remote within the United States; full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time (client working days only; no client holidays) Location: Remote, United States (Eastern Time schedule) Employment Type: W-2, full time, 40 hours per week Pay Rate: $70/hr (W-2) Engagement Type: Contract, anticipated start December 2026; duration tied to the implementation of the program's IT solutions (end date to be confirmed by the client) Final Interview: Client interview by phone or video Position Summary Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring an IT Project Manager on behalf of the client, a state government health and human services agency. The agency is responding to the federal Rural Health Transformation Program, a five-year funding initiative to make care more accessible, higher quality and better tailored to rural communities, and anticipates a series of IT focused missions in support of it. The Project Manager works within the state's Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO), follows its hybrid project lifecycle (Agile practices during implementation), takes direction from the EPMO Portfolio Manager, and manages one or more program projects day to day alongside the state project team, program sponsors, governance committees and implementation vendors. Preference is given to candidates who have managed similar health program or federally funded initiatives and who already work the way a state EPMO expects. Key Responsibilities Create and maintain the project schedule in the EPMO-prescribed tool (activities, dependencies, milestones, start and end dates, resources, percent complete), updated weekly through closeout, and take part in weekly updates to the implementation vendor's master schedule. Deliver weekly project status reports in the state's project management tool. Create and maintain risks and issues in the state's tool, recommend responses, and run monthly risk and issue reviews. Facilitate project meetings, including status, risk and issue review, backlog grooming, release planning and change review; publish agendas 24 hours before and minutes 24 hours after, distributed from the state document repository. Track project financials and enter actual expenditures in the EPMO tool monthly or as approved changes affect the budget. Manage change control with the EPMO Portfolio Manager and state governance committees, using the state's Change Request Form, and track changes in the project tool. Track all deliverables in a deliverable approval matrix and manage the implementation vendor's Deliverable Expectation Documents (DED) and Deliverable Acceptance Forms (DAF). Maintain the stakeholder register, decision log and action item log; engage program and project sponsors and governance committees on policy decisions, scope, resources, budget and escalated issues. Facilitate project activities, including the state's procurement process. Produce the deliverables required by state, agency and federal governance (for example CMS and FNS), following EPMO templates. Organize and archive project artifacts in the state document repository. Run lessons learned and produce the project closeout report at the end of each project. Requirements Requirements Required: Current PMP certification (copy of the certificate is required with the application). Current HIPAA training certificate, or willingness to complete HIPAA training provided by Dhaka Technologies Limited Company before submission and maintain it for the duration of the engagement. Experience managing IT implementation projects for state government, preferably for a health and human services, Medicaid or public health agency. Experience managing an implementation vendor's schedule and deliverables, including deliverable review and acceptance. Experience with hybrid or Agile delivery, including backlog grooming and release planning. Three professional references, submitted with the application, from engagements within the last five years who can speak specifically to the candidate's project management work. Applications without three references will not be considered. Proficiency with Azure DevOps and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Project, Visio) and Adobe PDF. Strong organization, document repository management, and written and verbal communication. Available full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time. Located in and authorized to work in the United States; W-2 only (no C2C or 1099). Must pass a national criminal background check, sign the client's acceptable use and confidentiality terms, work only on client-provided systems, and not use AI meeting assistants in client meetings. Preferred: Experience with federally funded health programs or grant initiatives (for example CMS, HRSA or rural health programs) and their reporting requirements. Experience working within a state Enterprise Project Management Office and its templates and governance. Experience managing several concurrent projects or a program of related projects. How to Apply Please send your resume, a copy of your PMP certificate (and HIPAA training certificate if you have one), and three professional references to with "IT Project Manager, Rural Health Transformation" in the subject line. For each reference, include the name, title, organization, email address, phone number, and the project management work the reference can speak to. References must be from engagements within the last five years. Applications submitted without three references will not be considered. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Lead-Producer Services Readiness
description: Role Overview The Producer Services Readiness Lead serves as the senior Producer Services subject matter expert for translating approved requirements into practical workflows, standard operating procedures, training, service processes, controls, and launch plans. The role leads and coordinates readiness activities for new and changing business-process requirements within Producer Services. The Lead applies sound operational judgment and escalates decisions involving policy, risk, resources, or cross-functional ownership to the appropriate Producer Services leader. The Lead coordinates readiness activities and assesses whether staff, workflows, materials, system dependencies, and escalation paths have been prepared before new producer-facing requirements go live, escalating unresolved readiness risks as appropriate. The role provides targeted onboarding and Support readiness during launches and peak periods but does not become the standing owner of routine onboarding, Support production, regulatory interpretation, or technical delivery. Key Responsibilities Business Process Readiness & Subject Matter Expertise Serve as the Producer Services subject matter expert for the implementation of new and changing business-process requirements. Translate approved policy, program, regulatory, financial, and operational decisions into clear Producer Services workflows and operating requirements. Develop and recommend how approved requirements should be executed across affected Producer Services teams, working with team leaders to confirm the final operating approach. Map current- and future-state processes, including roles, handoffs, decision rights, controls, exceptions, and escalation paths. Identify missing decisions, process gaps, conflicting requirements, and dependencies that could prevent successful implementation. Recommend practical operating approaches that balance producer clarity, control requirements, service quality, and available capacity for review and approval by Producer Services leadership. Maintain awareness of new and changing Producer Services processes across registration, reporting, validation, adjustments, corrections, payments, delinquency, and regulator referrals to support readiness planning and implementation activities. Process Implementation & Operationalization Assess the operational feasibility and impacts of new or changing requirements affecting Producer Services. Coordinate and support the implementation and operationalization of approved Producer Services processes, partnering with process owners and functional leaders to ensure readiness activities are completed. Draft and maintain operational process documentation, including SOPs, process maps, job aids, checklists, decision trees, intake procedures, queue-routing rules, and escalation protocols. Document process ownership, handoffs, decision rights, and escalation paths across Producer Services and partner functions. Coordinate the transition of approved requirements from process design into day-to-day operations. Assess readiness and identify gaps related to workflows, documentation, controls, staffing, data, knowledge, and escalation paths before launch, escalating unresolved risks to the appropriate leader. Monitor adoption after launch, identify operational gaps, and coordinate approved process updates, training activities, or corrective actions with the appropriate process owners. Transition implemented processes to the appropriate steady-state owner after stabilization. Training, Launch & Adoption Develop and coordinate operational training for new and changing Producer Services processes. Prepare facilitator materials, staff job aids, process guidance, scenarios, and readiness resources. Facilitate or support training sessions for Producer Services and other affected teams. Support readiness activities designed to ensure affected staff have access to process guidance, resources, training, and escalation paths before launch. Coordinate operational launch plans, including readiness checkpoints, communications inputs, staffing considerations, and contingency procedures. Support post-launch stabilization by monitoring questions, handoff failures, process exceptions, and operational issues Maintain documentation showing completion of required readiness, training, and launch activities. Product Owner & Solutions Partnership Partner with the Producer Solutions Product Owner to connect business-process readiness with the product and systems roadmap. Provide process requirements, workflows, business rules, exceptions, and operational input needed to support systems development. Review proposed system changes for alignment with approved Producer Services processes and operating needs. Provide subject matter expertise during requirements development, testing preparation, and implementation planning. Participates in UAT and business acceptance as the operational-process subject matter expert and validate that end-to-end workflows and exceptions have been documented and tested. Prepare teams, workflows, knowledge, and training for system releases coordinated through the Product Owner. Identify gaps between approved business processes and proposed technical solutions and raise the associated operational impacts. Support and coordinate operational readiness activities associated with transitioning approved system improvements into Producer Services. Provides operational recommendations and readiness assessments within delegated authority; final product acceptance, prioritization, and release decisions remain with the Product Owner and business sponsor. Maintain clear separation between process readiness and product ownership. The Product Owner manages the systems roadmap, systems requirements, UAT governance, and delivery coordination; the Readiness Lead serves as the operational readiness lead for process implementation, staff readiness, training, launch preparation, and operational adoption activities. Cross-Functional Coordination Coordinate with Compliance to ensure processes reflect approved regulatory requirements while maintaining Compliance ownership of regulatory interpretation and correctness. Coordinate with Finance on producer-facing payment, invoicing, adjustment, and correction processes while maintaining Finance ownership of billing. Coordinate with Producer Support on intake, routing, approved answers, service workflows, and case escalation procedures. Support delinquency-monitoring and regulator-referral processes while maintaining regulator ownership of enforcement decisions. Continuous Improvement & Process Controls Monitor operating results and recommend updates to processes, controls, training, and readiness standards based on recurring issues and lessons learned. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual work, strengthen controls, and improve producer clarity. Maintain traceable documentation of approved decisions, process requirements, controls, ownership, and implementation status. Support audit-ready operations by ensuring procedures, required evidence, and approval points are clearly documented. Provide analysis and recommendations to Producer Services leadership regarding improvement opportunities based on service, risk, producer, and implementation impacts. Other job related duties as assigned. Skills & Competencies Strong business-process design, implementation, and operationalization skills. Ability to become a trusted subject matter expert across complex and changing process requirements. Strong facilitation and training skills with technical and nontechnical audiences. Excellent organizational and follow-through skills across multiple concurrent launches and deadlines. Ability to translate approved requirements into clear workflows, roles, controls, and operating instructions. Strong written communication and documentation skills. Ability to identify missing decisions, unclear ownership, dependencies, and implementation risks. Sou

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description: Overview Under direction of FP&A leaders, this role will provide financial reporting, analysis, and forecasting support to Business Unit or sub-business unit leaders as assigned. Analyze consolidated actual results vs. forecast, plan, and prior year benchmarks. Create templates and processes for data gathering, tracking, and translation/submission to financial reporting systems. Responsibilities Lead processes and take ownership of financial forecasting, budgeting, and analysis models for assigned business areas though leveraging Adaptive. Analyze financial information and provide accurate and timely actual/forecast variance analysis vs. budget and other dimensions. Mix and cause of change analyses. Work closely with client services and operations to gather input for forecasting/budgeting purposes. Act as the point of contact for all FP&A deliveries in the assigned division. Ability to build and QA financial models and views as part of monthly reporting packages distributed to internal executive leadership and external stakeholders. Review and update corresponding MD&A. Handle ad-hoc requests from internal and external stakeholders timely and accurately. Ability to work in an agile and fast-paced environment. Gather feedback from various stakeholders and business leaders towards continuous process improvements. Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and the requirements of the job change. Qualifications BS degree in accounting, finance, or related field. Masters in related field or CPA a plus. 5 years of experience in accounting, finance, or similar field. FP&A specific experience a plus. Experience with executive/board level reporting to both internal and external stakeholders a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. MS Office experience required, specifically, strong Excel skills. Experience with financial & BI tools, a plus (specifically NetSuite/Adaptive/Hyperion/Tableau). Cognitive / Mental Requirements: Proactive problem solving skills. Ability to work well in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects. Physical Requirements and Working Conditions: Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods. Communicating with others to exchange information. Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned. No adverse environmental conditions expected. Base compensation ranges from $86,000 to $105,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti . For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually. Date of posting: 10/19/2026 Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 11/19/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. #senior Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Administrative Assistant

The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented and able to prioritize multiple tasks. Key Responsibilities 1. Data Management: Create, maintain, and update spreadsheets. Pull reports from various sources, enter data into software systems, and ensure accuracy. Perform regular data entry tasks and ensure consistency and reliability of data. 2. Email and Communication Management: Monitor, prioritize, and respond to incoming emails on behalf of the team or department. Manage email correspondence efficiently, ensuring timely responses to inquiries. Draft and send professional emails as needed to clients, team members, and other stakeholders. 3. Benefits Above market salary HMO on Day 1 for principal and two dependents Government-mandated benefits Performance-based Incentives Quarterly Company Events 1,000 PHP De Minimis Equipment and software provided Originally posted on Himalayas

As a key member of the Customer Success leadership team, you’ll shape the strategy for how we engage and retain enterprise customers, strengthen executive relationships, and scale customer outcomes in partnership with Product, Engineering, and Sales. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in SaaS account management, a proven ability to build and inspire teams, and a passion for helping customers realize measurable value from enterprise-grade security technology. The role will report directly to the global VP of CS. What you will do Lead and develop the Enterprise Customer Success team across AMER, including multiple levels of leadership (Directors and Managers). Drive customer retention, satisfaction, and expansion across a large, complex enterprise customer base. Establish and execute the Enterprise Customer Success strategy, ensuring alignment with company goals and operational excellence. Take an active, customer-facing role in escalations and customer issue resolution where needed. Use data-driven insights to improve customer health, forecast retention risk, and guide proactive engagement. Coach and mentor CS leaders to build high-performing teams that deliver measurable impact and operate with accountability. Must Haves 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Post-Sales leadership within a B2B SaaS environment; 5+ years leading large or multi-level teams. Proven success managing Enterprise or Global customers, ideally in the cybersecurity, email security, or infrastructure SaaS space. Strong business acumen and ability to partner with senior executives at Fortune 500 organizations. Demonstrated ability to scale teams and processes in a high-growth environment. Experience driving retention and expansion strategies through data, systems, and strong cross-functional collaboration. Exceptional communication, executive presence, and relationship management skills. Strategic thinker who thrives in ambiguity and acts with ownership and urgency. Understanding of renewals and expansion motions in partnership with Renewal Management / Sales. Experience building and operationalizing impactful AI-driven processes for post sales functions Nice to Have Experience in email security, cybersecurity, or enterprise infrastructure software. title: Systems Engineering Lead
description: Systems Engineer Lead This is a player-coach leadership position, not a people manager removed from the technology. The ideal candidate leads by example, enjoys mentoring engineers, remains deeply technical, works independently, collaborates effectively across teams, and thrives in environments where new challenges arise every day. The strongest candidates will come from enterprise environments supporting Windows, VMware, Azure, AWS, and cloud infrastructure while leading small teams of engineers and driving infrastructure projects from planning through execution. Who We Are EmployBridge is one of the United States' largest light industrial staffing company and the first workforce-as-a-service provider. The organization delivers workforce solutions through a digital-first approach while helping place hundreds of thousands of people into roles across the country. The culture is centered around Championing People and Unlocking Potential. The Systems Engineering Lead is responsible for leading a team of four Systems Engineers while remaining hands-on with the design, implementation, support, operation, and maintenance of enterprise infrastructure. This role supports both on-premises and cloud environments and serves as a senior technical resource across the organization. The individual will participate in technical research, infrastructure modernization, system administration, troubleshooting, and operational support while helping drive team productivity and accountability. Responsibilities Lead and coordinate a team of four Systems Engineers, ensuring priorities are aligned and work is completed effectively. Provide task management, accountability, coaching, and guidance while helping the team establish goals and achieve high levels of productivity. Design, install, configure, monitor, upgrade, maintain, and support infrastructure technologies including AWS, Azure, Windows Server, VMware, Microsoft 365 applications, networking, and related systems. Support both cloud and on-premises environments while maintaining critical business systems and infrastructure. Provide operational support and technical troubleshooting for servers, software applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise environments. Support major infrastructure initiatives, including Windows Server modernization efforts, system upgrades, and infrastructure improvements. Maintain infrastructure documentation, procedures, and operational standards. Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, Application Support, Help Desk, and other business teams to resolve issues and support ongoing projects. Partner with third-party vendors and technology providers for support, issue resolution, and project execution. Serve as a senior escalation point for complex technical issues and infrastructure challenges. Participate in daily operations, project planning, system monitoring, and on-call responsibilities. Required Experience 7+ years of hands-on Systems Engineering experience. 3+ years of technical team leadership experience. Experience supporting enterprise Windows environments, VMware infrastructure, cloud technologies, and server administration. 3+ years of AWS experience. Experience designing, installing, configuring, supporting, and maintaining server hardware, software, and infrastructure solutions. Preferred Experience Azure certifications. VMware certifications. Linux experience. CCNA, Server+, MCSE, or related technical certifications. Technical Expertise Required Windows Server VMware AWS Azure PowerShell Active Directory DNS Group Policy ADFS IIS Remote Desktop Services Microsoft 365 SharePoint Networking Cloud Infrastructure Server Administration Infrastructure Monitoring and Support What Success Looks Like Successfully leading a team of four Systems Engineers while maintaining a highly collaborative and accountable culture. Providing technical leadership across infrastructure initiatives and modernization projects. Supporting critical infrastructure and application-related issues across multiple teams. Building strong partnerships with stakeholders across the organization. Driving infrastructure stability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. Helping the organization successfully complete key server upgrade and modernization initiatives. Why? This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership role where no two days look the same. The individual will lead a team of engineers while working across Windows, VMware, Azure, AWS, certificates, cloud networking, and enterprise applications. The role offers significant exposure to complex infrastructure challenges, cross-functional collaboration, and opportunities to influence the future direction of the environment. It is ideal for someone who enjoys solving difficult technical problems, mentoring engineers, and continuously learning new technologies. Employbridge offers a competitive base salary plus monthly bonus potential! Additional benefits package for full time colleagues that includes: High IQ / EQ Team Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision benefits starting on the first of the month following hire date Pet Insurance starting on the first of the month following hire date 8 Paid Holidays per year Paid Time Off 401(k) Wellness Program Parental Leave The anticipated annual base salary for this position in the US is $135,000 - $145,000. This range does not include any other benefits that an individual may be eligible for. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act . Employbridge offers a competitive benefits package which includes Medical/Dental/Vision, prescription drug benefits, 401(k), paid time off and holidays, a wellness program, and incentive programs. We also offer a variety of career paths and encourage promotion from within. EmployBridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. title: Head of Growth
description: About LumiMeds LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up. As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive. We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction. Head of Growth — LumiMeds Location: Remote | Type: Full-time | Reports to: Founder/CEO About LumiMeds LumiMeds is a fast-growing telehealth company making GLP-1 weight-loss treatment (semaglutide & tirzepatide) accessible, affordable, and effective. We've built a real business with real patients and real outcomes — and we're just getting started. We move fast, test relentlessly, and let data settle arguments. The Role We're hiring a Head of Growth to own our growth engine end-to-end — online and offline. This is not a channel-manager seat. You'll set the growth strategy, run experiments across every lever (paid, organic, referral, partnerships, experiential, OOH, guerrilla), and personally drive the initiatives that move the business. You bring a playbook of proven tactics, the scrappiness to execute them on a lean budget, and the analytical rigor to know what's actually working. If you've grown a consumer business from scratch, thrive in ambiguity, and get a thrill out of finding the unlock nobody else saw — this is your seat. What You'll Do Own the full growth strategy across digital and offline channels — you set the roadmap and the number you're accountable to. Run growth end-to-end: ideation → hypothesis → execution → measurement → iterate. You don't hand things off; you drive them to the finish. Build and scale offline growth initiatives — experiential, OOH, guerrilla, events, partnerships, retail, and channels we haven't thought of yet. Scale digital acquisition — paid social/search, lifecycle, referral, affiliate, SEO/content — and squeeze efficiency out of every dollar. Bring proven playbooks — you've done this before and can point to specific tactics that worked, and why. Research relentlessly — find new channels, size opportunities, study competitors, and pressure-test ideas before we spend. Negotiate with vendors and partners — you get more for less and structure deals that de-risk our spend. Live in the data — instrument everything, measure CAC/LTV/payback obsessively, and kill what doesn't work fast. What You Bring Track record of growing a business — you can show real numbers you were directly responsible for moving. Both offline and digital growth experience — you're equally comfortable running a guerrilla campaign and a paid-acquisition dashboard. A documented playbook of growth tactics you've run and can run again. True growth-hacker DNA — scrappy, resourceful, and biased toward action on a lean budget. Data-driven decision-making — you form hypotheses, run clean tests, and follow the numbers. End-to-end ownership — you take an idea from napkin to launched, measured, and scaled. Strong research and negotiation skills — you find the opportunity and close the deal. Bonus: DTC, subscription, telehealth, wellness, or regulated-vertical experience. Why LumiMeds Direct access to the founder and a mandate to move fast. A real product with proven demand and outcomes — you're pouring fuel on a fire, not starting one. Full ownership of growth, with the budget and autonomy to prove your playbook. How to Apply If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English and ensure your resume reflects relevant experience for the role. This position is open to candidates based in approved locations, depending on the role and business needs. Qualified applicants will be contacted for next steps. LumiMeds is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skills, experience, and alignment with our values. Please note: This role requires professional-level English communication and availability to work U.S. business hours. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. Configure and manage Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls running PAN-OS, including security profiles (Antivirus, Anti-Spyware, Vulnerability Protection, WildFire), App-ID, User-ID, SSL/TLS decryption, and centralized management via Panorama. Lead firewall migration projects including legacy Cisco ASA to FTD conversions, cross-vendor migrations (Check Point, Fortinet, Juniper to Palo Alto or Cisco), and policy translation with rule optimization during cutover. Design network segmentation architectures using firewall zones, virtual routers, VRFs, and policy-based routing to enforce least-privilege east-west and north-south traffic controls. Deploy cloud-native firewall solutions including Palo Alto Cloud NGFW for AWS and Azure, and Cisco Secure Firewall Cloud Native for containerized and cloud workload environments. Implement firewall high availability designs including active/standby failover, active/active clustering, and multi-context deployments for service provider and large enterprise environments. Automate firewall provisioning, configuration backup, and policy deployment using infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible) and vendor APIs for repeatable, auditable workflows. Deploy Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) for wired and wireless authentication, MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB), and RADIUS/TACACS+ device administration across campus, branch, and data center environments. Configure ISE profiling services, posture assessment, and compliance enforcement to provide endpoint visibility and ensure devices meet organizational security baselines before granting access. Deploy ISE guest portals, BYOD onboarding workflows, and certificate-based authentication (EAP-TLS) with internal or external certificate authorities for secure device enrollment. Implement pxGrid integrations to share identity and session context between ISE, Cisco Secure Firewall, Splunk, and third-party security platforms for unified policy enforcement and threat intelligence. Design ISE distributed deployments spanning Policy Administration Nodes (PAN), Policy Service Nodes (PSN), and Monitoring and Troubleshooting Nodes (MnT) for scale, redundancy, and geographic distribution. Perform ISE upgrades, migrations (legacy ACS to ISE), and advanced troubleshooting using RADIUS live logs, policy trace, TCP dump, and debug utilities to resolve authentication and authorization issues. Key Responsibilities: SASE/Zero Trust: Design and implement SASE and Zero Trust architectures covering remote user, branch office, cloud workload, and data center connectivity use cases with a unified security policy framework. Configure and deploy Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) including Secure Web Gateway, SSL inspection, URL filtering, cloud firewall, and sandbox policies, and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) including ZTNA application segments, App Connectors, and browser-based access. Deploy Palo Alto Prisma Access including GlobalProtect remote user connectivity, explicit proxy for branch offices, and service connections to on-premises infrastructure managed through Strata Cloud Manager or Panorama. Implement Cisco Secure Access (SSE) including Zero Trust Network Access, Secure Web Gateway, Cloud Access Security Broker, and resource connector deployment for private application access. Configure Netskope Security Cloud including Next Gen SWG, CASB with API-enabled and inline protections, and Netskope Private Access (NPA) with traffic steering, real-time protection policies, and DLP controls. Leverage Guardicore micro-segmentation for east-west traffic control, application ring-fencing, and workload visibility to complement SASE north-south protections in hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Deploy identity-based access controls integrating with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, SAML 2.0, and SCIM provisioning to enforce user and device trust across all SASE platforms. Develop and maintain Zero Trust maturity roadmaps for clients, mapping current-state gaps to phased adoption plans across identity, device, network, application, and data pillars. Architecture, Design and Documentation: Lead client-facing discovery sessions, design workshops, and architecture reviews to define firewall, NAC, and SASE strategies aligned with business objectives and compliance requirements. Own the creation of High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) documents, network diagrams, implementation runbooks, and as-built documentation for firewall, ISE, and SASE deployments. Develop migration and cutover plans with rollback procedures, change management workflows, and CAB review packages Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and train client operations teams on day-2 firewall management, ISE policy administration, SASE platform operations, and incident response procedures. title: Partner Manager
description: At Algolia , we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests — four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined. In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens. As the Partner Manager for DACH, you will execute Algolia 's partner strategy across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with Germany as the primary focus market. You'll work with consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners to embed Algolia into the multi-technology — increasingly agentic — solutions they build and sell. This is not a solutions engineering role — you won't be architecting or implementing client solutions. But it is a solutions-focused role: you need real technical fluency, and the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia . In practice, that means identifying and shaping three kinds of agentic solutions: those that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners; those built by our consulting partners and brought to market by them; and those built jointly with technology partners around a shared value proposition that delivers real value to customers and end users. Pipeline development, opportunity progression and customer wins all matter — but they all start with getting the innovation right, with Algolia at the center of it. Reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships, and working in close collaboration with the General Manager of DACH, you will develop and execute the regional partner strategy — deciding which consulting, systems integration, technology and cloud partners to prioritize, and building the technical and commercial motions that turn those relationships into pipeline and revenue. Algolia 's partner motion in DACH is mature — we've been building relationships in the region for seven years. This role is an opportunity to build on that foundation: taking well-established partnerships to the next level, while also designing and standing up a partner-led growth strategy for the region. YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF: Developing and executing Algolia 's partner strategy across DACH, with Germany as the primary focus market alongside Austria and Switzerland Building on seven years of established partner relationships in the region, while designing and executing a new partner-led growth strategy for DACH Building and managing a portfolio of consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft) across the region Identifying, recruiting and onboarding new partners into the Algolia Partner Program, with particular attention to partners building agentic and AI-driven solutions Shaping and championing agentic solutions that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners Working with consulting partners to help them build their own agentic solutions on Algolia and bring those solutions to market Developing joint value propositions with technology partners for agentic solutions that deliver real value to customers and end users Acting as a solutions-focused innovator who can inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia Developing a working technical understanding of partner architectures and solutions deep enough to guide partners on where and how Algolia fits — without owning implementation Enabling partners on Algolia 's product and technical capabilities so they can position, sell and deliver successfully Owning deal registration, pursuit prioritization and account mapping across the partner portfolio Coordinating go-to-market strategy with partners, including joint marketing, co-selling and technical enablement content Coordinating across partners, internal sales and solutions engineering teams on strategic client pursuits Collaborating closely with the DACH General Manager and regional sales leadership to align partner strategy with revenue goals Collaborating with Algolia Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product and Enablement teams to ensure partner and end client success Owning pipeline creation and data accuracy for the DACH partner portfolio, with reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships — recognizing that strong pipeline, opportunity progression and customer wins all start with the right solution innovation involving Algolia YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE: 7-10+ years of experience in a senior Alliance, Channel or Partner role, ideally with technology, cloud or systems integration partners, in a recurring revenue business model Strong technical fluency — comfortable discussing APIs, search/AI architecture, cloud infrastructure and how multiple technologies combine into a single solution, without being a hands-on engineer Familiarity with the emerging landscape of agentic AI and the accelerator programs being built by systems integrators and technology partners Experience working with cloud partners (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and/or major systems integrators active in the German market (e.g., Accenture, Cognizant, Publicis Groupe, Valtech, Diconium) Business-side understanding of SaaS software, search/AI, headless commerce and API-first architectures A track record of developing and executing regional partner strategy, ideally with strength in the German market and familiarity with Austria and Switzerland Fluency in German (spoken and written) is required, given the primary focus on the German market; fluency in English is also required Salesforce.com experience creating and managing opportunities through the sales cycle, with high attention to data accuracy and quality Excellent communicator, writer and storyteller, with a strong ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders A history of developing and nurturing long-term industry and partner relationships A history of becoming a trusted advisor to partners, clients and internal stakeholders, including senior leadership A solutions-oriented mindset — genuinely creative and innovative, with the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy across a multi-country region A track record of driving joint co-selling and co-marketing activities Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, both internally and externally Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. The annual total cash compensation range (base salary and commission) for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work. On-Target Earnings Pay Range €139.500—€174.500 EUR FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY: Algolia ’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolia ns to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. title: Regional Sales Director (Northwest)

What you will do Recruit and hire a world class team of enterprise sellers, on time and on budget Clearly articulate, manage and enable enterprise sellers to hit all key productivity metrics and milestones of growth Instill a disciplined approach to pipeline generation leveraging all available resources including field sales, marketing, channel partners, and sales development to accelerate new business. Develop an overall account strategy for the region resulting in strong execution and collaborative team selling. Partner closely with Sales Engineering to deliver outstanding product demonstrations and a repeatable technology validation / proof-of-concept program. Build a strong partnership with existing customers that focuses on value realization and customer retention delivered through high renewal rates, rapid upsell expansion, and customer referrals. Effectively forecast monthly/ quarterly revenue to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and forecast methodology. Develop strategic relationships with existing channel partners and the development of new channel partners. Experience managing and closing deals of $200K+ as well high value transactions above $1m+ Experience establishing and fostering strong relationships with potential partners and customers at executive levels Strong presentation and communications skills, competent translating technical features into business value Familiarity and experience using consultative, value-based sales methodologies (Force Management, Challenger Sale, MEDDIC, etc.) Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills Comfortable working in a highly fast-paced environment Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. title: Content Collection for Advertising Rescue Dogs - Volunteer (Unpaid)
description: Updated/Reviewed 12.04.25 Foster Dog Content Collection Job Industry: Charity / Social Services / Non- Profit Organization Position Name: Foster Dog Content Collection for Dog Rescue - Volunteer (Unpaid) Job Location: Spokane, Washington, United States Job Type: Part Time Office Setting: Fully Remote Remote: Yes Compensation: Volunteer Hours Per Week: 5 (flexible) Role Mission The Foster Dog Content Collector is responsible for gathering up to date information and media on foster dogs for purposes of accurate records and advertisement. They are the link between our foster families, who are taking care of our rescued dogs and the teams who advertise them. We do not have a kennel or building, and rely 100% on online platforms to advertise our dogs; requiring high quality and up to date content/media to attract potential adopters. Role is remote and five hours per week on your schedule. What Winning Looks Like Key Results Area #1 - Raw Content Stays current on intakes and dogs in program Special attention to long term residents Point of contact between Foster Family and Dog Ad Pack Proactively gathers content on all available dogs weekly via Baserow forms Social Media Blink Key Results Area #2 - Media Organization Protects Baserow as source of authority Uploads photos, videos and copy to Google Drive Manages Master Dog Ads folders in Google Drive and keeps up to date Archives adopted dog content Needed Skills Systematic. Reaches out to each foster family on a routine and scheduled basis Organized. Keeps all media files organized within file and folder system Has a desktop computer or tablet (phone will be too difficult to navigate spreadsheets) Pleasantly persistent to those fosters who need extra motivation to complete forms Unique Company Culture and Mission Our Mission At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States. Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles. Our Vision. Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one dog destination in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokanes love of Rescue Dogs. Core Values: Transparency - sharing the good with the bad Community - dog loving people who treat each other well Integrity - doing what you say will do Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated Our Company Culture We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, freedom and God. No NGO status here, we dont take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87. We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. Were about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We dont do drama. There are no victims here and the system isnt out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We dont bend to the cultural rot out there. At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where its normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dogs birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time. We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isnt being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Finance Business Analyst
description: Job Overview: Serefin is seeking a motivated and analytical Finance Business Analyst to join its Finance team. Reporting to the Senior Finance Manager , this position is responsible for delivering accurate financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and business analysis to support strategic decision-making across multiple business entities. The successful candidate combines strong technical accounting knowledge with analytical thinking and business acumen. Working closely with operational leaders and cross-functional teams, the Finance Business Analyst will provide meaningful financial insights, identify opportunities for improvement, and support operational and strategic initiatives within a fast-paced and dynamic environment. This position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, excellent communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently and collaboratively. Key Responsibilities Financial Reporting & Analysis Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements for multiple Serefin entities, including consolidated financial reporting. Perform monthly account reconciliations, accruals, and general ledger analysis to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial information. Prepare monthly financial reporting packages, including detailed variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior year results. Analyze financial performance, identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to management. Prepare and maintain annual budgets, financial forecasts, and long-range planning activities. Prepare ad hoc financial analysis and reports to support business initiatives and strategic decision-making. Business Partnership Collaborate with operational leaders to understand business drivers and provide financial insights that support informed decision-making. Partner with cross-functional teams to improve financial processes, reporting, and internal controls. Assist in evaluating business performance through KPIs and financial metrics. Accounting & Compliance Prepare corporate income tax returns and supporting schedules for multiple legal entities. Support interim and annual external audits by preparing working papers and responding to auditor requests. Develop and maintain documentation of accounting procedures, internal controls, and process improvements to ensure compliance and operational efficiency. Ensure compliance with accounting standards, corporate policies, and regulatory requirements. Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to automate, streamline, and enhance financial reporting and analysis processes. Participate in finance transformation and system improvement initiatives. Support additional finance projects and responsibilities as assigned. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, or related discipline Accounting designation in progress (CPA), or an equivalent combination of related experience and education 3-5 years or relevant accounting, financial analysis and reporting experience Required experience working with complex ownership structure Independent preparation and filing of T2 corporate tax returns Required SRED experience Working knowledge of accounting systems NetSuite, Expensify and Payworks is an asset M&A experience International expansion experience an asset Self motivated and self-directed individual who enjoys working on a team Advanced Excel Skills; experience building complex templates and formulas Excellent verbal and written communication skills Impeccable analytical and organizational skills Ability to work closely with senior management team Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Engagement Manager - Germany

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab . Senior Professional Services, Engagement Manager - - Germany An overview of this role As a Senior Professional Services Engagement Manager focused on Germany, you will play a critical role in driving GitLab ’s growth in the region by structuring services engagements that create true partnership and shared success with our customers. You will lead efforts to design, position, and close outcome-oriented professional services engagements that translate complex DevSecOps and digital transformation initiatives into clear, measurable mission-critical outcomes. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Engagement Management, EMEA, you will work at the intersection of technical solutioning and customer requirements, aligning each engagement to their unique needs and objectives. In your first year, you will build trusted advisor relationships with technical leaders and partners to help integrate professional services into account strategies from early discovery through successful delivery. This is a unique opportunity to shape large-scale implementations that improve how customers plan, build, secure, and operate software using GitLab . Some examples of our projects Designing and structuring outcome-based professional services engagements that align GitLab capabilities to customers needs Partnering with account executives, solutions architects, and delivery leaders to turn complex DevSecOps transformations into clear, actionable implementation roadmaps and statements of work What you'll do Build trusted advisor relationships with division chiefs, program managers, and technical leaders Conduct discovery sessions with with prospects and Systems Integrators to understand current-state capabilities, requirements and desired business outcomes Design outcome-oriented services proposals that align GitLab capabilities with customer success metrics and objectives Structure engagements and commercial proposals to clear outcomes maintaining flexibility for staff augmentation and packaged offerings when needed Develop custom-scoped SOWs and staffing plans for complex implementations, engaging with technical architects and delivery leadership to ensure deliverability Articulate GitLab 's services value proposition, catalog offerings, and implementation methodologies in the context of customer requirements Gain agreement on scope and price while guiding customers through commercial terms, procurement processes, and contracting structures Manage project- and account-level escalations, ensuring rapid resolution and maintaining customer confidence Position consulting, training, success tiers, and additional solutions proactively to ensure successful outcomes and long-term customer retention Facilitate solutioning sessions including implementation roadmapping, enterprise strategy discussions, and executive-level requirements gathering Drive measurable outcomes by structuring services that support customer success metrics, accurately forecasting services bookings, and tracking key performance indicators related to bookings, margin, and attachment to strategic opportunities. Influence cross-functional teams by articulating GitLab ’s professional services value proposition in the context of federal requirements and compliance frameworks, and by feeding customer insights back into sales, delivery, and practice management. Partner with regional sales and engagement leadership to prioritize and manage services opportunities that support critical deals and strategic initiatives, providing clear recommendations on risk management, negotiation strategies, and commercial structures. Foster a culture of enablement and continuous improvement by training field teams on how to position and sell professional services by sharing trends, feedback, and suggestions that improve go-to-market content and operational processes. What you'll bring Demonstrated progressive experience structuring, scoping, and selling professional services engagements in the region Proven success operating in a pre-sales context, conducting discovery, designing outcome-oriented proposals, and developing custom statements of work (SOWs) and staffing plans for large, complex implementation projects. Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps practices, and cloud transformation initiatives, with the ability to connect technical solutions to mission objectives and measurable business outcomes. Effective communication and interpersonal skills with executive presence, able to build trusted advisor relationships with division chiefs, program managers, contracting stakeholders, and senior technical leaders. Highly developed facilitation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to guide customers through acquisition processes, commercial structures, and risk mitigation strategies. Comfort working cross-functionally with sales, solutions architecture, delivery, and operations teams to align on deal strategy, staffing, and successful execution in a fast-paced environment. Capacity to work autonomously and asynchronously in a fully remote setting, managing multiple complex opportunities while maintaining accurate forecasting and consistent alignment with GitLab values and goals. title: Web Development and CRM Manager
description: FILINVEST LAND, INC. The Web Development and CRM Manager orchestrates Filinvest's enterprise-wide lifecycle marketing, marketing automation, customer data management, and personalization strategy. This role ensures that CRM becomes a powerful engine for lead nurturing, lead-to-reservation conversion, customer onboarding, experience delivery, retention and reactivation, cross-sell and upsell, and lifetime value maximization The CRM Manager leads the design and execution of automated customer journeys, governs segmentation logic, maintains data integrity in partnership with Tech Platform and Customer Insights, and ensures a consistent, empathetic, and brand-aligned communication experience across the lifecycle. This role serves as a critical bridge between Digital, Brand & CX, Customer Insights, Operations, and Residential BUs — ensuring that CRM activities support business outcomes and reinforce a unified customer experience. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. CRM Strategy & Lifecycle Journey Orchestration Orchestrate Filinvest's CRM strategy across the entire customer lifecycle: Lead Inquiry Reservation Documentation Loan Processing Construction Turnover After-sales Renewal/Renegotiation Lead the development of automated journeys for lead nurturing, buyer onboarding, requirements completion, construction updates, turnover readiness, move-in support, after-sales support, delinquency reminders (in coordination with Operations), and ensure all journeys are customer-centric, brand-aligned, and optimized for conversion. 2. Audience Segmentation & Personalization Govern enterprise-level segmentation in partnership with Customer Insights. Build and maintain audience segments based on behavior, engagement level, funnel stage, persona, project category Ensure personalization across email, SMS, in-app or portal messaging, construction updates, buyer education content Maintain dynamic segments and eligibility rules for all automated journeys. 3. CRM Automation Design & Optimization Build automation flows such as welcome series, lead nurturing sequences, document submission reminders, construction phase triggers, turnover scheduling, move-in prompts, maintenance reminders Continuously optimize timing, frequency, message relevance, conversion triggers, content clarity Implement A/B testing for subject lines, content, CTA, and cadence. 4. Data Integrity, Tagging & Lead Management Govern the cleanliness and structure of CRM data. Ensure correct lead tagging and routing in alignment with sales, BUs, digital, tech platform Implement data hygiene routines for re-duplication, bounce management, unsubscribe management, record validation Maintain data dictionaries, segment logic documentation, and data governance standards. 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with the following business functions: 1) Digital & Performance Teams to ensure CRM journeys support paid campaigns, provide audience insights to improve targeting, and align UTM, tracking, and attribution flows. 2) Brand & CX Team to ensure CRM content is on-brand, clear and human, empathetic, segment-appropriate, CX-compliant 3) Customer Insights to validate segments, insights, and behavioral clustering and use NPS, CSAT, and qualitative insights to enhance CRM journeys. 4) Residential Business Units to ensure BU-level needs (project launches, updates, inventories) are supported via CRM. 5) Operations & Customer Care to maintain alignment for customer-facing notifications and service updates. 6. Reporting, Analytics & Optimization Track CRM KPIs: open rates, CTR, response rates, lead-to-reservation conversion, journey drop-off points, and engagement scores Maintain CRM dashboards with Customer Insights and Tech Platform. Produce monthly insights and recommendations for journey improvement across BUs. Present findings to the CMO and the Digital COE. 7. Governance, Standards & Compliance Establish enterprise CRM content standards: tone of voice, template formatting, brand/CX alignment, response scripts, opt-outs and compliance Maintain CRM playbooks and implementation guidelines. Ensure compliance with: data privacy laws (DPA), opt-in/opt-out rules, Corporate Communications protocols 8. Team Leadership & Vendor Management Lead CRM Specialists and support roles. Coach team in automation building, journey design, data hygiene, segment creation, amd reporting and optimization Oversee CRM platform vendors and Martech providers. Manage configurations, integrations, and enhancements with Tech Platform. ROLE QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, IT, Communications, Data Science, or related field. 5–8 years of CRM experience in: 1) Lifecycle marketing 2) Marketing automation 3) Segmentation 4) Behavior-driven communications 5) Customer journey management Experience with CRM platforms (MoEngage, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, etc.). Strong understanding of funnel conversion, segmentation, and lead nurturing principles. Experience collaborating cross-functionally at enterprise scale. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Customer Support Engineer (Tier 1)
description: About Tailscale Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital. About the Role If you’re passionate about solving technical issues and providing high-quality support to a diverse community of users, this is the role for you. We’re seeking a motivated Support Engineer (Tier 1) to join our growing team of support professionals. You will serve as the face of the company for a large portion of our community, handling a broad range of tickets that will help flex your technical muscles. As a Tier 1 engineer, you’ll be part of a distributed team focused on delivering excellent support and proactively solving friction by partnering with our broader CX team and Product/Eng. This role reports directly to the Tier 1 Support Team Lead and will play a key role in our journey. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary technical resource for less complex issues, resolving a wide range of configuration and networking challenges to keep them unblocked. Manage a high-velocity ticket queue with a consistent focus on meeting targets for time to first response and time to resolution. Drive positive user outcomes and maintain high CSAT scores by providing clear, helpful, and accurate technical guidance. Balance a high volume of daily ticket replies while maintaining the technical depth required to troubleshoot complex networking issues. Partner cross-functionally to identify recurring friction points and advocate for improvements to the user experience. What We Are Looking For Display a natural tinkerer’s mindset and a deep curiosity for how things work, likely demonstrated through personal projects, homelabs, or open-source contributions. Demonstrate a foundational understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, IP addressing, firewalls, and routing. Show proficiency in troubleshooting across multiple operating systems such as macOS, Windows, Linux, and mobile OS’s. Some familiarity with Jira and Slack to manage internal workflows and communicate effectively with the team and customers Exhibit excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts with empathy and clarity. Maintain a proactive approach to learning new technologies and staying current with evolving infra tools. As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale 's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set. UK Pay Range £49,770—£78,210 GBP Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic! What We Offer An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life. A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles). Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family! Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description. Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation. Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration. Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. Paid parental leave program . We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents). Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter. Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people. title: Full Stack Engineer, Experimentation
description: About the Job: LaunchDarkly is seeking a skilled Full-Stack Engineer to join our Experimentation team! You’ll collaborate closely with a cross-functional team of backend, frontend, and full-stack engineers, along with product managers, data scientists, and designers, to help build an experimentation platform that balances power and accessibility. In this role, you’ll contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of scalable, performant services using Go and RESTful APIs, and user experiences built with React and TypeScript. You’ll have opportunities to take ownership of projects, grow your technical expertise, and help improve the quality and reliability of our systems. We’re focused on building a best-in-class experimentation platform that enables customers to run impactful, data-driven experiments with ease and confidence, and we’re actively growing the team to deliver on this vision. We are committed to delivering a leading experimentation platform that empowers our customers to run tests and data-driven experiments seamlessly and at scale. We have a robust product roadmap, and we are actively expanding our teams to execute on it. Responsibilities: Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of scalable and performant solutions for experimentation and data-driven products, with attention to usability and maintainability. Collaborate with senior engineers on architectural decisions that impact system scalability and performance. Lead limited scope features from definition to deployment Help identify and troubleshoot performance issues and participate in efforts to optimize service reliability. Work closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to implement new features and iterate on existing functionality. Participate in code reviews to support code quality and share constructive feedback with teammates. Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that enhances the reusability and readability of team systems. Contribute to the team’s efforts to improve observability, monitoring, and operational excellence. Help investigate and resolve production issues, occasionally partnering with customer support or other teams as needed. Collaborate across functions to align on priorities, surface blockers, and improve team workflows. Learn from and support more senior engineers, and contribute to a culture of growth, inclusion, and continuous improvement. Stay current with industry trends related to software development, experimentation, and backend technologies. Demonstrate curiosity, creative thinking, and a proactive mindset in problem-solving. Qualifications: 5+ years of hands-on experience building full stack web applications. Familiarity with Typescript, React, Node, and Go is preferred but not required. Solid grasp of software engineering principles, design patterns, and coding best practices. Exposure to building or maintaining scalable, production-grade systems. Familiarity with observability practices and tools (e.g., logging, metrics, monitoring). Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is a plus. Strong collaboration and communication skills with a team-oriented mindset. Comfortable working in Agile development environments. Experience with CI/CD practices and tools. Passion for writing high-quality code and continuously improving engineering practices. A self-motivated approach and willingness to take initiative. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Prior experience working with or contributing to distributed teams is a plus. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. *Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas. **Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary. About LaunchDarkly : Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by: Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability At LaunchDarkly , we believe in the power of teams.
