title: Payroll Specialist - Canadian Payroll
description: Role Overview The Payroll Specialist partners directly with clients to support payroll processing and implementation using the platforms and systems we’ve helped implement. With strong Canadian payroll expertise, this role serves as a trusted resource to clients implementing and using ERP and HR/payroll solutions in Canada, helping them establish accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll processes. The ideal candidate combines hands-on Canadian payroll experience with HR/payroll systems implementation and strong communication, analytical, and client service skills. They understand Canadian federal and provincial requirements and can translate those requirements into system configuration, business processes, and practical client guidance. Key Responsibilities Partner directly with clients to understand Canadian payroll and HR business processes, requirements, and objectives. Support clients implementing and processing Canadian payroll within ERP and HR/payroll systems, providing guidance on system use, payroll regulations, and standard workflows. Apply knowledge of Canadian payroll requirements and provincial nuances to help clients establish compliant payroll processes and system configurations. Troubleshoot payroll and system issues, determine root causes, and escalate technical concerns as needed. Provide proactive support during critical payroll cycles, including payroll deadlines, year-end reporting, and regulatory changes. Conduct client trainings or refreshers on payroll tools, processes, Canadian payroll requirements, and system updates. Collaborate internally with implementation teams to ensure smooth handoff from implementation to ongoing client support. Stay current on Canadian payroll legislation, regulatory requirements, and technology platform enhancements to better serve client needs. Maintain detailed and accurate client documentation, call notes, configurations, and case updates. Minimum Requirements 3+ years of experience working with Canadian payroll, with a strong understanding of Canadian payroll processes, requirements, and compliance. Demonstrated knowledge of Canadian federal and provincial payroll requirements and the ability to apply those requirements within payroll or ERP systems. Experience working with payroll and/or HR systems in an implementation, consulting, systems, or client-facing capacity. Experience supporting or implementing payroll for Canadian organizations; experience working across multiple provinces is strongly preferred. Familiarity with payroll platforms such as Paymate, ADP Canada, or similar; experience with Canadian payroll systems such as Rippling, Payworks, and Dayforce is a strong plus. Proven ability to manage multiple projects or client implementations simultaneously while delivering high-quality results. Comfortable working directly with clients through video, phone, email, and other remote collaboration tools. Exceptional communication, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Willingness and ability to learn new technology platforms and obtain Intacct and Sage HCM certifications. Preferred Attributes Experience with Canadian payroll within an ERP implementation or consulting environment. Familiarity with Canadian payroll complexities, including provincial requirements, statutory deductions, taxable benefits, vacation pay, year-end requirements, and other jurisdiction-specific considerations. Payroll certification such as PCP, CPM, FPC, or CPP, or willingness to pursue relevant certification. Familiarity with Construction Payroll, including Union and Prevailing Wage. A natural collaborator and coach with a client-first mindset. Adaptable and resourceful in dynamic or complex client environments. Committed to continuous learning, regulatory awareness, and process improvement. Always Choose Exceptional | Lead with Integrity | Embody Respect and Care Deeply | Embrace Change and Innovation Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the US or Canada; we cannot provide sponsorship at this time. Salary: 55,000-70,000 USD Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Manager, Clinical Workflow Implementation - iQueue for Inpatient Flow
description: We are a growth stage company that creates software solutions combining lean principles, predictive and prescriptive analytics, and machine learning to transform hospital and infusion center operations. More than 190 health systems and over 1,200 hospitals and centers across 49 states rely on our award-winning products and expert change management services to increase patient access, decrease wait times, and reduce healthcare delivery costs. We have raised more than $300 million from top-tier investors such as Bain Capital, Insight Partners, and Goldman Sachs. We have been named among the top 100 AI companies in the world. Please note that while this role is listed as available for remote, we are currently employing in the following states: AK, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, MT, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV . If your state is not listed, we may not be able to proceed with your application. We have offices in Santa Clara, CA and Charlotte, NC for employees who prefer to work regularly or occasionally from an office. You will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of customers while leading a team responsible for helping hospitals successfully adopt LeanTaaS solutions to achieve meaningful operational outcomes. This is a hands-on leadership role where you will build and scale a growing Clinical Workflow Implementation team while remaining actively engaged in strategic customer implementations. As an early leader of this function, you'll work directly with customers to establish implementation best practices, refine delivery methodologies, and create scalable processes that improve efficiency and enable the team to deliver exceptional outcomes as it grows. Success in this role requires balancing customer delivery, people leadership, and operational excellence while serving as a trusted advisor to hospital executives and an experienced coach to your team. Over time, as the organization expands, you will transition more of your focus toward developing people, driving operational strategy, and scaling a high-performing implementation organization. If you are passionate about improving healthcare delivery, developing high-performing teams, and helping hospitals optimize patient flow, we would love to have you on board! WHAT YOU'LL DO Drive Implementation Success & Executive Engagement Lead a portfolio of strategic customer implementations from discovery through go-live, including operational workflow analysis, solution design, project leadership, and change management planning. Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors, governance teams, and clinical leaders, serving as a strategic advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle. Drive executive engagement by facilitating governance meetings, executive business reviews, and strategic discussions that align implementation progress with customer goals and operational outcomes. Provide executive oversight across the broader implementation portfolio by proactively identifying risks, developing mitigation strategies, and ensuring successful customer outcomes. title: Field GTM Manager, Events and Community
description: Quick highlights Your goal: Turn the best ecommerce events and communities into 10–15 qualified demos each month. Your field: Attend or host 3–4 focused events each month across North America. Your audience: Ecommerce founders, operators, Heads of CX and agency leaders. Your ownership: Choose the room, build the guest list, host the experience and turn conversations into pipeline. Location: North America. Remote, with frequent travel across the US and Canada. Reports to: Head of Partnerships. You will also work directly with Richpanel 's CEO and sales team. Company: Profitable, Sequoia-backed and growing 110% YoY at 8-figure ARR. Compensation: $130,000–$155,000 base, 20% target bonus, meaningful stock options and benefits. About Richpanel Richpanel is the AI-native helpdesk. Brands hire an AI support team that resolves repeat customer questions from start to finish. Their people stay in control of the moments that need judgment. Richpanel replaces the old helpdesk and the next few support hires. The AI handles order tracking, returns, subscription changes and the repeat work that buries CX teams. Human agents handle the exceptions in the same workspace. We are profitable, backed by Sequoia and growing 110% YoY at 8-figure ARR. We already serve 3,000+ paying brands. We have built this with a small team. Your work will be visible in our pipeline and company growth every month. About the role The best deals rarely begin at a booth. They begin at a private dinner, a founder retreat or a small room where the right operators speak honestly about what is not working. Your job is to put Richpanel in those rooms and turn the right conversations into qualified demos. You will find the events and communities where our buyers already gather. You will study attendee lists, invite target accounts, work with agency and technology partners, and host experiences people want to attend. You will also own the commercial result. This is not a brand-awareness or event-logistics role. Your scorecard is qualified demos, pipeline and closed ARR. What you will own Attend or host 3–4 focused events each month. Generate 10–15 qualified demos each month from the field. Build the annual calendar of dinners, roundtables, retreats and community events. Review attendee lists before we spend. Know which target accounts will be in the room. Pre-book conversations with high-value prospects before each event. Work with agencies, BPOs, technology partners and operator communities on joint events. Own the guest experience from invitation through follow-up. Host dinners, moderate discussions and make thoughtful introductions. Follow up quickly and turn interest into held demos with the right stakeholders. Keep event-sourced pipeline accurate in our CRM. Measure cost per qualified demo, pipeline and closed ARR by event. Build a repeatable playbook that tells us which rooms to return to and which ones to skip. What counts as a qualified demo A qualified demo is not a badge scan or a friendly chat. It means: The company fits Richpanel 's target customer profile. The buyer has a real customer-support problem worth solving. A decision-maker or strong internal champion joins the meeting. The buyer has agreed to evaluate Richpanel , not simply receive information. The demo is held and accepted by the sales team. Requirements You may be a fit if You have 3+ years in field GTM, events, community, business development, hospitality, brand marketing or a related customer-facing role. You come from an arts, humanities, communications, hospitality, theatre, design or event-production background and know how to create an experience people remember. You are a natural host. You notice who is standing alone, make introductions and help a room come alive. You are also commercial. You have owned a pipeline, meetings or revenue target before. You can show events that produced qualified sales conversations, not just attendance or social reach. You write warm, personal invitations that busy founders want to answer. You can speak with a founder, a Head of CX and an agency owner without sounding scripted. You are organized enough to manage travel, vendors, guest lists, budgets and follow-up without dropping details. You are comfortable travelling several times each month. You take ownership. If an event is not producing meetings, you change the plan. Strong signals You have worked at an ecommerce brand, agency, BPO, Shopify app or customer-experience company. You already know ecommerce founders, operators, agency leaders or community hosts. You have run private dinners, executive roundtables, retreats or small conferences. You have sold or generated pipeline for B2B SaaS. You have moderated a panel, hosted a podcast, performed on stage or built a community. You can show the exact path from an event to a held demo and closed deal. This role is not for you if You measure success through registrations, impressions, booth scans or LinkedIn posts. You enjoy planning events but do not want a sales target. • You wait for people to walk up to you. You prefer large vendor conferences over small, focused rooms. You need a detailed playbook before taking action. You dislike frequent travel or fast follow-up. What success looks like In your first 30 days Learn Richpanel 's product, customers and target buyer. Build a map of the communities, events and partners that reach our best prospects. Create a six-month field calendar with a clear reason for every event. Attend customer demos and learn how buyers describe their problems. Build the first target-account and guest lists. In your first 60 days Attend or host 3–4 focused events in a month. Generate your first 8–10 qualified demos. Run at least one Richpanel -led dinner or roundtable. Show clean event attribution and fast follow-up in the CRM. Identify the events and communities we should stop funding. In your first 90 days Consistently generate 10–15 qualified demos each month. Maintain a repeatable rhythm of 3–4 strong events per month. Create measurable pipeline from field programs. Build relationships with the partners and community leaders who can fill future rooms. Own a field playbook that another teammate could follow. Benefits Why join Richpanel Your work reaches revenue: You will see the demos, pipeline and customers created by the rooms you build. Real ownership: You will own the field calendar, event choices, guest strategy and budget recommendations. A product worth showing: Richpanel replaces both the old helpdesk and the next few support hires. A strong starting point: Referrals, partners, podcasts and events already create most of our best opportunities. Direct access: You will work closely with the CEO, partnerships and sales. A small team: Good ideas move quickly. There are few layers between a decision and the result. Long-term upside: You receive stock options in a profitable, 8-figure ARR company growing 110% YoY. Compensation Base salary: $130,000–$155,000 USD, based on experience and location. Target performance bonus: 20% of base salary. Target cash compensation: $156,000–$186,000 USD. Equity: Meaningful stock options with 4-year vesting. Benefits: Paid time off, learning support, company offsites and the tools you need to work remotely. Your bonus rewards held qualified demos and sourced pipeline. Closed ARR adds upside, but you are not penalized for sales work outside your control. How we work Customer obsession: Put the buyer's interests first. Never push someone into a meeting that is not useful. Curiosity: Learn how ecommerce operators work and why they buy. Drive: Own the number. Find a way through when the first plan fails. Taste: Create thoughtful experiences, not noisy events. Integrity: Report the real result, even when an event misses. Interview process We aim to finish the process within two weeks. 1. Past-results conversation: Walk us through an event or field program you owned. This role is a natural next step for security consultants with 3 – 4 years of IT security experience who want to specialize in Microsoft data security and compliance. You will grow through customer engagements, coaching from more senior colleagues and continuous learning, with a clear path towards a Purview Expert role. You will contribute to Microsoft Purview projects across the full delivery lifecycle. Your day-to-day tasks will typically include: Classification & Labelling: Configure and deploy sensitivity labels, sensitive information types and auto-labelling policies in Microsoft Purview, based on designs prepared with other consultants. Support pilot rollouts and iterate based on user feedback. Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Implement DLP policies across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and endpoints. Tune rules to balance protection with usability, analyse alerts and reduce false positives. Data Retention & Records Management: Build retention labels and policies that map to the customer’s legal, regulatory and contractual obligations. Assist in disposition reviews and lifecycle management scenarios. Insider Risk & Compliance Monitoring: Assist in configuring Insider Risk Management, Communication Compliance and audit / eDiscovery use cases, and help operational teams interpret the resulting signals. Integration with the Microsoft Security Stack: Configure the interactions between Purview and Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Entra, contributing to an end-to-end Defender XDR data protection story. Documentation & Handover: Produce clear design documents, configuration baselines, runbooks and knowledge transfer material so that customer teams can operate the solution after go-live. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with customer stakeholders (IT, Security, Legal, DPO, Compliance) as well as internal NVISO teams to gather requirements, validate designs and demo solutions. Support & Continuous Improvement: Provide second-line support on Purview deployments, be familiar8 with the Microsoft Purview roadmap and related technologies and continuously improve the delivery approach and reusable material. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states. 3 – 4 years of professional experience in IT security, including exposure to Microsoft 365. Azure or cloud security in general is considered a plus. Purview hands-on experience with at least one year working with Microsoft Purview capabilities: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, eDiscovery, Insider Risk and/or Data Governance; in a customer or enterprise environment. Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. Technical skills Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 platform (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams) and a good understanding of the Microsoft Entra identity model. Familiarity with the Microsoft Purview portal and its core solutions: Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, Data Lifecycle Management and Records Management. Understanding of how Purview integrates with Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Endpoint and the broader Defender XDR ecosystem. Basic scripting skills in PowerShell (Exchange Online, Security & Compliance) to automate deployment, reporting and troubleshooting tasks. Regulatory & Domain Knowledge Working knowledge of data protection regulations such as GDPR, and awareness of frameworks like NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001 and DORA and how they translate into data protection controls. Ability to translate legal and business requirements into concrete data classification, DLP and retention rules. Soft skills Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and to write clear documentation. Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written. A consulting mindset: curious, structured, customer-focused and comfortable working on several engagements in parallel. Benefits What do we offer At NVISO , we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components: A training budget of 10.000€ and 10 days every 2 years. Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO , our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc). An entrepreneurial and agile company, where you will be stimulated and supported in driving new initiatives (either through internal innovation or by improving our service offering), without losing sight of having fun! Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career! Flexible working model and home office possibilities (+working abroad options). Monthly Allowances; Statutory leave plus 5 additional leave days by NVISO . title: Global Technical Manager - Business Assurance, Certification
description: Minimum eligibility criteria: This is a senior global certification leadership role. Appointment requires demonstrable, current and substantial experience in management system certification at global or multi-region level, including leadership of geographically dispersed, culturally diverse technical teams and accountability for accreditation strategy, technical decision-making and network-wide implementation. The role reports to the Global Head of Certification (QHSE), Product & Quality Management for Business Assurance. Please note that this is a fully remote role, and we only welcome applications from candidates who have a valid work permit in their country of residence. Role purpose: The Global Technical Manager provides senior technical and accreditation leadership for the Business Assurance Certification business. The role sets, maintains and enforces the technical framework, accreditation strategy, certification policies and governance controls that determine consistent, compliant and commercially effective service delivery across the SGS affiliate network. The post-holder is expected to operate with the credibility, judgement and seniority required to influence senior business leaders, represent SGS with Accreditation Bodies and make final technical decisions where certification, accreditation, impartiality, integrity or business risk issues arise. Primary accountabilities: Set the global technical and accreditation strategy for Business Assurance Certification in consultation with the Global Head of Certification and relevant business leadership. Lead, develop and manage global technical and accreditation functions, including direct and indirect leadership of product, technical and accreditation specialists located across multiple countries and regions. Define, approve and enforce global certification policies, technical requirements, accreditation controls and operating standards across the affiliate network. Provide authoritative technical direction to the certification business, including final decision-making where disputes, interpretation issues or material compliance risks arise. Manage strategic relationships with global and local Accreditation Bodies, ensuring confidence in SGS integrity, competence, impartiality, governance and global operating model. Ensure technical and accreditation requirements are implemented in a way that protects compliance, supports consistent service delivery and enables commercially viable operations. Represent the Business Assurance Division externally, and act as delegate for the Global Head of Certification where required. Lead investigations and corrective action governance for material technical, accreditation or integrity failures within affiliates, ensuring effective restoration of compliant independent operation. Drive simplification, digitalisation and continuous improvement of technical processes, systems and delivery models, including future audit delivery approaches and technical review efficiencies. Specific responsibilities: Provide senior-level contribution to the strategic direction of the Business Assurance Certification business. Act as lead advisor to business management on certification, accreditation, impartiality, technical governance, integrity and business risk matters. Maintain expert knowledge of core accreditation and certification requirements, including ISO/IEC 17021-1, ISO/IEC 17065 where applicable, IAF, EA and other relevant regional or product-specific requirements. Interpret external accreditation requirements and convert them into clear, practical and enforceable internal policies, procedures, tools and controls. Oversee global accreditation activities and support affiliates in maintaining, extending or defending local accreditations. Directly or indirectly support key Accreditation Body relationships and activities, including UKAS, ANAB, SAS and other local or product-specific Accreditation Bodies as applicable. Resolve technical, accreditation, operational and commercial conflicts across the network, balancing compliance, impartiality and business impact. Work with operations, sales, IT, product groups and regional teams to define core systems and ensure adoption of global best practice. Identify improvement opportunities in procedures, systems, governance controls, competence frameworks and technical support processes. Support development of new certification products and services by ensuring technical feasibility, accreditation alignment and operational readiness. Maintain responsibility for technical direction and leadership of specific certification products or schemes as required. Required profile - essential: Graduate-level qualification or equivalent professional experience in a relevant technical, scientific, engineering, management system, commercial or governance discipline. Minimum 10 years of relevant certification and/or accreditation experience, including significant management system certification experience in an accredited third-party certification environment. Substantial global or multi-region certification leadership experience. Experience limited to a single country, single affiliate, consultancy-only environment or narrow technical discipline is not sufficient for this role. Proven experience leading geographically dispersed and culturally diverse technical teams, including direct or matrix management of senior specialists across multiple countries or regions. Demonstrable track record of setting or enforcing technical policy, accreditation strategy, certification governance controls or network-wide requirements at regional or global level. Strong technical command of management system certification and accreditation requirements, including impartiality, competence, audit delivery, certification decision-making and Accreditation Body expectations. Credibility to engage with senior business leaders, Accreditation Bodies and technical experts, and to make well-reasoned decisions under pressure where there is commercial, accreditation or integrity risk. Commercial judgement sufficient to ensure compliant service delivery remains efficient, scalable and aligned with business objectives. Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate complex technical requirements clearly to senior leaders and operational teams. Required skills and behaviours: Senior technical leadership and sound professional judgement. Strategic outlook with the ability to translate technical and accreditation requirements into practical business solutions. High-impact influencing skills across a matrix organisation, including the ability to challenge senior stakeholders constructively. Strong people leadership, coaching and performance management capability for senior technical professionals. Ability to manage conflict, competing priorities and ambiguity without compromising certification integrity or accreditation compliance. Change management capability, including leading adoption of new systems, procedures and working practices across a global network. Innovation mindset and ability to challenge established practice where simplification, digitalisation or risk reduction is possible. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level briefing, external representation and clear policy drafting. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and willingness to work with digital certification, workflow and reporting tools. Flexibility to travel internationally as required by Accreditation Body, leadership, governance or network support activities. Desirable experience: Senior role within SGS , another global Certification Body or an Accreditation Body. Lead auditor, technical reviewer, certification decision-maker, trainer or scheme manager experience in accredited third-party management system certification. Experience implementing significant change to certification systems, competence frameworks, technical review processes, audit delive

title: Head of International Alliances
description: Head of International Alliances The Company TurbineOne builds AI-powered software for frontline operators working in defense, national security, and tactical environments. Our Frontline Perception System (FPS) helps teams process and act on critical information in low-connectivity, real-world conditions. We’re a fast-moving DefenseTech startup building products that matter in mission-critical environments. Team: Growth Location: Europe / Remote Reports to: Chief Growth Officer The Role As Head of International Alliances, you will lead TurbineOne 's strategy for identifying, evaluating, building, onboarding, enabling, managing, and scaling strategic partnerships that accelerate growth across Europe and MENA. You'll be responsible for expanding our ecosystem across defense primes, technology companies, systems integrators, OEMs, and venture-backed DefenseTech innovators. This is a leadership role that directly supports revenue generation by improving market access, strengthening customer propositions, enabling joint pursuits, and helping TurbineOne 's sales organization create, advance, and win opportunities. To excel in this role, you should thrive on analyzing markets, decoding competitive dynamics, identifying mutually beneficial alliances, and turning those relationships into measurable commercial outcomes. You will work side-by-side with Sales and collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Government Relations, and Executive Leadership. Prior experience as a direct, quota-carrying salesperson is required so that you understand firsthand what sales teams need from a partner, how complex defense opportunities progress, and how partnerships should contribute to pipeline and revenue without competing with Sales for customer ownership. Primary Responsibilities Partnership Program Launch & Scale: Own the end-to-end development and execution of TurbineOne 's international partnership program, with primary responsibility for Europe and MENA. Target High-Value Alliances: Identify and secure technology, channel, integration, distribution, manufacturing, and strategic partners that improve customer access, market reach, technical differentiation, or probability of win. Develop the European and MENA Ecosystem: Forge deep, long-term relationships with European defense primes, systems integrators, OEMs, emerging DefenseTech companies, and relevant government and NATO innovation organizations. Team with Sales: Build partnerships around specific commercial objectives, target accounts, programs, and pursuits that help TurbineOne sales teams create qualified pipeline, gain customer access, and improve win probability. Build for the Future: Establish scalable partnership processes, systems, governance, playbooks, and operating models that can support future regional or sector-focused partner managers. Partnership Diligence Lead and coordinate commercial and strategic diligence for prospective European and MENA partnerships. Evaluate partner capabilities, reputation, technical fit, financial stability, genuine customer access, competitive positioning, incentives, and execution risk. Coordinate cross-functional technical, operational, legal, contracts, security, compliance, financial, and business reviews prior to partnership approval. Develop Go/No-Go recommendations and executive decision briefings that clearly articulate the expected strategic and commercial value of each partnership. Commercial Execution Structure and negotiate partnership frameworks including: NDAs Teaming Agreements Memorandums of Understanding Reseller Agreements Distribution Agreements Strategic Alliance Agreements Work with contracts, legal, and outside counsel (as appropriate) to document, review, and finalize agreements. Build repeatable partnership playbooks, onboarding processes, governance models, sales-facing rules of engagement, and success metrics tied to pipeline, customer access, and partner performance. Market Expansion Expand TurbineOne 's reach across priority European and MENA defense markets through strategic partnerships that complement the direct sales motion. Identify priority countries, defense programs, customer segments, and opportunities where a partner can materially accelerate access, contracting, integration, or adoption. Develop partner enablement strategies that empower partners to accurately position, support, and grow TurbineOne while preserving clear customer and opportunity ownership with the sales organization. Establish and progress joint go-to-market planning, co-selling, demonstrations, capture efforts, proposals, and marketing initiatives tied to specific customers, programs, and measurable commercial outcomes. In a Typical Week You Will Evaluate and Initiate Strategic Alliances: Meet with a prospective European or MENA prime, integrator, or OEM to assess whether the relationship can materially improve TurbineOne ’s access, positioning, or probability of success on priority opportunities. Execute Due Diligence: Validate market access, customer networks, reputation, competitive conflicts, incentives, and operational execution capabilities before recommending investment in a partner. Build Executive Recommendations: Synthesize diligence into structured Go/No-Go recommendations that define strategic rationale, commercial objectives, risks, and expected contribution to TurbineOne ’s growth. Negotiate Key Agreements: Review, structure, and negotiate NDAs, teaming agreements, reseller agreements, and other partnership frameworks that protect IP, customer relationships, and TurbineOne ’s long-term commercial interests. Align with Engineering: Partner cross-functionally with Engineering to evaluate integration feasibility with partner platforms. Build and Execute Joint Go-to-Market Plans: Work with Sales to develop partner-supported account, pursuit, co-selling, demonstration, and capture plans that accelerate qualified pipeline and improve win probability. Manage Ongoing Partner Relationships: Lead periodic business reviews with active partners to assess joint pipeline, account activity, enablement, performance, risks, and future milestones. Support Sales and Proposal Efforts: Work with Sales, Capture, and Proposal teams to coordinate partner participation in customer engagements and craft compelling multi-company proposals. Communicate with Executive Leadership: Review the prospective and active partnership portfolio, including partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, performance, risks, and strategic opportunities across Europe. Establish Best Practices: Create and curate partner competencies, playbooks, onboarding materials, enablement assets, and rules of engagement that make the partnership function easy for Sales to use. Desired Experience 10+ years in Strategic Partnerships, Business Development, Alliance Management, Sales, or related commercial leadership roles, with meaningful responsibility for international markets. Significant experience within the defense, national security, aerospace, or DefenseTech ecosystem; direct DefenseTech experience is strongly preferred over general enterprise technology experience. Prior experience as a direct, quota-carrying salesperson with personal responsibility for pipeline development, opportunity management, forecasting, and revenue attainment. Demonstrated understanding of how complex defense technology sales progress from initial customer engagement through evaluation, capture, procurement, negotiation, and award. Demonstrated success identifying, activating, building, and managing strategic partnerships that contribute to measurable pipeline, revenue, customer access, or program wins. Meaningful experience working across European defense markets (MENA a plus), including familiarity with defense primes, systems integrators, OEMs, national procurement environments, and industry teaming structures. Strong understanding of international business development, distribution models, channel partnership

title: Senior Support Engineer
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab . An overview of this role As a Support Engineer at GitLab , you'll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges while running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You'll join the Engineering department and work directly with customers as they encounter edge cases. You'll dig into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source. You'll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you'll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed GitLab and GitLab .com software as a service, and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team. Some examples of our projects: A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns A ChatOps feature that makes it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab .com What you’ll do Act as an escalation point for difficult customer interactions and lead the resolution of complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls. Mentor and guide teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions and cross-team collaboration. Advocate for and drive improvements to support practices, product quality, and reusable documentation and support content that directly influence team objectives. Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmaps, and priorities while driving fixes and new features. Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations during daytime hours, providing emergency support for self-managed GitLab and software as a service customers and coordinating incident communications with the GitLab .com Production team. Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team. What you’ll bring Experience owning complex, customer-facing technical cases from initial contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, resolution, and clear customer communication, including difficult or escalated interactions. Strong experience with Linux systems administration, scripting, Git, and continuous integration and continuous delivery in production or customer environments, with the ability to investigate issues at both the infrastructure and application levels. Ability to mentor teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions, case reviews, and cross-team collaboration. Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to turn customer feedback into product fixes, feature improvements, and roadmap priorities. Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless computing, and an understanding of how different GitLab implementations operate and affect customers. Demonstrated ability to learn, collaborate across teams, and apply transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles. About the team We're a globally distributed group of Support Engineers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. We work asynchronously and stay connected through pairing sessions, one-on-one meetings, coffee chats, and Slack. We structure our shifts to support our personal lives while meeting customer needs. Thanks to GitLab ’s transparency value, you can see what we are working on and how we operate on our Support Team page. How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. title: AI Transformation Owner, Product & Design
location: Remote - Canada, United Kingdom, United States
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab . An overview of this role As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab , you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them. Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it. You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure. What you'll do Strategy & Prioritization Own your function's AI strategy, aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time. Map how work flows across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before? Manage intake of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently. Prioritize strategically against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work. Adoption & Change Management Reimagine, not just automate. Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done. Drive adoption and change management together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick. Coordinate with Enterprise AI to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business. Build and bridge the Champion network in your function. Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly. From early in the role, identify and recruit Champions across sub-teams (5-10% time, formally agreed with their manager), run a regular Champion sync, host demos to the wider function, and act as their bridge to Enterprise AI. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped. Hands-On Building & Agent Operations Build AI agents using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering. Author and iterate on skills files that define how AI agents behave. Refine instructions based on real usage and share reusable skills across the function. Configure MCP servers and tools, giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely. Own your function's fleet of agents. Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn. Expect to rebuild. AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today. What you'll bring Business & Strategic Deep knowledge of your function's operations. You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. You can trace a process end-to-end and explain how it connects to the teams around it. Strategic prioritization skills. You've managed competing demands before and can make hard calls about what matters most. You think in terms of business outcomes, not activity. A product management mindset. You naturally think about intake, backlog, iteration, and adoption. You're comfortable defining success metrics and holding yourself accountable to them. Strong communication and influence. You'll be the person saying "not yet" to some teams and "think bigger" to others. You need the credibility and interpersonal skills to make both of those conversations land. Cross-functional instincts. You default to understanding how your org's processes affect and are affected by the teams around you - not just optimising in isolation. Experience building peer networks or communities of practice. You've recruited and sustained volunteer contributors before, whether as a guild lead, champion program owner, or community organizer. You know how to motivate people whose time you don't directly own. Hands-On & Technical Comfortable building with AI tools. You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to build a working agent, configure a skill, connect an MCP server, and troubleshoot when something isn't working. Think: power user, not software engineer. Ready to learn fast. Experience with or willingness to quickly pick up no-code/low-code AI platforms, prompt engineering, and agent configuration. You'll be trained on GitLab 's specific tooling, but you should arrive ready to get your hands dirty. Strong conceptual understanding of AI capabilities - summarization, classification, generation, automation, agentic workflows - and a commitment to staying current. The landscape shifts constantly. description: THE POSITION Insurance Call Center Representative QuoteWizard by LendingTree is currently looking to grow our Warm Transfer Verification program. At LendingTree , you’ll find an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives make us stronger. description: ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL — we're the tech-powered growth partner for ecommerce brands, running 12+ owned fulfillment centers across the US, Canada, the UK, and Europe so our merchants can stress less and grow more. The goal is lower cost, faster delivery, and a better customer experience, all at once. You'll get there through sharp network design, disciplined carrier negotiation, and a team you build and develop to run the details so you can stay focused on the strategy. Design the carrier network to lower cost and cut delivery time, and redesign it as volume, lanes, and rates change. Build and develop a high-performing team. Set clear priorities, raise their capability, and give them room to own the day-to-day. Drive cross-functional initiatives across Product, Revenue, and Operations to strengthen supply chain efficiency and the overall cost structure. Negotiate contracts with national and regional carriers, and agreements with LTL, ocean, and air freight carriers. Partner with Product to keep the VCN tool selecting the right carrier and optimizing for lowest cost and highest performance. Own carrier relationships and act as the final point of escalation for vendor issues. Audit carrier invoices and performance, and turn the findings into sharper strategy. Build the business analyses that surface opportunities to improve internal and external vendor processes. Apply zone skipping, pre-sorting, drop-off rates, delivery to regional sorting centers or DDUs, and similar techniques to keep lowering transportation cost. Work with Revenue and Operations to shape an optimized delivery offering for ShipMonk 's customers. What you'll bring A strategic thinker who can zoom out to a multi-year plan and zoom into a single surcharge line, then move between the two quickly. A proven people leader who has built, developed, and retained strong teams. Excellent communication and analytical skills. Direct experience with high-volume small parcel shipping across multiple carriers. A deep understanding of carrier invoicing, including surcharges and accessorials. Experience with regional carriers and multiple modes of transportation to reach the best rates. Experience with zone skipping and postal sharing programs. The ability to prioritize and lead multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. At least 3 years in a similar senior leadership position. At least 5 years in a similar environment. About ShipMonk ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL; we're a growth partner for merchants . With over 2,500 employees across five countries, we're on a mission to revolutionize fulfillment by providing everything from the fastest click-to-delivery and real-time inventory to custom solutions—all with a merchant - first mindset. Why ShipMonk ? We believe in building for the long term, and our success is powered by five key differentiators that help us become true partners to our merchants. We never outsource, ensuring quality and consistency. ● Proprietary Technology: We've eliminated the need for tribal knowledge with our AI-powered platform. It provides a real-time, unified view of inventory and orders, giving our merchants the control and visibility they need to succeed. ● Unrivaled Support: We provide hands-on, "mom and pop" support with a global reach. Our dedicated teams are on-site at every fulfillment center, ready to jump into action. ● Transparent Pricing : We believe in honest, long-term partnerships. Our all- inclusive pricing means predictable costs, with no hidden fees or surprises. ● Committed to the Future: We invest over $10 million annually in research and development to ensure our technology and services continually evolve, helping merchants plant roots with a partner who is here to stay. Our Core Values Our values are the heart of our culture. We're looking for individuals who embody these principles every day. Merchant-first: We handle the logistics so our merchants can focus on what they do best—growing their business. People make ShipMonk : We believe in our team and invest in our people. Own it: We take ownership of our work, our mistakes, and our successes. Get sh*t done: We're a fast-paced, high-growth company that values action and results. About the job As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in multi-modal reinforcement learning to advance next-generation intelligent systems. Your work will focus on optimizing decision-making and adaptive behavior across integrated data modalities such as text, images and audio to deliver enhanced intelligence, robust performance, and domain-specific capabilities for real-world challenges. You will develop and scale reinforcement learning techniques within complex multi-modal architectures, including diffusion-based generative models and autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, as well as resource-efficient models designed for constrained hardware environments. This includes conducting research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, spanning diffusion models for image autoregressive models for multimodal reasoning, and unified multimodal frameworks. You are expected to have deep expertise in designing multi-modal reinforcement learning systems and a strong background in advanced model architectures, with a hands-on, research-driven approach to building and deploying novel algorithms and training frameworks. You will design and develop RL infrastructure and reward modeling strategies to enable efficient large-scale training, improve training stability, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes. Your responsibilities also include curating multi-modal simulation environments and training datasets, improving baseline policy performance across modalities, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in multi-modal learning and reward optimization. In addition, you will explore next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more directly and effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of unlocking superior, domain-adapted AI performance in dynamic, real-world environments. Responsibilities Conduct research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified frameworks that integrate multiple modalities. Design and build reinforcement learning infrastructure that supports scalable, distributed training across multimodal systems while maintaining efficiency and reliability. Develop and refine reward modeling strategies that improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes. Create and curate multimodal simulation environments and datasets to support robust training, evaluation, and benchmarking of reinforcement learning systems. Design and conduct rigorous benchmarking and evaluation protocols to measure model performance, track progress against baselines, and validate improvements across multimodal tasks. Analyze and optimize policy performance across modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, and cross-modal alignment. Investigate and develop next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of achieving superior state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Publish research findings in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc. Requirements A Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field is required; a PhD in Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, or a closely related discipline is preferred, along with a strong track record of AI research and publications in top-tier conferences. Proven experience running large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online RL settings, with demonstrated impact on domain-specific decision-making and measurable improvements in policy performance. Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization methods applied to vision and multimodal learning problems, with a focus on improving policy stability, exploration, and sample efficiency in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities. Strong proficiency in PyTorch and deep learning frameworks for vision and multimodal AI, with hands-on experience building end-to-end RL pipelines covering simulation, training, evaluation, and deployment in production-grade systems. Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to solve core RL challenges in multimodal and vision tasks, such as sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation tradeoffs, and training instability, along with experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on algorithmic improvements to advance agent performance. title: Managing Director, Technology Officers Practice - Retained Search
description: About Modern Executive Solutions Modern Executive Solutions is a fully integrated talent management consultancy with a specific focus on developing diverse, modern leadership teams. We provide services that include talent and organization strategy, culture and change management, leadership assessment and development and executive search. Everything we do is forward-looking and focused on creating modern organizations, leadership team and leaders. We are headquartered out of Atlanta, Georgia but work on a remote-first basis with employees across the United States and a team also in the United Kingdom. As a part of our embedded purpose to change lives for the better we donate 10% of our annual profits to charities that support youth and education in order to develop the diverse talent of tomorrow. The Opportunity Modern Executive Solutions is seeking a high-impact Managing Director to lead the execution of retained executive search engagements with rigor, judgment, and credibility. This role is central to the success of each search, owning the day-to-day execution of the engagement and helping clients navigate to the right leadership decision through a thoughtful, consultative approach. Working under the guidance of a Senior Partner, the Managing Director is accountable for running a successful search process from kickoff through close. This person will shape the search strategy, lead and motivate the research team, build trust with the client’s hiring stakeholders, and ensure the engagement remains on track even when conditions become complex or challenging. The right person brings strong executive search execution skills, commercial judgment, and the emotional intelligence to know when to support, when to challenge, and when to elevate issues in a client’s process that may be limiting the outcome. Key Responsibilities Own the end-to-end execution of executive search engagements under the supervision of a Senior Partner. Translate client needs into a clear, practical, and differentiated search strategy. Lead the research team to develop target company lists, market maps, candidate pipelines, and search hypotheses. Drive momentum throughout the engagement, keeping workstreams moving with pace, discipline, and accountability. Build trusted relationships with the client hiring team through consistent communication, sound judgment, and credible counsel. Act as a consultative advisor to clients, helping them refine role specifications, assess talent, and navigate key decision points. Identify weaknesses, gaps, or inefficiencies in the client’s hiring process and challenge constructively when those issues may compromise the search outcome. Motivate and direct the research team through difficult stretches of a search, especially when progress is slow or market feedback is challenging. Synthesize market intelligence and candidate feedback into actionable insights for clients and internal stakeholders. Ensure a high-quality candidate experience and a professional, well-managed process from first outreach through completion. Partner closely with the Senior Partner, escalating client management challenges when appropriate while maintaining primary ownership of search execution. Maintain high standards of quality, professionalism, discretion, and follow-through across every stage of the engagement. What Success Looks Like Deliver search engagements with consistency, quality, and strong outcomes. Earn the confidence of clients by combining responsiveness with honest, well-grounded counsel. Build effective search strategies that are informed by market realities and aligned to the client’s business context. Lead research teams with resilience, focus, and urgency, particularly when searches become difficult. Recognize when client assumptions or process issues need to be challenged and do so with tact and credibility. Create alignment among internal and external stakeholders to keep the search moving toward the right hire. Ideal Profile Significant experience in retained executive search or a closely related advisory environment. Tu misión será reducir de forma medible el riesgo de las aplicaciones que procesan información y movimientos de nuestros clientes, sin perder de vista la velocidad de entrega. La IA será una parte central de tu trabajo. La usarás para ampliar la cobertura y la calidad de AppSec, y establecerás controles para que el software creado con asistentes, agentes, prototipos, scripts o prácticas de vibe coding siga un camino seguro, trazable y proporcional a su riesgo. Este es un rol hands-on: esperamos que construyas automatizaciones, revises código, tomes decisiones técnicas y trabajes de cerca con Producto e Ingeniería. Deberás: Ser el socio de seguridad de Producto y mantener una visión de sus aplicaciones, componentes, datos, dependencias, superficies de ataque y riesgos prioritarios. Incorporar seguridad desde el diseño mediante threat modeling, revisiones de arquitectura y escenarios de abuso para funcionalidades, APIs, flujos de pago y cambios de alto riesgo. Diseñar, implementar y operar capacidades de AppSec asistidas por IA para revisar cambios, priorizar hallazgos, generar pruebas y proponer correcciones con contexto del negocio. Evaluar de forma continua la precisión, cobertura, latencia, costo y seguridad de esas capacidades. Los hallazgos críticos y las decisiones de merge deberán conservar validación humana e independiente. Definir guardrails para asistentes y agentes de desarrollo, incluidos el uso de herramientas y modelos aprobados, el manejo de código y datos, la protección de secretos, el alcance de permisos, el aislamiento de ejecución y la trazabilidad de acciones. Extender el SDLC seguro al desarrollo formal e informal. Esto incluye vibe coding, prototipos, scripts, automatizaciones y herramientas internas, con rutas simples para registrar responsables, almacenar código, ejecutar controles y desplegar de forma segura. Integrar y ajustar controles como SAST, SCA, detección de secretos, seguridad de IaC y contenedores, DAST, pruebas de APIs y análisis manual. Aplicarás gates según riesgo para entregar señal útil sin convertir Seguridad en un cuello de botella. Realizar revisiones de código y evaluaciones de seguridad sobre autenticación, autorización, lógica de negocio, integridad transaccional, manejo de datos, integraciones y configuraciones cloud. Fortalecer la cadena de suministro de software mediante inventario de componentes, control de dependencias, versiones, procedencia, artefactos y correcciones que eliminen clases completas de vulnerabilidades. Definir y mantener estándares y patrones seguros basados en referentes como OWASP ASVS, OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security, OWASP GenAI, NIST SSDF y PCI DSS, adaptados al contexto de Bold . Job Description : Summary - The Asset Management Analyst position is designed to execute enhanced asset management processes that pertain to our fleet management and revenue monitoring activities. Primarily, this individual will provide support for the asset team through data and analytics. The primary goal of the Asset Management Analyst is to provide enhanced asset analysis to providea bettercustomer experience and to support growth initiatives and increase sales. This position will alsobe responsible forthe execution of projects within Asset Management that are key to orchestrating execution plans andensureaccountability through cross-functional ownership. This position will also promote Asset Management fundamentals and principles within the FMS and Dedicated Organization. Essential Functions Responsible for Fleet Management. Works on Redeployment of Assets within Asset team to prevent units from becoming NLE (No Longer Earning) Works cross functionally with other teams to achieveaccuratetracking and reporting of our assets. Create exception reporting to support Asset Management initiatives. Drive special projects as a lead analyst based on Asset Management needs Additional Responsibilities Sales and Marketing: Track redeployment of vehicles from reserving to in service of unit to the Customer with coordination with the local AM with reporting and AM centered programs (AMP) DTS Support: Coordinate andassistwith key initiatives under the DTS product offering as needed. Asset Management: Fulfill asset requests, Manage Rent to Lease (R2L), Manage Surplus Vehicle Notice (SVN), Vehicle Change Notice (VCN) Monitor Account I/S & O/S to control NYE and NLE s. Attend calls weekly to prevent billing errors on end bills and start bills. Financial: Review and conduct analysis of Fleet,Lessthan term, FlexLease ,Short Term Lease, Fast Track,Vosawhile ensuring proper depreciation to salvage during the life of the asset working in tandem with local AM’s Creative Solutioning: providing insight and navigating a plan of action to achieve AM goals. Performs other duties as assigned. Works with Artificial Intelligence (AI) Skills and Abilities High Proficiency in Microsoft Excel MSAccess,SQL, and or Snowflake experience is a plus Power BI experience is a plus High Energy, Self-motivated, self-directed person with the ability to focus on multiple projects and activities simultaneously and able to thrive in afast pacedenvironment Demonstrated ability to Lead, motivate,trainand develop othersin order tounderstand the business model as it pertains to Asset Management Ability to influence Asset Management and Sales Leadership as well as peers Strong oral and written communication skills having desired impact and effect to drive results Strong presentation and analytical skills focused on managing assets, Strong Customer focus Ability to create andmaintainprofessional relationships within (all levels of the organization, peers, work groups, customers, supervisors) Ability to work independently and as member of a Team Flexibility tooperateand self-driven to excel in afast pacedenvironment Capable of multi-tasking, highly organized, with excellent time management skills Ability to deal with ambiguity Creative Solutioning Detail oriented with excellent follow up practices Qualifications Bachelor's degreerequiredin Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Accounting Three (3) years or more in Rental, Operations,Salesor industry related experiencerequired DOT Regulated - No Job Category Asset Management Our Culture & Commitment : At Ryder, you’re trusted to make an impact—while enjoying room to grow and having a voice that’s heard.
