title: Head of Cloud Platform Engineering
description: Job Description: About Us Flui Technologies is a leading software solution provider to the energy and water sector, delivering innovative and scalable software infrastructure and services since 1990. Our solutions - MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter - support market competition, smart metering, network flexibility and supplier integration across Energy Retail, Energy Networks and Water Retail, and are used to manage messaging for more than 35 million electricity and gas meter points, with millions of records processed per day. As the utility sector evolves to meet the challenges of Net Zero, Smart Metering, Energy Code reform, Market-wide Half-Hourly Settlement, Demand-side Response and Embedded Generation, we combine deep industry knowledge with technical innovation to deliver robust, business-focused solutions backed by dedicated people and exceptional support. We are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, reflecting our commitment to protecting data and managing risk. The Role The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering owns the operations and component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate - the infrastructure that underpins software processing critical market and metering data at national scale. This is a hands-on role: you will design, build and run cloud-native platforms combining AWS-native services with open-source components, and carry end-to-end accountability for how that estate performs, costs, and stands up to scrutiny. Beyond architecture and operations, you will own FinOps and security for the cloud estate, and act as the accountable owner for its overall fitness for purpose - resilience, performance and scalability - as Flui's platforms scale to support a growing and increasingly complex utility market. You will work closely with the engineering leadership to ensure architecture decisions serve both the product roadmap and the operational realities of running critical infrastructure. The role suits someone who wants to remain genuinely hands-on with design and build, while holding single-point accountability for how well the cloud estate is run, secured and paid for. Job Responsibilities The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering will report to the Technology Director and will be responsible for: Owning the component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate, spanning AWS-native services and open-source/self-managed components (e.g. container orchestration, messaging, data stores, observability tooling). Operating and continuously improving the platforms underpinning MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter, with direct accountability for their resilience, performance and scalability at national-scale transaction volumes. Designing and maintaining disaster recovery, high-availability and capacity plans appropriate to platforms supporting critical utility market infrastructure. Owning FinOps for the cloud estate: cost visibility, forecasting, tagging and allocation, and driving measurable, ongoing cost optimisation without compromising reliability. Owning cloud security posture: identity and access management, network security, encryption, vulnerability and patch management, and ensuring the estate operates in line with Flui's ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS and wider compliance obligations. Defining and maintaining the non-functional standards ('fitness for purpose') that platforms must meet - resilience, performance, scalability and observability - and holding engineering teams to them through architecture review and guardrails. Remaining hands-on: designing, building and, where appropriate, personally implementing infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines and platform tooling alongside the wider engineering team. Owning operational rigor for the estate - incident management, on-call practice, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement of SRE practices. Making and owning build-vs-buy and AWS-native-vs-open-source decisions, balancing cost, control, operability and vendor lock-in. Managing key vendor and technical relationships, including AWS itself and providers of critical open-source or commercial platform tooling. Partnering with the product/engineering leadership to ensure cloud architecture decisions support the product roadmap and time-to-market, and recruiting/developing a small, high-calibre platform engineering team as the estate grows. Championing knowledge sharing and technical education across engineering - documenting architecture decisions and standards, running internal sessions on cloud and platform practice, and mentoring engineers and technical colleagues to raise the wider team's capability. Essential Competencies and Experience Business Acumen Demonstrable experience owning cloud platforms supporting a regulated, high-availability or critical-infrastructure business. Ability to balance technical excellence with commercial and operational reality - cost, risk, and delivery pace. Understanding of the utility/energy sector's data and resilience expectations is an advantage. Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, storage, networking, data and security services, ideally evidenced by current AWS certification(s). Proven experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms that combine AWS-native services with open-source components (e.g. Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka or equivalent messaging, Prometheus/Grafana or equivalent observability). Track record of owning a FinOps practice and delivering demonstrable, sustained cloud cost savings. Strong cloud security background - IAM, encryption, vulnerability management - and familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001. Experience defining and meeting non-functional requirements: high availability, disaster recovery, performance/load testing and scalability at production scale. General Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK) and mature CI/CD practice. Comfortable operating hands-on day to day while also owning strategy, standards and team development. A track record of sharing knowledge and raising technical capability across a team or wider engineering community - through documentation, mentoring, or internal training. Willingness to participate in on-call/incident response as needed for platforms supporting critical services. Job Qualifications A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is a bonus, or equivalent hands-on experience. Current AWS certification(s) - e.g. Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional or Security Specialty - highly desirable. Your Personal Characteristics Will Include A pragmatic engineer-leader: hands-on by instinct, comfortable balancing strategic ownership with keyboard time. Security and cost-conscious by default, without losing sight of reliability and delivery speed. Calm and structured under pressure, with a methodical approach to incident response. Curious and current - actively tracks the evolving cloud and open-source ecosystem. Advocates simplicity and resists unnecessary complexity or over-engineering. A clear communicator, able to translate technical trade-offs into business terms for the leadership team. A natural teacher and mentor, who enjoys raising the technical capability of colleagues and peers, not just delivering the work themselves. This resource will work closely with functional teams, technical teams, business stakeholders, and customer representatives to ensure hazardous material requirements are accurately represented within SAP and integrated across applicable logistics and supply chain processes. Develop functional specifications, process flows, configuration documentation, business requirements, and system design documentation. Participate in system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), regression testing, and defect resolution. Develop test scenarios and validate end-to-end HAZMAT processes across integrated SAP modules. Troubleshoot functional issues and coordinate with technical development, integration, security, and infrastructure teams to resolve system defects. Support compliance with applicable federal, DoD, transportation, environmental, and hazardous material regulations and policies. Assist with development of standard operating procedures, training materials, job aids, and end-user documentation. Participate in workshops, design sessions, demonstrations, and customer working groups to support implementation and continuous improvement activities. Required Qualifications Experience supporting SAP functional implementations, sustainment, or modernization efforts. Functional knowledge of hazardous materials, Dangerous Goods, regulated materials, or environmental health and safety processes within SAP. Experience with SAP S/4HANA and/or related SAP logistics capabilities. Understanding of material master data and its relationship to logistics, warehousing, transportation, and supply chain processes. Experience gathering business requirements and translating requirements into SAP functional designs and system configurations. Experience supporting functional testing, defect management, and system implementation activities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex cross-functional SAP processes. Ability to collaborate effectively with functional, technical, business, and customer stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to develop clear functional and technical documentation. 10% Travel every 12 weeks to Scott Air Force Base. Knowledge of hazardous material classification, labeling, packaging, storage, shipping, and transportation requirements. title: Support Raising Coach
description: About Protect Life Michigan Thousands of lives are on the line every day due to abortion. Are you ready to stand up and change hearts to stop it? We are defenders on a mission to recruit, equip, and deploy students around Michigan to become passionate and professional social reformers. We won’t stop until abortion is unthinkable. Since 2005, we have grown from a group of volunteers to a team of dozens of powerhouse activists. Each team member is bright, strategic, and dedicated to protecting the unborn. Anyone in ministry knows that support raising is critical to both equipping missionaries for the work God has called them to, and mobilizing God’s people to take part in what God is doing by generously supporting it. Protect Life Michigan ’s Support Raising Coach will help staff understand this core truth so they can be vision-driven, spiritually healthy, and fully funded. This role requires a high degree of emotional intelligence and the ability to lead others in a clear, encouraging, and practical way. This role works closely with the Support Raising Specialist to assess overall staff support-raising progress, identify new hires who need a higher level of support, and provide the necessary support each week. This position requires an individual to be fully committed to Support Raising and in agreement with Protect Life Michigan ’s strategy for mission partner development. Location: Remote in Michigan, with occasional in-person activities. Time commitment: This is a part-time to full-time position, with options ranging from 10-40 hours per week depending on the candidate’s availability. Duties & Responsibilities: New hires: Before support raising begins, hold check-in meetings with new hires to review their prep work, answer questions, explain their weekly goals, and provide presentation feedback. Ideally, meet with new hires in-person. During initial support raising, evaluate weekly progress reports to assess staff health, questions, barriers, coaching opportunities, etc. to prepare for one-on-one coaching sessions. Provide one-on-one coaching to staff via weekly check-in meetings. From their reports, review their progress, provide feedback including spiritual encouragement, practical advice, and radically-candid accountability. Together, determine clear expectations for success moving forward. Assist in hosting internal Support Raising Bootcamps. Assist in overseeing weekly phone call blocks. Regularly report staff progress and any issues to the Support Raising Specialist. Participate in Monthly Recap Meetings with the Support Raising Specialist: to review candidate training needs and set new goals, provide updates on staff progress through support raising, receive ongoing coaching training and feedback, and adjust support raising plans for staff as needed. Participate in Quarterly Progress Reviews with the Support Raising Specialist: to evaluate overall progress, adjust strategies, plan for the next quarter, synthesize data, observe and communicate patterns, for the purpose of improving coaching and support raising outcomes. Veteran Staff: Provide one-on-one coaching to current employees who are entering a new season of support raising, including meeting with them to create their strategy, assessing any specific challenges you can help them overcome, and training them on renewals, increases, and referrals as needed Foster a positive support raising culture through language, behavior, learning opportunities, mission moments, and more Interns During the months of January to June of each year, assist with the training and coaching of summer interns. This may include hosting group coaching cohorts, and providing additional support to individuals as needed. Assist with other projects and tasks, as needed Qualifications: Commitment to the pro-life movement and the mission of Protect Life Michigan . Support-raising experience required. Excellent coaching skills, ability to encourage others while providing relevant, practical advice, and confidence in solving problems on a case-by-case basis. Google Workspace experience required. High degree of emotional intelligence with an ability to show support, celebrate wins, and hold people accountable to goals and outcomes Ability to understand data and manage multiple projects independently Salary/Benefits Salary and benefits are determined by the needs of the individual, commensurate with education and experience. Benefits include: After completing 1 year of work, eligibility for employer-matched Simple IRA. Ample professional development opportunities. Protect Life Michigan is a support-raising organization. The salary and all expenses associated with this position will be fundraised by the candidate . Protect Life Michigan will provide training and coaching in order to help the candidate reach full support and will pay the candidate while they raise support. We have an excellent track record of helping job candidates reach full support: 85% of our candidates have reached full support within 2-3 months. You will complete support raising prep work over the first 1-3 weeks, then you will attend a support raising bootcamp around week 4 of your employment with PLM. Subsequently, you will spend the next 6-13 weeks support raising before beginning your job duties. All applicants must be supportive of this approach and open to engaging in it. Ample paid vacation time, holidays, and sick days. Semi-flexible schedule to be set with the employee and supervisor Ability to work from home. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Data Analyst
description: Why Phase2 Phase2 is a remote-first agency focused on digital modernization, emerging innovation, and purpose-built AI products and frameworks. Through solutions that demand both deep expertise and advanced AI capabilities, we help organizations leap ahead with automatic, fast, safe, and scalable solutions that have never been possible before. Phase2 is looking for a Senior Data Analyst who can help our clients move from data collection to decision‑making — and increasingly, from manual analysis to AI‑augmented insight. This role blends client‑facing strategic thinking with hands‑on technical execution. You’ll work across marketing, product, UX, and engineering teams to design measurement strategies, interpret complex data sets, and surface insights that inform both near term optimization and long term transformation. As Phase2 evolves in AI‑native and productized services, this role will help define how analytics, automation, and machine‑assisted insight generation become embedded in our practice. Design and implement analytics measurement frameworks aligned to client business, marketing, and product strategies. Advise on and support event‑driven analytics, data layers, and tagging strategies across web, mobile, CRM, and marketing platforms. Design and build dashboards, reports, and self‑service views using BI and visualization tools. Troubleshoot data integrity, tracking, and pipeline issues across platforms and vendors. Document implementations and lead enablement sessions to establish analytics best practices. Strategic & Client Advisory Lead stakeholder conversations to deeply understand business goals and translate them into measurement and insight requirements. Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to inform strategic recommendations across UX, content, marketing, and product. Develop testable hypotheses related to acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention, and experience quality. Recommend experimentation strategies (A/B testing, personalization, SEO testing, CRO) tied to defined KPIs. Connect insights across multiple data sources to tell a coherent, actionable story. Contribute to sales and marketing efforts through thought leadership, presentations, webinars, and proposals. Act as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal teams. Minimum Qualifications 6+ years of experience in digital analytics, marketing analytics, or data analysis in an agency or consulting environment. Deep expertise with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, along with broader experience with enterprise analytics and tag management platforms including Google Marketing Platform, Tealium iQ, Adobe Launch, or equivalent. Strong understanding of end‑to‑end digital measurement across websites, mobile, CRM, email, and marketing platforms. Experience with AI‑assisted analytics, machine learning‑supported insights, or automated reporting workflows. Experience collaborating with web and app development teams to configure, test, and validate analytics implementations across development, staging, and production environments. Strong, hands-on experience working with raw data, including writing complex SQL queries, building or supporting data pipelines (e.g., Fivetran, Stitch, dbt), and querying data warehouses and cloud platforms such as GCP, BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks to power analysis beyond dashboards. Proven experience designing conversion tracking, funnels, goals, and event‑based measurement models. Experience building dashboards and reports using tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, or Datorama. Strong CRO and experimentation background, including interpreting test results and making recommendations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate data into clear narratives. Ability to manage multiple projects independently with attention to detail and accuracy. Preferred Qualifications Experience with event‑driven or product analytics tools such as Adobe Analytics, Mixpanel, Heap, or Amplitude. Experience implementing data sanitization and masking solutions within CDPs (e.g., Freshpaint, Ours Privacy) to ensure HIPAA-compliant data collection and downstream activation. Working knowledge of additional programming and scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, M (Power Query), or R to support data analysis, automation, and implementation. Knowledge of personalization platforms (Adobe Target, Optimizely, Acquia Personalization). Experience with consent management platforms such as OneTrust, Osano, or Termly. Relevant analytics or data platform certifications (e.g., GAIQ, DAA, BigQuery, Power BI, Microsoft Power BI, cloud data platforms, or equivalent). Experience planning and implementing HIPAA compliant data systems. What You’ll Get The chance to make a real impact, helping millions of people per year. To work from wherever you thrive best. The role is responsible for proactive risk identification, incident response, and continuous improvement of safety performance. title: Engagement Coordinator
description: Job Title: Engagement CoordinatorJob Category: CommunicationsTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * * The Opportunity: CACI is seeking an Engagement Coordinator to support our team with developing and implementing communications and change management content for our U.S. Navy customers. You will work directly with external customers and internal staff to develop compelling messaging and products to illustrate customer successes, communicate complex ideas in concise and organized formats, and coordinate communication strategies that develop the customer’s brand identity. Key components of the Engagement Coordinator’s approach include: Strategic Analysis: Ensure communication tactics are grounded in thorough strategic analysis. Stakeholder Identification: Identify key stakeholders and understand their impact on the achievement of organizational goals. Message Alignment: Ensure products and stakeholder communications convey consistent messaging, both internally and externally. Priority Alignment: Link day-to-day activities with NAVSEA and Naval Shipyard priorities. Strategic Impact: Maximize strategic effects through associated communication processes. Work site is primarily at the employee’s home site. Occasionally the employee may need to work at the customer site or a CACI office.For the most effective support of our customers, the ability to work an Eastern Standard Time work schedule is strongly preferred. Note: This position is contingent and will only be filled upon funding approval. Responsibilities: Interact daily with individuals, groups, and teams of mid- to senior-level NAVSEA and Shipyard leaders. Meet with senior stakeholders to assess needs, establish goals, and create/implement communication strategies. Refine high-level leadership discussions, complex technical information, ideas, and meeting minutes into themes and storylines that personnel at all levels can easily understand. Craft clear, consistent, and easily understandable content (language, formatting, and design) that helps shape the customer’s brand identity and message. Participate in team meetings to develop organizational strategies, communication processes and pipelines, and content development. Create products and distribute internal and external communication materials, e.g., articles, SharePoint posts, emails, graphics, and internal newsletters that highlight the successes of process improvement and innovation initiatives. Maintain communication databases. Ensure contact lists, media lists, and other communication databases are up to date. Update SharePoint content and manage analytics as needed. Work with stakeholders to establish, track, and report metrics related to the customer’s goals and objectives. Provide oral and written reports, talking points, and executive-level summaries of complex technical ideas, processes, and projects. Interact with the customer via the telephone, video conferencing, email, chat, and in person as necessary. Support the execution of contract requirements, which may include submission of supporting data and metrics and timely completion of written reports to stakeholders, customers, and CACI leadership. Other duties may be assigned in support of contract taskings and mission success. Qualifications: Required: Must be a United States Citizen. Must have hold and active DOD Secret security clearance. Bachelor’s degree. In lieu of the degree requirement, candidates with minimum 6 years of directly applicable work experience may be considered for this position. Minimum 4 years of work experience in strategic communication, project management, facilitation, organizational development, change management, or process and performance improvement. Adept at creating compelling visual imagery and editing text to produce high-quality multimedia content using various tools and techniques to enhance the aesthetic and communicative value of digital content. Willingness and ability to experiment and invent new approaches to provide the highest caliber service to our customers. Strong interpersonal skills and customer service orientation; ability to respectfully communicate with customers at all levels of the organization in a professional, effective manner that achieves successful outcomes. Ability to perform successfully independently and as a team member in a demanding work environment. Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint). Outstanding organizational skills to efficiently manage competing priorities, multiple concurrent taskings, and firm deadlines. Desired: Certification and/or experience in some or all of the following: - Process and/or performance improvement. - Change management. - Facilitation and/or training of leaders. Work experience with the Naval Maintenance Community, United States Navy, or the Department of Defense. This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI. CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. title: Mental Health Therapist - Kentucky
description: About NOCD NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment. At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts. description: Role Summary - We are expanding our sales organization and adding our next SDR to support a 50/50 inbound & outbound motion. We are hiring a high-velocity SDR to execute both inbound qualification and outbound pipeline generation. This role is responsible for creating Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs) through fast qualification, disciplined follow-up, and consistent outbound activity. This is not a passive lead-routing role; you will be expected to create pipeline every day, not wait for it. Success requires strong process discipline, high activity volume, and the ability to run a tight qualification call (5–8 minutes) before handing off to an AE. This role is designed for someone who moves with urgency, thrives on activity, and knows how to generate high-quality pipeline. title: Senior Platform Software Engineer - Platform Architect
description: NVIDIA is building a new wave of accelerated computing systems, where platform manageability, secure firmware, and high-performance networking must work as one coherent architecture. We are looking for an engineer to help define and implement OpenBMC-based management for systems that include host CPUs, BMCs, and coordinated top-of-rack Ethernet switching functionality. This role focuses on extending the BMC from a traditional server management controller into a secure management authority for both system management and Ethernet switch management, while preserving clear separation between the BMC management plane and the switch data plane. Are you ready to help develop the next generation of OpenBMC networking architecture? Join us at the forefront of platform firmware, system management, and enterprise network infrastructure. What you'll be doing: Architect and implement OpenBMC support for platforms where the BMC handles host system functions and a coordinated ToR Ethernet switch subsystem. Define the end-to-end switch-management architecture across OpenBMC D-Bus services, bmcweb/Redfish APIs, persistent configuration, eventing, telemetry, security, and backend switch control interfaces. Develop OpenBMC object models and services for switch inventory, switch ASICs, front-panel ports, internal ports, PHYs, optics, retimers, VLANs, LAGs, FDB entries, counters, sensors, and health state. Implement L2 networking capabilities including port admin control, speed and FEC configuration, auto-negotiation, breakout, VLAN creation and membership, access/trunk mode, MAC learning, FDB management, flooding controls, link aggregation, and loop-prevention features. Build backend abstraction layers that can integrate with Linux switchdev/netlink, SAI/SONiC/SWSS-style components, DENT-style Linux networking components, or vendor switch ASIC SDKs. Work closely with hardware, ASIC, security, firmware, QA, manufacturing, and cloud infrastructure networking teams to influence board architecture, schematics, manageability interfaces, and production test strategy. Write and review design specifications, API documentation, code, unit tests, hardware-in-loop tests, integration tests, and QA plans required to productize the architecture. What we need to see: Bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or a related field with 12+ years of relevant experience. Strong OpenBMC firmware development experience on x86 or ARM-based server environments, such as Yocto, systemd, D-Bus, phosphor services, bmcweb, Redfish, firmware update, device monitoring, and platform security. Hands-on experience with Ethernet switch architecture and L2 features such as VLANs, trunks, access ports, LAG/LACP, STP/RSTP, LLDP, FDB/MAC learning, storm control, ACLs, QoS, PHY management, and transceiver diagnostics. System management software experience with rack or blade server platforms, including IPMI, KCS, Redfish, PLDM, MCTP, SPDM, secure firmware update, attestation, and BMC-host communication. Strong programming and debugging skills in C/C++ and Python, with familiarity in Bash, Go, or Rust; ability to develop reliable Linux user-space services and review low-level system code. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong ownership, high engineering judgment, and a passion for solving hard multi-functional problems. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Contributions to OpenBMC, Linux networking, switchdev, SONiC, SAI, DENT, FRR, LLDP, OCP, DMTF, Redfish, or other open-source platform-management and networking projects! Experience building a switch network operating system, BMC-managed switch subsystem, or converged server/switch management architecture for hyperscale or enterprise platforms. Expected impact: Deliver a reusable OpenBMC switch-management architecture that supports multiple switch backend implementations without tying the platform model to one ASIC vendor. Enable a unified management experience for host platform health, BMC management, and ToR switch network health through coherent inventory, configuration, telemetry, and lifecycle workflows. Improve platform reliability by providing safe defaults, validated configuration persistence, rollback, diagnostics, and strong separation between management and data-plane traffic. NVIDIA is broadly recognized as a leading employer within the technology world. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people working with us. If you are creative, autonomous, and excited to build the boundary between platform firmware and data-center networking, we want to hear from you. NVIDIA is an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. title: Senior Deep Learning Engineer, Accuracy Evaluation
description: We are seeking senior engineers to pioneer new methodologies for accurately assessing the performance and capabilities of ground-breaking deep learning models, including LLMs, RAG, agents, and vision models. You will collaborate across the organization to bring the latest ﬂagship models from our community and partners to life. This role offers an outstanding opportunity to craft the future of AI at a fast-growing company at the forefront of the AI revolution. Join our team of world-class software engineers and partners to deliver the most advanced models with lightning-fast inference. You'll work on the most powerful, enterprise-grade GPU clusters capable of hundreds of PetaFLOPS and gain early access to unreleased hardware, making a direct impact on NVIDIA 's roadmap and the broader AI landscape! What you’ll be doing: Design and build decision-grade evaluation environments for NVIDIA 's frontier models spanning reasoning, multimodal, long-context, and agentic systems, producing auditable accuracy signals that gate every major model release. Research and develop novel evaluation methodologies for emerging model families and capability domains (low-precision numerics, multi-turn agentic tasks, code generation) where established benchmarks don't yet exist or don't generalize. Build and operate the evaluation infrastructure and pipelines including benchmark environments, regression CI systems, and statistical analysis tooling, used by model, product, and applied research teams across NVIDIA . Partner with model research, training, and customer teams to translate evaluation signals into concrete decisions: release go/no-go, training iteration direction, and competitive positioning against external frontier models. What we need to see: BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field 6+ years of hands-on experience with LLMs, designing and running evaluations for large language models or multimodal AI systems, including experience with agentic, multi-turn, or reasoning-heavy settings. Strong statistical foundations: experimental design, significance testing, regression analysis, and the ability to distinguish signal from noise in benchmark results at scale. Proven experience building evaluation infrastructure (pipelines, benchmark harnesses, reproducible CI systems) not just consuming existing benchmarks. Clear, precise communicator who can translate quantitative evaluation results into decisions for researchers, product teams, and senior leadership. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Deep familiarity with open-source evaluation frameworks Experience designing evaluations for agentic systems: tool use, multi-turn reasoning, environment-based benchmarks (SWE-bench, GAIA, WebArena-style), or interactive evaluation settings. Track record of publishing or contributing to evaluation research, new benchmark design, methodology papers, or reproducibility analyses that shaped how the field measures model capability. Experience measuring model accuracy under low-precision inference (FP8, INT4, quantization-aware settings) and understanding how calibration and sparsity interact with benchmark results. Comfort running large-scale workloads on HPC/Slurm clusters, including reproducible experiment management (MLflow, W&B) and compute cost optimization across hundreds of benchmark runs. title: Director, FHIR Technical Ecosystem
description: DIRECTOR, FHIR TECHNICAL ECOSYSTEM HL7 International is a global, member-driven non-profit dedicated to advancing healthcare data interoperability. The organization is accredited by the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) as an international Standards Development Organization (SDO). Our widely adopted standards and frameworks are the foundation of health information exchange worldwide, enabling data to be shared, accessed, and applied to improve health outcomes and system performance. We are entering an exciting new chapter of growth and transformation. Our strategic vision emphasizes brand recognition, revenue diversification and growth, and the ability to innovate in response to emerging healthcare challenges. Position Summary FHIR's technical foundations, the build, validation, and publication tooling, the publication infrastructure, the implementation-guide framework, and the body of knowledge and practice that keeps all of it working, need sustained and resilient ownership. The Director, FHIR Technical Ecosystem provides that ownership. Working under the direction of the FHIR Product Director, the Director keeps the technical machinery of FHIR dependable and keeps the knowledge behind it distributed and documented. A defining purpose of the role is continuity: reducing the ecosystem's dependence on any one person by building documented practices, distributed technical ownership, and succession into every critical technical function. The Director is a member of the Standards Development division and reports to the CSDO, while coordinating closely with the FHIR Product Director on functional and technical priorities, and the Deputy FHIR Product Director on process and terminology. The Director also works closely with senior leadership on business development initiatives, supports the Standards Implementation division as a technical subject-matter expert, and coordinates with the Contributor Engagement Lead on community. This is a remote position. Travel to HL7 meetings and selected national and international industry events is required. Key Responsibilities Tooling, publication, and build infrastructure Set direction, resourcing, and resilience strategy for FHIR build, validation, and publication tooling and infrastructure, against the requirements defined by the Product Director, so these remain dependable foundations for the community. Ensure the tooling and infrastructure are actively maintained through engineers, contractors, or HL7 technical services, with no critical component dependent on a single person. Ensure the resourcing and resilience of terminology services infrastructure, coordinating with the Deputy FHIR Product Director, who leads FHIR terminology ecosystem architecture. Standards-development infrastructure and the community's workflow Provide direction for the integrated set of infrastructure the community relies on to develop standards, and keep the connections between its parts coherent: the FHIR publication infrastructure, the GitHub repositories that hold the specifications and their source, the build infrastructure that turns that source into published output, the JIRA infrastructure that Work Groups use for balloting comments and issue resolution, and the documentation platforms such as Confluence that hold process and guidance. Ensure these systems work together as a dependable pipeline from proposal to comment to resolution to build to publication, so that a Work Group's development activity moves through the toolchain without friction or gaps. Treat this toolchain as the connective tissue between the community's standards-development work and the published specification, owning its health, integration, and evolution, and coordinating with the Deputy FHIR Product Director on the process that runs on top of it and with the Contributor Engagement Lead on the contributor experience of using it. Anticipate how a change in one system, for example repository structure, issue-tracker workflow, or build process, affects the others and the Work Groups that depend on them, and manage that change so the community is supported. Implementation-guide framework and quality Own the implementation-guide authoring framework, quality expectations, and consistency standards across guides, producing specific implementation guides for adoption programs, and supporting the implementers who use them. Technical continuity and capability Establish documented practices, distributed technical ownership, and succession across critical FHIR technical functions, reducing dependence on any single individual. Capture and maintain the operating knowledge behind FHIR's tooling and publication so it remains accessible to current and future contributors. Contribute FHIR subject-matter expertise to HL7 education and certification. Support to Standards Implementation Serve as a senior FHIR technical subject-matter expert to the Standards Implementation division's funded work, grants, and consulting. Business Development Co-lead business development initiatives with other members of HL7’s leadership and management. People, program, and operational leadership Supervise and develop the technical and program staff responsible for FHIR tooling and publication, setting priorities, managing performance, and building a collaborative, high-trust team. Manage budgets, timelines, risks, and dependencies for FHIR technical operations. Coordination Coordinate with the FHIR Product Director on requirements and priorities, the Deputy FHIR Product Director on process and terminology, the Contributor Engagement Lead on community, and the Standards Implementation division on adoption. Qualifications and Experience Substantial experience in health IT, interoperability, and standards, including technical program and people leadership. Strong understanding of FHIR tooling, publication, and the specification lifecycle. A track record of building resilient technical operations and reducing key-person risk through documentation, distributed ownership, and succession. Experience directing software and tooling maintenance, whether through employees, contractors, or shared technical services. Excellent written communication and the ability to make technical operations understandable to technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated commitment to open, community-driven development. Track record of successful business development initiatives. Leadership Attributes Stewardship: motivated by the long-term health and resilience of FHIR's technical foundations. Team and organizational leadership: skilled communicator, motivated to provide team leadership, clear direction and guidance to attain results. Systems thinking and acting: able to see the whole tooling and publication chain and where it is fragile, and intervene accordingly. Collaboration: leads through influence and coordination across roles and divisions. Innovation and process improvement: Encourages and enables the development and adoption of novel technologies, and promotes continuous process improvement. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing vision-language models with a focus on real-world deployment. Your work will span the full model development lifecycle - from data curation and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy at scale. You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating text and vision, applying state-of-the-art research to improve model quality, efficiency, and domain-specific performance. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly. You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity. Responsibilities Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on vision-language models, covering training, evaluation, and optimization across the full model development lifecycle. Design and implement post-training pipelines including supervised fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, and reinforcement learning from human feedback. Develop and maintain high-quality multimodal datasets, including data curation, filtering, and balancing for domain-specific tasks. Drive model efficiency and deployability, adapting models for resource-constrained environments using compression and optimization techniques. Design and implement evaluation frameworks and benchmarks to measure model performance, robustness, and real-world task success. Build and scale training workflows across distributed GPU infrastructure. Identify and resolve bottlenecks in training pipelines to achieve state-of-the-art model quality on target benchmarks. Contribute to and leverage open-source ecosystems including models, datasets, and tooling to accelerate development. Stay current with the latest research in multimodal learning and vision-language systems, translating relevant findings into practical improvements. Publish research findings in top-tier AI conferences and journals where applicable. Requirements Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; MS/PhD preferred. Strong experience with multimodal post-training workflows including supervised fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, and reinforcement learning from feedback. Hands-on experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning and distributed training frameworks. Demonstrated ability to build and improve vision-language models with measurable results on standard benchmarks or real-world tasks. Experience adapting models for resource-constrained environments. Proven open-source contributions in multimodal AI on GitHub or HuggingFace. Publications at top AI conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ECCV etc.) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. Strong project management skills; able to run multiple events and campaigns at once, keep every detail on track, and hit deadlines without dropping quality. Comfort with the marketing stack: CRM (Salesforce) and marketing automation (HubSpot or similar), plus the ability to pull and interpret your own performance data. Excellent communication and stakeholder skills; able to align sales, partners, and corporate marketing around a shared plan. Able to travel to relevant tradeshows and conferences globally, roughly 30–50% during peak season. Experience managing a field events portfolio across multiple regions. Background in B2B startup marketing. Experience delivering both intimate field events and larger-scale user conferences. Familiarity with the SaaS landscape (strongly desired) and the Media & Publishing industry (nice to have). title: Product Manager
description: At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most. We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel. Forbes Advisor is investing in the products and platform capabilities that power everything we build, and we're looking for a best-in-class Product Manager for our technology platforms team. This hands-on role will own products across our CMS platform, including reusable capabilities, partner propositions and platform features that enable our products across the business. Great products are built on great platforms - so getting the foundations right is everything, whether that's for the teams using our products every day, the partners we build for, or the customers who ultimately benefit from them. You'll take products from discovery through delivery and continuous iteration, making sure what we build today can evolve with the business tomorrow. Working closely with Publishing, Engineering, Design, Commercial and the wider Product team, you'll turn business needs into a clear, prioritised roadmap. You'll balance user needs, technical feasibility and commercial goals, keeping the people who use your products at the centre of every decision. The person we're looking for is a genuine all-rounder who's equally comfortable working with engineers, internal teams and business stakeholders. You're naturally curious, enjoy solving complex operational problems, and are comfortable making smart trade-offs to deliver practical solutions. You're a self-starter and an exemplary communicator who keeps stakeholders aligned and reliably delivers what matters most. Responsibilities: Strategy & roadmap Develop and maintain product roadmaps for CMS capabilities, partner propositions and platform features, balancing user needs, technical feasibility and business priorities. Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities, prioritise initiatives and continuously evolve the platform. Product delivery Lead product delivery from discovery through launch and ongoing iteration, ensuring products deliver measurable value. Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria that Engineering teams can confidently deliver. Own a prioritised backlog and work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design and QA to deliver high-quality products at pace. CMS, platform & product capabilities Deliver scalable CMS capabilities, reusable components and platform features that enable teams across the business. Work closely with Engineering to design solutions that are reusable, maintainable and scalable as the platform evolves. Collaborate with internal teams and third-party partners to deliver new partner propositions and enhance the platform capabilities that support them. AI & continuous improvement Use user feedback, operational insight and business priorities to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Use AI, automation and reusable platform capabilities to improve internal workflows, reduce duplication and accelerate delivery. Measure the impact of new capabilities and use those learnings to inform future product decisions. Stakeholder communication Build strong relationships across Publishing, Engineering, Commercial and the wider Product team, acting as the central point of communication for your product area. Keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, delivery progress and product decisions. What you'll bring: 3+ years in product management, with a track record of delivering high-impact platform products, internal tools or business capabilities. Comfortable working across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through delivery and iteration. Experience with CMS, publishing tools, content platforms or partner-facing products is a plus. Experience delivering cross-functional product initiatives, collaborating across Engineering, Design and business teams to achieve shared outcomes. Comfortable working closely with Engineering and translating business needs into clear product requirements. Experience using AI to improve product development, accelerate delivery and solve complex problems. Data-informed, with strong product judgement and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs that deliver the greatest value. Exemplary communication and stakeholder skills, with a proven ability to build alignment across technical and non-technical teams. Curious, pragmatic and proactive, with a practical approach to solving problems and delivering value. title: ASIC & FPGA Design Engineer Sr - E3
description: Standard Job Description You will be the ASIC & FPGA Design Engineer for the ASIC/FPGA department at Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control. Our team delivers full custom analog and mixed signal ICs that power advanced defense systems, ranging from 130 nm down to 12 nm and including high voltage BCD processes. What You Will Be Doing As the ASIC & FPGA Design Engineer you will own the entire layout flow—from floorplan through tape out—working hand in hand with circuit designers to turn schematic intent into high performance, parasitic aware physical designs. You will operate in a dual tool environment (Synopsys Custom Compiler and Cadence Virtuoso) and drive physical verification closure across multiple foundries, directly supporting mission critical programs. Your responsibilities will include: • Create floorplans, place and route analog blocks, optimizing area, matching, signal integrity and power delivery. • Drive DRC, LVS and ERC verification to achieve full closure for each target process. • Perform or support EMIR analysis to detect and remediate IR drop and electromigration concerns. • Develop and maintain layout methodology, automation scripts and best practice guidelines for the department. • Collaborate with circuit designers, verification engineers and system architects to ensure the layout reflects functional intent and performance targets. • Manage tape out sign off packages, including documentation, design rule decks and release notes. • Mentor junior layout engineers and promote a knowledge sharing culture. Why Join Us Do you want to be part of a company culture that empowers employees to think big, lead with a growth mindset, and make the impossible a reality? We provide the resources and give you the flexibility to enable inspiration and focus. If you have the passion and courage to dream big, work hard, and have fun doing what you love then we want to build a better tomorrow with you. We offer flexible work schedules to comprehensive benefits investing in your future and security, Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s comprehensive benefits package here. Further Information About This Opportunity: This position is remote. MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN - This position is located at a facility that requires special access. The selected candidate must be able to obtain a secret clearance. Basic Qualifications • Associate degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Technology, Microelectronics, or a related technical discipline • 8 or more years of experience in full-custom analog or mixed-signal IC layout design • Layout experience across process nodes ranging from 130nm to 12nm, including BCD technologies • Proficiency with Synopsys Custom Compiler (or Custom Designer) • Proficiency with Cadence Virtuoso layout environment • Experience with physical verification closure (DRC, LVS, ERC, ANT) across multiple foundry processes • Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance Desired Skills • Bachelor degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field • EMIR analysis experience, including IR drop and electromigration mitigation • Scripting or layout automation skills (SKILL, Tcl, Python, or Perl) • Layout experience with precision analog blocks such as PLLs, ADC/DACs, LDOs, bandgap references, or amplifiers Pay Information GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. title: Product Manager
description: At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most. We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel. Forbes Advisor is investing in the products and platform capabilities that power everything we build, and we're looking for a best-in-class Product Manager for our technology platforms team. This hands-on role will own products across our CMS platform, including reusable capabilities, partner propositions and platform features that enable our products across the business. Great products are built on great platforms - so getting the foundations right is everything, whether that's for the teams using our products every day, the partners we build for, or the customers who ultimately benefit from them. You'll take products from discovery through delivery and continuous iteration, making sure what we build today can evolve with the business tomorrow. Working closely with Publishing, Engineering, Design, Commercial and the wider Product team, you'll turn business needs into a clear, prioritised roadmap. You'll balance user needs, technical feasibility and commercial goals, keeping the people who use your products at the centre of every decision. The person we're looking for is a genuine all-rounder who's equally comfortable working with engineers, internal teams and business stakeholders. You're naturally curious, enjoy solving complex operational problems, and are comfortable making smart trade-offs to deliver practical solutions. You're a self-starter and an exemplary communicator who keeps stakeholders aligned and reliably delivers what matters most. Responsibilities: Strategy & roadmap Develop and maintain product roadmaps for CMS capabilities, partner propositions and platform features, balancing user needs, technical feasibility and business priorities. Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities, prioritise initiatives and continuously evolve the platform. Product delivery Lead product delivery from discovery through launch and ongoing iteration, ensuring products deliver measurable value. Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria that Engineering teams can confidently deliver. Own a prioritised backlog and work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design and QA to deliver high-quality products at pace. CMS, platform & product capabilities Deliver scalable CMS capabilities, reusable components and platform features that enable teams across the business. Work closely with Engineering to design solutions that are reusable, maintainable and scalable as the platform evolves. Collaborate with internal teams and third-party partners to deliver new partner propositions and enhance the platform capabilities that support them. AI & continuous improvement Use user feedback, operational insight and business priorities to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Use AI, automation and reusable platform capabilities to improve internal workflows, reduce duplication and accelerate delivery. Measure the impact of new capabilities and use those learnings to inform future product decisions. Stakeholder communication Build strong relationships across Publishing, Engineering, Commercial and the wider Product team, acting as the central point of communication for your product area. Keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, delivery progress and product decisions. What you'll bring: 3+ years in product management, with a track record of delivering high-impact platform products, internal tools or business capabilities. Comfortable working across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through delivery and iteration. Experience with CMS, publishing tools, content platforms or partner-facing products is a plus. Experience delivering cross-functional product initiatives, collaborating across Engineering, Design and business teams to achieve shared outcomes. Comfortable working closely with Engineering and translating business needs into clear product requirements. Experience using AI to improve product development, accelerate delivery and solve complex problems. Data-informed, with strong product judgement and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs that deliver the greatest value. Exemplary communication and stakeholder skills, with a proven ability to build alignment across technical and non-technical teams. Curious, pragmatic and proactive, with a practical approach to solving problems and delivering value. title: Videographer
description: Overview and Introduction to Communitas International Communitas is a church planting organization with 50 years experience working in Western Europe, Central and Eastern Europe, Latin America and North America. Our leading edge ministry is looking for the right person to help lead us into greater Kingdom ministry. Our current mission family of over 200 includes full-time, bi-vocational employees, as well as affiliates, with many of that number being non-Americans. Communitas operates in over 20 different countries as we start new initiatives and nurture churches and church-planting projects toward reproducible maturity. Communitas is rooted in missional theology. Our three core values center on being Kingdom seeking, Grace oriented and People focused. Our church planting methodology is not tied to a specific formula, but rather the spirit of serving others and the embracing of a progression of actions that lead to a healthy, maturing church, making our approach very adaptable to unique contexts (see for details). We are pioneers and risk takers. We value honesty and encouragement. We collaborate well, within our global regions, as well as with partner organizations. The Need and Opportunity Across post-Christian secular culture people have largely given up on church, but spirituality remains important to them. Communitas International is at the forefront of sparking that spirituality with mission and helping people ‘taste and see that the Lord is good’. Our church planting organization offers the following: A firm commitment to expressing the passionate love of God for the world in word and deed. Substantial experience in reaching people in post-Christian culture. Strategic coaching for planters and churches by experienced cross-cultural practitioners. Robust training for team leaders and members via online cohorts, on-site events and regional/global seminars and conferences. Rigorous assessment experiences and tools that can form the basis for strategic coaching and healthy team building. Partnership in innovation with those looking for new ways to declare the timeless message of the Gospel. Videographer Reports to: Chief Multiplication Officer Works closely with: Mobilization, Human Resources, Global field leaders, Field staff Direct reports: None Location: Remote work engagement Structure: Full-time, part-time, bi-vocational (support-raised); volunteer Position Scope: The Videographer will use video production and visual storytelling to strengthen Communitas’ brand, expand audience engagement, and share the stories of what God is doing through our ministry partners and communities around the world. This position is responsible for creating compelling video content from concept development through final production, including planning, directing, filming, editing, and distributing video projects across digital platforms. Principal Duties & Responsibilities: Produce, direct, film, and edit professional-quality video projects for web, social media, ministry communications, and other platforms. Capture interviews, events, ministry activities, and environmental footage that authentically represent the work of Communitas. Maintain a strong working knowledge of video production equipment, software, and industry best practices. Develop creative concepts, story ideas, scripts, and production plans that communicate Communitas’ mission effectively. Work directly with project leaders and community members across diverse cultural settings. Travel to ministry locations, churches, and project sites to capture firsthand stories and experiences. Set up and operate live-streaming equipment and platforms as needed for events and ministry communications. Support and train missionaries in effective video capture techniques. Capture creative still photography to support Communitas’ communications and marketing efforts. General Responsibilities: Demonstrates spiritual maturity and a growing relationship with Jesus Christ. Aligns fully with the mission, vision, values, and Statement of Faith of Communitas. Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and integrity in all matters. Maintains a collaborative, learning-oriented, and positive leadership posture. Commits to excellence in communication, stewardship, and organizational representation. Qualifications: Be a committed follower of Jesus Christ with a strong alignment with the mission, vision, and values of Communitas. Demonstrate a passion for ministry, storytelling, and using creative gifts to serve others. Be a collaborative team member who works well with diverse groups of people. Be adaptable, willing to experiment, evaluate, and adjust creative approaches when needed. Hold a bachelor's degree in cinematography, broadcasting, communications, media production, or related field (preferred). Demonstrate strong video production, filming, editing, and post-production skills. Possess extensive knowledge of video formats and delivery methods for web and mobile platforms. Understand the technical requirements and equipment needed for professional video production. Have strong written and verbal communication skills. Be able to manage multiple projects, prioritize deadlines, and work effectively in a changing environment. Be willing and able to travel as ministry opportunities require. Funding: The salary and ministry-related expenses associated with this position are funded through personal support raising. Candidates may serve in this role through a traditional full-time ministry position, part-time role, bi-vocational arrangement, or volunteer capacity. Communitas provides onboarding, training, coaching, and ongoing support to help team members build and sustain a healthy ministry partnership team. Communitas welcomes applicants who feel called to use their creative skills to advance the Gospel through visual storytelling. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Recruiter
description: Job Description: Title: Senior Recruiter Team: Human Resources Location: Remote (Canada, New York Metro Area / 2 hour commute to NYC or Raleigh, North Carolina) Why This Role Exists At Phreesia , the Senior Recruiter plays a pivotal role in identifying, attracting, and hiring the talent that helps us deliver on our mission of making care easier every day. Operating within our Business Partner Model, you’ll act as a strategic talent acquisition advisor to HR Business Partners, hiring managers, and senior and executive leaders — leading searches across multiple departments, position levels, and geographic locations. You’ll bring deep full-cycle recruiting expertise and sound judgment to every stage of the process and be trusted to operate with a high degree of independence. You’ll care deeply about delivering a best-in-class experience for every candidate and hiring manager, bring grit to our most challenging and highest-stakes searches, try new approaches that improve how we hire, and consistently make excellent things happen for the business and the teams you support. What You’ll Spend Your Time Doing Own full-cycle recruiting. Lead the end-to-end North America recruiting process for a variety of roles, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing candidates at all levels. Shape the search strategy. Lead search strategy and kickoff meetings with hiring managers and HR partners to align on job requirements, qualifications, and the ideal candidate profile, while bringing a point of view on market conditions and hiring approach. Partner with senior leaders. Work directly with senior leaders on searches, presenting market insights, candidate slates, and hiring recommendations with credibility and polish. Raise the bar across the recruiting team. Mentor and coach other recruiters, sharing best practices in sourcing, interviewing, and candidate management. Be a strategic talent advisor. Guide business leaders on compensation, market trends, and interview approaches while exercising sound judgment in ambiguous or high-stakes hiring situations. Drive continuous improvement. Stay current on recruiting trends and AI-enabled tools, and lead projects that sharpen team processes and strategy. Deliver an exceptional candidate experience. Serve as a Phreesia brand ambassador by creating a high-touch, authentic, and inclusive experience for every candidate and modeling that standard for the broader recruiting team. Keep stakeholders connected. Communicate proactively and consistently to create a transparent and engaging journey that reflects our culture and values for internal and external stakeholders. Use data to improve outcomes. Leverage recruiting data and metrics to track performance, inform hiring decisions, and improve results. Create consistency and compliance. Support hiring consistency through scorecards, process standards, and timely feedback in Workday. Adapt to what each search needs. Thrive in ambiguity, adjusting your recruiting approach and process to fit the unique demands of each search rather than applying a one-size-fits-all playbook. What Makes You a Great Fit You don’t need to check every box — but this role will feel energizing if you: Have a proven track record of success in results-driven, full-cycle recruiting, including hard-to-fill or confidential searches Bring demonstrated executive presence and communicate with senior leaders in a confident, credible, and concise way Are comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and balancing multiple complex searches while maintaining quality and responsiveness Have experience mentoring or informally leading other recruiters Bring strong business acumen and can understand organizational needs and align talent strategies accordingly Are adaptable and growth-oriented, with an interest in learning and evolving alongside changing business needs Have extensive experience recruiting across multiple levels and functions, including senior-level searches across North America Have experience managing complex internal and external stakeholder relationships, including relationships with senior leaders Are comfortable operating with a high level of independence Are committed to professional development and staying current in the recruiting industry Have global recruiting experience, which is strongly preferred Have experience with Workday, which is preferred We Do Have A Few Requirements To Check Bachelor’s degree required 10+ years of relevant full-cycle recruiting experience, including experience recruiting for senior or specialized roles Where You’ll Work This is a remote role for candidates located in Canada, New York Metro Area / 2 hour commute to NYC or Raleigh, North Carolina. Minimal travel may arise based on business needs. Compensation & Rewards Base Salary: $100,000 - $120,000 USD / $95,000 - 110,000 CAD A comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your whole life — not just your work Who We Are: At Phreesia , we’re looking for smart and passionate people to help drive our mission of creating a better, more engaging healthcare experience. We’re committed to helping healthcare organizations succeed in an ever-evolving landscape by transforming the way healthcare is delivered. Our SaaS platform digitizes appointment check-in and offers tools to engage patients, improve efficiency, optimize staffing, and enhance clinical care. Phreesia cares about our employees by providing a diverse and dynamic work environment. We’re a five-time winner of Modern Healthcare Magazine’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare award and we’ve been recognized on the Bloomberg Gender Equality Index. We are dedicated to continuously improving our employee experience by launching new programs and initiatives. If you thrive in a culture of recognition, value inclusivity, professional development, and growth opportunities, Phreesia could be a great fit! Top-rated Employee Benefits: 100% Remote work + home office expense reimbursements Competitive compensation Flexible PTO + 8 company holidays Monthly reimbursement for cell phone + internet + wellness 100% Paid 12-week parental leave to our U.S. employees, as well as a generous parental benefit to our employees in Canada Variety of insurance coverage for people (and pets!) Continuing education and professional certification reimbursement Opportunity to join an Employee Resource Group. Learn more here: We strive to provide a diverse and inclusive environment and are an equal opportunity employer. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: (Senior) B2B Operations Manager (all genders)
description: über die rolle Als B2B Operations Manager entwickelst du die Prozesse, Datenflüsse und Arbeitsweisen unseres B2B-Bereichs. Du nutzt Daten, Automatisierung und KI, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren und Abläufe skalierbar zu machen. So kann sich das Team stärker auf Kunden, Partnerschaften und Wachstum konzentrieren. Unser CRM befindet sich im finalen Aufbau. Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung dafür, wie B2B-Prozesse im CRM abgebildet werden: Du erkennst Engpässe in der Datenpflege und den Workflows, formulierst Anforderungen an Struktur und Automatisierung und setzt neue Abläufe gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams um - von der Abbildung von Lead-Qualifizierung und Onboarding über Pricing- und Konditionslogik bis zu Partnerkommunikation und Shop-Prozessen. deine aufgaben B2B-Prozesse & Operations (ca. 60%) Du übernimmst 0-to-1-Ownership für unsere B2B-Prozesse, von der Lead-Qualifizierung über das Onboarding bis zur laufenden Partnerbetreuung. Wo heute kein sauberer Ablauf existiert, baust du einen. Du bist die Schnittstelle zu CRM und Automation: Du verstehst die Datenflüsse, erkennst Engpässe und formulierst klare Anforderungen, die Data & AI und IT technisch umsetzen. CRM-Hygiene ist für dich die Grundlage jeder verlässlichen Auswertung. Du verbindest Sales, Supply Chain, Finance und Product zu reibungslosen Abläufen mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und treibst bereichsübergreifende Projekte voran. Du definierst und trackst zentrale KPIs (Conversion Rate, Pipeline-Geschwindigkeit, Lead-Qualität, Customer Value) und baust Reporting, das dem Team echte Steuerungsintelligenz gibt, keine Zahlenfriedhöfe. Du hältst fest, was funktioniert: Du machst Best Practices zu Playbooks und SOPs und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Team wirklich genutzt werden. Operatives Enabling (ca. 40%) Du verantwortest B2B-Newsletter und Partner-Kommunikation: Du bringst die richtigen Aktionen zu den richtigen Partnergruppen und wertest ihre Wirkung aus (Open Rate, CTR, Conversion). Du entwickelst unsere Pricing- und Konditionenlogik mit und pflegst sie sauber in Shop und CRM: kommerziell durchdacht, konsistent, nachvollziehbar. Du betreust unseren B2B-Shop und den Education-Shop: Produktzugänge, Kollektionen, Bundles, kleinere Anpassungen, und du begleitest die Shop-Migration. Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Produktdaten: vollständig, korrekt, verlässlich. dein profil Du hast 3-4+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer Sales-Organisation, Commercial/Sales Operations, Strategieberatung oder einem Scale-up gesammelt. Ein Hintergrund in einer Strategieberatung oder Business Development ist ein Pluspunkt. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit HubSpot und bewegst dich sicher in CRM-Systemen und digitalen Workflows. Du bist ein hands-on Generalist: Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, setzt selbst um statt zu delegieren, und dir ist keine Aufgabe zu klein. Du hast bereits komplexe, bereichsübergreifende Projekte eigenständig geführt - von Scoping und Business Case über die Umsetzung bis zur Verankerung im Team (SOPs, Playbooks, Trainings). Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du erkennst Chancen, priorisierst nach Wirkung und Skalierbarkeit und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen. Du arbeitest stark analytisch: Du bewegst dich sicher in großen Datenmengen und Spreadsheets und ziehst daraus klare, umsetzbare Schlüsse. Du hast eine hohe KI- und Datenaffinität: Du hast KI-Tools bereits praktisch in deiner Arbeit eingesetzt und möchtest sie zu einem festen Bestandteil deiner Arbeitsweise machen. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und lernst schnell. Du strukturierst fachliche Bedarfe und übersetzt sie in umsetzbare Anforderungen an Prozesse, Daten und Systeme. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und zielgruppengerecht innerhalb des Unternehmens. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch. was uns wichtig ist Stapelstein ist für dich kein Job - sondern eine Mission, hinter der du wirklich stehst. Für dich ist ein respektvoller, empathischer Umgang keine Checkbox - sondern die Basis, auf der gute Zusammenarbeit entsteht. Herausforderungen bremsen dich nicht - sie machen dich neugierig. Du denkst kreativ und unternehmerisch - du findest Wege, wo andere Hindernisse sehen, und machst dich in deinen Rollen wirklich wirkungsvoll. Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung und triffst Entscheidungen mit Überzeugung - ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Du brauchst keine Struktur von außen - du schaffst sie dir selbst. Du nutzt KI nicht, weil es alle tun - sondern weil du verstanden hast, dass es die Art, wie wir arbeiten, grundlegend verändert. was wir bieten Der Start ist jederzeit möglich. Ein marktübliches, faires Gehaltspaket. Remote-first - in Deutschland und zeitweise auch aus dem Ausland. Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer gemeinsamen Kernzeit von 9-12 Uhr. Überstunden werden vollständig durch Freizeitausgleich ausgeglichen. Vollzeit bedeutet bei uns 36 Stunden pro Woche - für mehr Fokus und mehr Lebenszeit. Ergänzt wird das durch 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr. Monatliche Team-Meet-ups in Stuttgart oder Berlin. Zeit, um gemeinsam im selben Raum zu arbeiten, Projekte voranzubringen und sich persönlich auszutauschen. Zwei inspirierende Offsites pro Jahr, weil echtes Teamgefühl trotz Remote-first seinen Raum braucht. Flexible Benefits wie Einkaufsbudget, Mobilitätszuschuss oder Urban Sports - nach bestandener Probezeit. Originally posted on Himalayas
