description: Shirley Ryan AbilityLab is the global leader in physical medicine and rehabilitation for adults and children with the most severe, complex conditions. By joining our team, you’ll be part of our life-changing mission and vision. You’ll contribute to an innovative, multifaceted culture that is second to none — one that embraces collaboration, excellence, discovery and compassion. You’ll play a role in something that’s never been done before as we integrate science and clinical care to help patients achieve better, faster outcomes — as we Advance Human Ability, together. Job Description Summary The Applications Analyst II – IT Revenue Cycle (Patient Access) serves as a primary resource for system configuration, deployment, and support of revenue cycle information systems specific to Scheduling and Registration within Oracle Health/Cerner solutions. This position partners closely with revenue cycle operations and clinical applications teams to analyze, design, and implement system solutions that enhance operational efficiency and patient access workflows. The Applications Analyst II collaborates with end-users to gather requirements, facilitates workflow analysis, and validates system performance to ensure alignment with business goals. The Applications Analyst II will consistently demonstrate support of the Shirley Ryan Abilitylab statement of Vision, Mission and Core Values by striving for excellence, contributing to the team efforts and showing respect and compassion for patients and their families, fellow employees, and all others with whom there is contact at or in the interest of the institute. The Applications Analyst II will demonstrate Shirley Ryan Abilitylab Core Attributes: Communication, Accountability, Flexibility/Adaptability, Judgment/Problem Solving, Customer Service and Core Values (Hope, Compassion, Discovery, Collaboration, and Commitment to Excellence) while fulfilling job duties. Job Description The Applications Analyst II, IT Revenue Cycle (Patient Access) will: Support revenue cycle and patient access applications including installing upgrades, providing enhancements, troubleshooting issues, and ongoing problem management. Analyze existing revenue cycle applications and workflows to identify opportunities for enhancement, optimization and operational efficiency improvements. Collaborate with end-users and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Design, develop, configure, document, test and implement software solutions to address business needs and improve revenue cycle efficiency. Conduct thorough testing and validation of system enhancements to ensure quality, reliability and alignment with business objectives. Provide ongoing support and maintenance for revenue cycle applications, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, and performance monitoring. Respond promptly to user inquiries and technical issues, delivering effective solutions to minimize system downtime. Collaborate with vendors and internal IT teams to escalate and resolve complex technical issues as needed. Implement system upgrades and patches in coordination with IT infrastructure teams, ensuring minimal disruption to operations. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including technical specifications, user guides, technical specifications, maintenance documentation and process workflows. Stay informed about industry best practices and emerging technologies in revenue cycle management, sharing insights with the team. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Revenue Cycle Operations, Quality Control & Education, and Finance, to align system capabilities with business objectives and regulatory requirements. Participate in project teams and meetings to represent the IT Revenue Cycle perspective, contributing recommendations for system improvements and strategic initiatives. Develop project plans with timelines, milestones, defined roles and responsibilities, and communication plans. Perform all other duties that may be assigned in the best interest of Shirley Ryan AbilityLab . Reporting Relationships: Reports directly to the Manager, IT Revenue Cycle Applications Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field. Equivalent work experience will be considered. Current or prior certification in one or more Cerner/Oracle Health applications preferred (e.g., Cerner Application Specialist, Cerner Integration Architect, Revenue Cycle certifications). Minimum of 2 years of experience in applications analysis, consulting, software development, or related IT roles, preferably in healthcare or revenue cycle management. Strong knowledge of registration and scheduling workflows, processes and front-end applications (RevenueCycle.exe). Strong knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle processes, regulations, and industry standards (e.g., HIPAA, Patient Access, Charge Services, Patient Accounting). Firm understanding of operational workflows and the ability to work independently with users to define how technology can support and improve business processes. Ability and willingness to learn new tools and Healthcare Information Systems as part of SRALab’s future core applications toolset. Proven ability to manage software initiatives and projects of varying sizes and complexity. Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems, identify issues, and propose effective solutions. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse stakeholders and teams. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure. Professional computer skills necessary to prepare project plans, presentations, process workflows, test plans, and technical documentation. Deliver clear, natural, and expressive speech with strong control over tone, pacing, and pronunciation. Maintain consistency in voice, accent, and delivery across recording sessions. Access to a professional or near-professional recording setup . Strong command of intonation, diction, and emotional range . Ability to follow scripts precisely while maintaining natural delivery. Reliable availability for 5–10 hours per week . Preferred Experience recording for TTS, audiobooks, IVR systems, or AI voice datasets . title: Director, Finance Systems
description: Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities. The Director, Finance Systems will lead the strategy, architecture, implementation, and ongoing evolution of the systems and technology that enable Finance to operate effectively at scale. This leader will partner across Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Operations, IT, HR, and other business functions to build an integrated, automated, and data-driven Finance technology ecosystem - ensuring we are using the right tools and workflows, leveraging automation and AI where appropriate, to operate lean without sacrificing rigor. This role is ideal for a finance-minded technology leader who understands that great systems are not simply implementations—they are the foundation for scalable processes, reliable data, strong controls, faster decisions, and an increasingly AI-enabled Finance organization. This role is remote, based out of the United States or Toronto, ON. We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting. Who You Are You bring a deep understanding of finance and accounting processes, paired with expertise in technology, data, and systems. You are comfortable discussing financial close, revenue recognition, inventory accounting, and financial planning with Finance leaders, as well as integrations, data architecture, APIs, master data, security, and system design with technical teams. You understand how systems, processes, controls, data, and organizational design work together. You have built Finance infrastructure in environments where business growth outpaced existing processes and systems. You are energized by complexity and ambiguity. Rather than simply automating existing processes, you challenge how work should be performed and use technology, workflow automation, analytics, and AI to simplify and redesign Finance operations. You have 10+ years of experience across Finance Systems, Accounting Systems, Finance Transformation, Enterprise Applications, or related disciplines, including 5+ years leading teams, major systems programs, or enterprise transformation initiatives. Experience in technology, semiconductor, hardware, manufacturing, AI infrastructure, or another complex global operating environment is highly desirable. What We Need Build and lead the Finance Systems strategy and operating model, creating a scalable technology foundation that supports rapid company growth, increasing transaction volumes, global expansion, and increasingly sophisticated commercial and operational requirements. Own the Finance functional architecture and roadmap for the company’s ERP and related financial systems. Bring experience with enterprise ERP and financial platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, or equivalent platforms, as well as integrations with HR, payroll, procurement, banking, tax, planning, CRM, supply chain, and operational systems. Partner with Finance leaders to redesign processes before automating them. Lead automation and transformation across record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, revenue accounting, inventory and cost accounting, fixed assets, intercompany accounting, treasury and banking, tax, payroll accounting, financial planning and forecasting, and management and financial reporting. Develop an AI-forward Finance roadmap and a reliable Finance data architecture. Identify practical applications for generative AI, agents, intelligent workflow, anomaly detection, automated reconciliation, and predictive analytics. Partner with Data and Analytics teams to ensure Finance data is accurate, accessible, traceable, and useful for decision-making. Embed financial controls into system design and business workflows. Lead complex cross-functional Finance technology and transformation programs from business case through implementation and adoption, communicate strategy and investment requirements to senior leadership, and build a high-performing Finance Systems organization focused on simplification, automation, continuous improvement, customer experience, and measurable business outcomes. What You Will Learn How to build a Finance technology architecture from growth stage through global scale rather than inheriting a mature environment. How to translate rapid business growth into systems, data, processes, and controls that can scale ahead of the organization. How to design Finance infrastructure capable of supporting complex global supply chains, inventory, manufacturing, revenue models, and legal-entity structures. How to apply AI and automation directly to Finance workflows, moving beyond traditional ERP-centric Finance architectures. Knowledge of YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, including audience engagement and video performance metrics. Close attention to sourcing, attribution, copyright, footage rights, and permissions. Strong communication, organization, and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple productions and meet tight deadlines. The ability to collaborate across India and U.S. time zones, with flexibility during breaking news and major political events. title: Senior GenAI Solutions Architect
description: Join North Wind - Accelerating Hypersonic Innovation At North Wind, we are advancing hypersonic technologies through cutting-edge research, system development, and flight testing. Our team drives innovation in high-speed aerodynamics, propulsion systems, and mission-critical components, supporting every phase of hypersonic programs - from R&D to flight testing, If you are passionate about pushing technological boundaries in a dynamic environment, we invite you to join us. Senior GenAI Solutions Architect: Are you an innovator who thrives on solving complex problems with Generative AI, agentic systems, and advanced deep learning? North Wind is seeking a Senior GenAI Solutions Architect who can design and scale intelligent, multi-agent pipelines that accelerate aerospace engineering workflows; ranging from automated data pipelines to reduced‑order modeling of high‑fidelity computational fluid dynamics simulations. This role focuses on building secure, scalable GenAI architectures that operate seamlessly across IL2 to IL7 cloud platforms to support defense missions and digital engineering initiatives. North Wind is looking for a seasoned, technically strong GenAI Solutions Architect to accelerate DoD customers’ adoption of generative and agentic AI. In this role, you will lead engagements with key defense partners, understand their mission and technical requirements, and architect innovative solutions that leverage multi‑agent orchestration, advanced deep learning techniques, and secure data integration. You will collaborate across North Wind’s digital engineering and data science ecosystem, working with cross‑functional teams and customers to deliver mission‑aligned, impactful outcomes. Key Responsibilities: Serving as a trusted, customer-facing technical advisor who champions GenAI and agentic solutions across IL2–IL7 environments, guiding customers through secure, cloud‑agnostic architectures. Define and design solutions leveraging AWS and Azure GenAI services, lead technical workshops and demonstrations, and contribute to best practices and reference architectures for advanced deep learning and digital engineering within the DoD. Stay current with advancements in GenAI, multi-agent systems, and aerospace-focused AI techniques is essential to driving mission success. Serve as a trusted advisor, becoming an evangelist for GenAI solutions both within the company and customer facing roles. Demonstrate deep technical expertise in cloud infrastructure development and deployments in a cloud-agnostic methodology, working alongside North Wind IT staff and infrastructure engineers to maintain capable and secure systems. Work with customers and teammates to define and architect solutions that leverage AWS GenAI services (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker Studio, Amazon Titan Embeddings, etc.) to address their most critical challenges. Work with customers and teammates to define and architect solutions that leverage and integrate with Azure GenAI services (AI Studio, AI Foundry, etc.) Lead technical workshops and demonstrations with customers to showcase the capabilities of NorthWind's platform and AI technologies. Contribute to the development of best practices and reference architectures for GenAI in the DoD. Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in GenAI and related technologies. Qualifications: Strong foundation in cloud‑native architecture, deep learning, and Generative AI, with hands‑on experience designing and deploying secure solutions across IL2–IL7 environments. Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience architecting and deploying cloud-based solutions. 3+ years of hands-on experience with machine learning technologies and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, MLFlow, etc.). Experience working with large datasets and data pipelines. Strong understanding of cloud security principles and best practices, especially IL4-7 and CMMC 2. Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrate expertise with AWS and Azure AI services, proficiency in developing agentic and multi‑agent systems, and a proven ability to translate complex mission requirements into scalable, production‑ready architectures. Master’s degree in computer science or a related field. Experience with developing and training Generative AI models and techniques (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models). Experience with Amazon SageMaker Studio and other AWS machine learning services. Experience with Azure AI and data ecosystem tools, including Azure AI Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, and related Azure data lake, data pipeline, and MLOps services. Expertise designing or optimizing reduced‑order models, physics‑informed neural networks, or other advanced deep learning techniques for aerospace or defense engineering workloads. Experience working in the DoD or public sector. Active security clearance (e.g., Secret, Top Secret). AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional certification. Demonstrated commitment to staying current on emerging GenAI, digital engineering, and aerospace‑focused AI advancements. Demonstrated ability to lead technical workshops, influence stakeholders, and drive adoption of modern GenAI practices within complex DoD organizations. Familiarity with secure DevSecOps practices, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code workflows commonly used in defense cloud environments. Desired Characteristics Thrives in a fast‑paced, agile environment and is comfortable working within a distributed, cross‑time zone team. Actively engage on collaborative communication channels such as Slack, Teams, and Confluence, and are willing to jump into rapid‑response “tiger teams” when mission needs arise. Demonstrates a strong willingness to learn, embraces iterative development, and consistently contributes to team success. Think creatively to solve complex AI/ML challenges while adhering to North Wind’s security boundaries and DevSecOps principles, and they communicate effectively with engineers, program managers, and executive leadership alike. North Wind is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. North Wind supports safe and drug free workplace through pre-employment background checks and drug testing. The salary range provided is a general guideline. Actual pay will depend on several factors, including, but not limited to, education, experience, training, and other applicable qualifications. North Wind is committed to pay transparency in compliance with applicable state and local laws. All candidates must be eligible to work in the United States. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Contracts Specialist
description: Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data Avicado is known for best-in-class service to our clients, and our contracts are the backbone of that delivery. Solid contracts set the terms, expectations, and guardrails that let our teams do great, uninterrupted work. As Avicado grows, the Contracts Specialist is one of the key support pillars that keeps that backbone strong. You keep our contracts reviewed, signed on terms we can stand behind, easy to find, and easy to understand, so Finance, our consultants, Sales, and leadership can do their work with confidence. Core Responsibilities Contract Review and Risk Screening Act as the first-line reviewer for contracts, amendments, and RFPs from Sales and internal teams, including client, partner, vendor, and IT agreements. Identify the terms that carry real risk, say what each could cost us, and recommend how to respond, including redlines within our standard positions. Coordinate redlines and approvals between Sales and leadership, and elevate terms outside our standard positions, so every contract has a clear status and a clear next step. Support internal teams with risk questions on software and IT agreements and client security questionnaires. Own the insurance requirements in contracts: be the first stop for internal questions, coordinate the annual insurance renewal with our broker, and back up the Biz Ops Coordinator on certificate of insurance (COI) requests. Contracts Database and Lifecycle Build and maintain the central Contracts Database. A contract is not done until it is stored with its key dates, terms, and obligations. Keep the data accurate and complete: check entries regularly, fix errors at the source, and document how entries are made so teammates can add to the database correctly. Record renewal, notice, and termination terms when a contract is stored, so Sales, who own renewals, know the terms, the paper the contract is on, and whether anything new needs to be put in place. Own the termination process: when Directors or Sales decide to end an agreement, review the contract if its terms are not already in the database, define how it gets terminated, and hold the team accountable for the steps. Grow what the database captures over time so the team can answer questions about terms and obligations without reopening the contract, and so leadership can see risk in aggregate across all of our contracts. Templates Own our contract templates: decide what goes into them, get our Legal team's feedback, and update the templates once a change is approved. Maintain the template change request process so every request gets a clear answer and the requester can see its status. Keep one current version of each template in one place, and make sure out-of-date copies are not in use. Work with Sales so they understand which terms carry little risk and can be adjusted, and which carry operational or business risk and should not change without review. Identify template gaps and get them closed. Ideal Background Should have Hands-on experience reviewing professional services agreements, such as MSAs, SOWs, and change orders, ideally in a consulting or implementation environment. Working knowledge of common risk terms: indemnification, limitation of liability, SLAs, data and privacy, and insurance requirements. Experience building or maintaining a contract repository or tracker and keeping it accurate over time, not only using one. Experience carrying a template or process change through to adoption across teams that do not report to you. A calculated view of risk: you size it, recommend a response, and let decision-makers weigh it against the value of the deal, rather than treating risk as something to avoid or forwarding every contract to counsel. Experience working with an outside law firm or in-house counsel. Comfort working in lower-tech setups (SharePoint, spreadsheets, Salesforce), not only e-signature platforms, and embracing new tools such as AI. Preferred Experience with public sector contracts and RFPs. Experience with prime agreements and the terms that flow down from them, such as procurement codes and subcontracting commitments. Construction experience is a plus. Experience with client security questionnaires. Experience reviewing software, IT, and vendor agreements. Experience with international contracts. Characteristics of an ideal candidate Responsive; Avicado takes great pride in reacting quickly and positively to our clients and teammates, both internal and external Innovative; a desire to drive innovation through new and unique solutions while embracing creative ideas Entrepreneurial; the drive to take initiative, deliver results, and create value for our clients Empowered; bring solutions instead of problems Performance Driven & Accountable; sets goals and challenges our high-performance culture Even-tempered; handles pressure and thrives in a fast-paced environment Coachable; recognizes strengths & weakness and open to guidance Why Avicado Competitive compensation Health insurance 401k with employer match Flexible PTO Remote work Philanthropic Matching Gift Program And more… About Avicado Avicado , LLP was established in 2015 with a focus on utilizing the latest cloud-based tools and applications to enhance our clients' experience. As a technology consultancy, we empower construction owners to make the most of their systems and data. Our team of experts collaborates with enterprise organizations such as data centers, universities, hospitals, and real estate developers to promote seamless interoperability across their teams and technologies. We are experiencing an exciting phase of expansion and actively searching for new talent to join our team. We’re a close-knit team with a high-performance culture, but we don’t like to take ourselves too seriously. Our diversity and inclusivity are a point of pride, and we have created a highly interactive remote work environment that encourages mutual respect and individuality while fostering opportunities for employees to excel both personally and professionally. We offer competitive benefits, remote work experiences, flexible work arrangements, various career development opportunities, employee resource groups, and more. Avicado 's unwavering dedication to creating a remarkable workplace experience has been widely acknowledged by experts in the industry. We are thrilled to have attained the highly coveted "Great Place to Work" certification and to have been included on Inc.'s esteemed Best Workplaces list for three consecutive years. Additionally, we are humbled to have received the AYA Award, which recognizes allies who promote equality and actively foster positive change for women in technology. At Avicado , we take great pride in fostering a culture that is both inclusive and supportive, especially for women in the technology industry. These accolades are a testament to our ongoing efforts to foster a culture of inclusion, mutual respect, and professional growth for all members of our team. If you are a self-motivated individual who wants to work with Fortune 500 clients in a rapidly growing company, we encourage you to join us! EOE Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Creative Team Lead
description: WHO WE ARE Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using. Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees. Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 22-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay. WHAT TEAM YOU’LL BE PART OF You'll join the Creative team, a team of designers and developers led Philippe, Creative Director,, with members based in Paris, San Francisco, and Seoul. In short, the Creative team is responsible for producing all the ad creatives that power Adikteev 's campaigns. This means designing and developing every format Adikteev uses: statics, videos, MRAIDs (interactive HTML5 banners), playable ads, and native ads. The team works hand-in-hand with Account Management and clients to translate campaign briefs into high-performing creatives, from initial concept and client workshops all the way through to final delivery and performance iteration. The team also plays a strategic role: tracking design trends, building best practices from top-performing creatives, and creating templates that improve the overall production workflow. WHAT YOU WILL DO As Creative Lead for APAC, you’ll help build and scale one of Adikteev ’s highest-potential regions. Concretely, this means: Creative Strategy & Production: Prioritise and drive creative production for our clients’ app, being responsible for the quality of delivery. Brainstorm and generate new ideas for mobile creatives. Design animated, interactive, and playable mobile ads that allow a consistent brand experience, such as videos, storyboards, and motion graphics that support and enhance advertising campaigns. Creative Performance & Client Strategy: Analyse ad performance data and iterate on creatives to improve performance. Participate in client meetings, providing feedback and insights on creatives. Watch the market and be constantly looking to try new things and concepts. Develop and maintain a high standard of creative guidelines, processes, benchmarks, and best practices. Team Leadership: Manage the design team in APAC, guiding them from idea generation through creative production, while helping them improve the performance of their ads (messaging, etc.) and their client presentations. WHO YOU ARE You’ll thrive in this role, and be a great fit for the Creative team at Adikteev , if you bring: Experience & background: 6+ years of experience as a Creative Designer or in a similar role. Previous experience managing a team. Background in ad tech or a mobile gaming studio. Skills: Proficiency with After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop (Adobe Creative Cloud). Knowledge of interaction design. Understanding of the building blocks of game development, including animation, AI, graphics engines, and related systems. Basic knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS is a plus. Strong communication skills. Creative mindset with excellent problem-solving abilities. Strong team spirit. Organized and methodical, with the ability to prioritize effectively while maintaining rigor and responsiveness. Autonomous, accountable, and able to take ownership of your work. Languages: English: full professional proficiency - mandatory ; Chinese (Mandarin): full professional proficiency - mandatory Please note that, for legal reasons, candidates are required to hold Korean or Chinese citizenship and/or maintain residency in China / South Korea in order to be considered for this position. PERKS AND BENEFITS Performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs ; Longevity bonus every 2 years ; 4 1/2 days work week (Friday afternoons off) ; 1.7 paid leave per month from the 1st month ; Festive holiday season support for Chuseok & Seollal ; Flexible remote working policy ; Mental Health support ; Medical check-up support. OUR PROCESS What to expect as you move through our hiring process: Call with Maxime, Talent Acquisition Lead; Team fit interview with Christel, EMEA Creative Team Lead, & Miso, Creative Designer; Use case to complete remotely and present to Philippe, Creative Director, and John, Country Manager; Final interview with Clément, Global COO and Antoine, CCO. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team. OUR COMMITMENT We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future. Adikteev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees, candidates, vendors and clients, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status. title: Sr. Director, eDiscovery Technology & AI
description: KLDiscovery brings clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide. The eDiscovery Technology practice is where those clients meet advanced analytics and AI: technology-assisted review, generative AI classification for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and the non-standard workflows that turn a hard matter into a defensible, efficient one. Clients across the US, UK, Europe, and Asia Pacific are asking how to use AI in discovery and how to defend it, each under their own rules. This practice answers them everywhere KLD operates. The Senior Director, eDiscovery Technology leads that practice globally. You will lead a team of technologists and consultants across time zones, own the methodology and defensibility of every AI-assisted workflow we deliver, partner with Advisory to package and price the consulting offerings they sell, and sit at the table with Product and Engineering as we build AI review into our own platform. This is applied legal technology leadership rather than a software engineering role, and a legal background is preferred. We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $156,000 to $195,000. What you will do Lead the eDiscovery Technology practice Lead a team of eDiscovery technologists and consultants who design and run advanced analytics and AI-assisted workflows on client matters, including technology-assisted review and continuous active learning, generative AI review for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and custom workflow design for non-standard tools and data. Run the practice on a billable model: request intake, scoping, staffing, utilization, quality, and turnaround, against a demand curve that is growing fast. Run it as one global practice, with one intake, one standard, and one set of playbooks across the US, EMEA, and APAC. Build follow-the-sun handoffs so a matter started in London or Hong Kong is picked up cleanly in the US, and partner with regional Operations leaders on staffing, skills, and coverage. Grow the practice. Hire, onboard, and develop a manager, consultants, and technologists as demand expands, and build a career path from technologist to consultant to lead. Build the operating rhythm: intake standards, capacity forecasting, coverage for second-shift, weekend, and deadline-driven work, quality standards, and playbooks so every matter gets the same standard regardless of who staffs it. Own the methodology and its defensibility Own how KLD applies analytics and AI to review: TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, generative AI classifiers for relevance and privilege, prompt design and iteration, validation statistics (recall, precision, elusion), and the documentation that makes the result defensible. Serve as the senior subject matter expert for clients and counsel on AI-assisted review: scoping, protocol support, validation design, and explaining results in plain language to lawyers who have to sign their name to them. Build reusable playbooks, prompt libraries, validation templates, and reporting so quality lives in the practice rather than in any one person. Own AI governance for client matters with Legal and InfoSec: client data boundaries, client-specific AI restrictions, privilege protections, and audit trail, applied consistently across every tool the practice uses. Adapt the methodology to the jurisdiction without lowering the standard: US TAR and GenAI case law and protocols, UK disclosure practice, GDPR and UK data protection, cross-border transfer and data residency limits, and APAC requirements, so the same playbook is defensible in every region where we run it. Co-own the consulting offerings with Advisory Partner with Advisory and Sales to define, package, and price the AI and analytics consulting offerings they sell: what we offer, how it is scoped, what it costs to deliver, and what margin it carries. Supply the technical authority in pursuits Advisory leads across regions: pre-sales calls, RFP responses, pilots, and client education sessions for US, UK, European, and APAC clients and law firms. Move the practice from reactive technical support toward productized consulting with clear deliverables, pricing, and outcomes. Track offering revenue, attach rate, billable utilization, revenue per consultant per week, and margin, and report them into the weekly and monthly business reviews. Partner with Product and Engineering Serve as the practice’s voice into KLD’s own AI review capabilities: requirements, pilot design, operational readiness, adoption, and the feedback loop from client matters back to the roadmap. Evaluate and adopt third-party analytics and AI tools, run structured comparisons, and own the practice’s vendor relationships and licensing. Work with Process Engineering to encode repeatable workflows into automation and AI skills so the team’s time goes to judgment rather than mechanics. Lead clients and cross-functional partners Act as the senior technical voice for Client Success, Sales, and clients in every region on complex matters, escalations, and methodology questions, including cross-border matters that span more than one jurisdiction. Represent the practice externally with a clear point of view on AI in discovery, thought leadership, and industry presence. Lead with KLD’s values: Client is Always in the Room, Better Every Day, Own the Outcome, and Deliver Results Together. What you bring Required: 10+ years in eDiscovery or litigation technology, including 5+ years applying advanced analytics and AI-assisted review on client matters and 3+ years leading a team. Deep hands-on expertise in TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, and generative AI review (Relativity aiR, eDiscovery AI, or equivalent), including prompt design, validation statistics, and defensibility documentation. Working command of Relativity and RelativityOne. A client-facing record: you have scoped, defended, and explained AI-assisted review to counsel and clients, supported protocol negotiations, and handled the hard questions. Multi-jurisdiction experience: you have delivered analytics or AI-assisted review on matters outside the US or for non-US clients, and you understand GDPR, cross-border data transfer constraints, and how disclosure practice in the UK, EU, or APAC differs from US discovery. Commercial fluency: you have packaged or priced consulting work, partnered with sales on pursuits, and can explain utilization and margin to a CFO. Product partnership experience as the operational or practitioner voice on AI feature design, pilots, or adoption. A record of building and developing a technical consulting team, including growing leads into managers and leading people across time zones. A direct, clear communication style. You can explain recall and elusion to a general counsel and to a first-year technologist in the same afternoon. Experience in PE-backed or high-growth environments where pace and accountability are the norm. Preferred: Legal degree (JD or equivalent); bar admission a plus. Structured analytics experience (Brainspace, Reveal, or similar). Declaration or testimony experience on review methodology. Relativity certifications, CEDS, or equivalent. title: Principal ML Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using. Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees. Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay. WHAT TEAM YOU WILL BE PART OF You will be joining the Machine Learning team . They have full ownership of Adikteev 's ML ecosystem; building and maintaining the systems that power the core of our business at massive scale. They operate with a strong product ownership mindset, working at the intersection of research and production, where the models they ship have a direct and measurable impact on billions of real-time decisions every day. WHAT YOU WILL DO Technical Leadership : Set technical direction, Model Development : Design and train on predictive models for CTR, CR, VTA, bid shading, and auction-win probability across display and video inventory, Platform Engineering : Scale our ML platform — feature stores, training pipelines, model versioning, A/B experimentation — to support multiple model families running in production simultaneously, Real-time Systems : Drive sub-10ms inference at high QPS through model optimization (ONNX), efficient serving, and latency-aware architecture decisions, MLOps & Observability : Own end-to-end ML workflows from data ingestion through monitoring: drift detection, shadow scoring, A/B tests, and automated retraining triggers ; drive design reviews, ADRs, and mentoring of senior+ ML engineers. Translate business objectives into technical strategies, Cross-functional Partnership : Work closely with Tech Reporting and Analytics to define ML KPIs, instrument experiments, and communicate model performance to stakeholders up to Comex level, Applied Research : Design and set up a neural network for adtech from the ground up, taking it from prototype to production in our bidding stack. ★ WHO YOU ARE You could be a great addition to our Engineering team if you have: 8+ years of industry ML engineering experience, with 3+ years building and owning production ML systems at scale. Hands-on adtech experience is required — programmatic advertising (RTB/DSP), mobile attribution (MMP ecosystem, SKAdNetwork, Privacy Sandbox), or real-time bidding — alongside deep expertise in recommender systems and/or LTV/churn modeling. Strong command of the modern ML stack: Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, MLflow or Weights & Biases, Spark or Flink for feature engineering. Experience with real-time serving infrastructure: Triton, TorchServe, Ray Serve, or custom low-latency gRPC services. Solid software engineering fundamentals — you write production-grade, reviewable code and care about system reliability. Track record of delivering value incrementally — shipping working software in small, frequent increments rather than large multi-quarter projects. Clear, concise communicator who can translate model performance into business impact for non-technical audiences. Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in France or the European Union in order to be considered for this position. COMPENSATION Competitive Salary between 130,000€ and 150,000€ OTE We are committed to transparent compensation practices. The salary range shown reflects total On-Target Earnings (OTE), including base salary and a performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs. Final compensation will be tailored to each candidate’s background, experience, skills, and overall fit for the role. ★ PERKS AND BENEFITS* Competitive Salary ; Performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs; Longevity bonus every 2 years ; 4 1/2 days work week (Fridays afternoon off) ; “RTT” ; Mental Health support ; Flexible remote working policy ; Regular team-life event / activity ; Inclusive parental leave Policy. *Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of France, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are. ★ OUR PROCESS What to expect as you move through our hiring process: HR interview with Claire, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner Technical test to complete remotely Technical interview with Gwennaëlle, Staff ML Engineer and Pedro, Senior ML Engineer, Manager interview with Cédric, CTO, Comex interview. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team. ★ OUR COMMITMENT We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future. Adikteev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees, candidates, vendors and clients, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status. title: Senior Voice Routing Manager
description: The Challenge We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next. A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow. Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling. What You'll Do Own call quality holistically : hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments. Manage zones, codes, and origins : own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones. Update routing continuously : change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers. Work cross-functionally by design : partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users. Move routing toward automation : work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work. Requirements What You'll Bring Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience. NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD. Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus. Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts Who You Are Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. You are methodical and analytical by nature, and you would rather have a clean, repeatable process than a clever one-off fix. Hands-on: you do the routing work yourself, day to day, not just direct others to do it. A strong communicator: equally at ease explaining a routing issue to Product or Marketing as debating a fix with a supplier's NOC team. Ownership without a script: you see a bottleneck and you fix it rather than wait to be asked. Genuinely commercial: you understand a dropped call or a bad route costs Talk360 real money and a real user's trust, not just an SLA breach. Recruitment Process Recruiter screening Hiring manager screening with COO Technical interview Case study Final interview. with CEO What you get Learning and growth €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. Time to recharge 25 vacation days Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview) Work from anywhere As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. A team you'll actually want to be part of Weekly team lunch every Thursday Regular team moments and outings An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond Set up for success Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance An environment to grow and make impact A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission About Talk360 Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build. Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business. As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360 ’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products. Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe. Here’s what our users say: “I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. title: Director of Reliability Assessments and Performance Analysis
description: Our Company The North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority whose mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid. NERC develops and enforces Reliability Standards; annually assesses seasonal and long‐term reliability; monitors the bulk power system through system awareness; and educates, trains, and certifies industry personnel. NERC’s area of responsibility spans the continental United States, Canada, and the northern portion of Baja California, Mexico. NERC is the Electric Reliability Organization (ERO) for North America, subject to oversight by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) and provincial authorities in Canada. NERC’s jurisdiction includes users, owners, and operators of the bulk power system, which serves nearly 400 million people. Our Mission The vision for the ERO Enterprise, which is comprised of NERC and the six Regional Entities, is a highly reliable and secure North American bulk power system. Our mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid. Your Impact The Director of Reliability Assessments and Performance (RAPA) leads NERC’s independent assessment of reliability, adequacy, and performance of interconnected North American bulk power system. The Director provides strategic and technical leadership across three functional areas: Reliability Assessments, Performance Analysis, and Data & Analytics Integration. The position is responsible for identifying emerging and quantifying reliability risks; developing forward-looking assessments of resource and energy adequacy and their impacts on reliability; evaluating historical system performance and reliability trends; and developing the data, analytical tools, platforms, and governance necessary to support NERC's reliability and security mission. The Director leads multidisciplinary teams of engineers, analysts, data scientists, and technology professionals. The Director also works across the ERO Enterprise to advance consistent, technically rigorous, and increasingly sophisticated approaches to reliability assessment and performance analysis. The position is responsible for major NERC reliability publications and analytical products and serves as a senior technical representative of NERC before the Board of Trustees, FERC, DOE, state and provincial policymakers, industry executives, stakeholder organizations, and the media. This position reports to the Senior Vice President of Strategy and External Engagement. Your Role Provide strategic leadership for NERC's Reliability Assessment, Performance Analysis, and Data & Analytics Integration functions, establishing priorities, analytical direction, and multi-year strategies aligned with NERC and ERO Enterprise long-term strategies. Lead NERC's independent assessment of current and future bulk power system reliability including resource adequacy, energy adequacy, transmission capability, demand and load growth, resource transformation, fuel availability, emerging technologies, and other evolving reliability risks. Direct development of NERC's major reliability assessments and performance publications including seasonal and long-term reliability assessments, the State of Reliability, special assessments, technical reports, and other products requested by NERC executive leadership or the Board of Trustees. Advance the methodologies used to evaluate reliability risk including probabilistic and scenario-based approaches that better characterize energy limitations, extreme conditions, resource performance, uncertainty, and tail-risk events rather than relying solely on traditional deterministic planning measures. Lead analysis of historical bulk power system performance to identify trends, emerging risks, reliability gaps, and opportunities for industry action using NERC reliability data and other authoritative data sources. Establish an integrated analytical framework connecting forward-looking reliability assessments with observed system performance allowing historical performance, operating experience, and emerging trends to inform NERC's assessment of future reliability risk. Provide executive-level interpretation of changing industry conditions including rapid demand growth, resource mix transformation, inverter-based resources, distributed resources, energy storage, large loads, generator and transmission performance, fuel infrastructure dependencies, and other emerging reliability issues. Lead a foundational data team focused on data strategy and analytics, including development and maintenance of analytical platforms, tools, applications, dashboards, data pipelines, and shared analytical capabilities supporting reliability assessments, performance analysis, and broader NERC reliability activities. Guide development of analytical capabilities including statistical analysis, probabilistic modeling, visualization, automation, advanced analytics, and appropriate application of technologies to improve the efficiency, reproducibility, and credibility of NERC's reliability analysis. Establish and oversee data governance practices that promote authoritative data sources, consistent definitions, data quality, appropriate access, documentation, stewardship, and effective use of reliability information across NERC. Oversee major reliability data programs and data collections including development of data requests, coordination with Regional Entities and industry, quality assurance, and evolution of data structures necessary to address emerging reliability risks. Develop and maintain strong partnerships across the ERO Enterprise coordinating analytical approaches, data requirements, assessment methodologies, and reliability findings with Regional Entities while preserving NERC's independent assessment responsibilities. Evaluate the reliability implications of significant industry developments including changing electricity market practices, regulatory and public-policy requirements, environmental regulations, technological changes, resource retirements and additions, infrastructure constraints, and evolving planning practices. Provide technical and policy-relevant reliability insights to NERC executive leadership and the Board of Trustees including recommendations regarding emerging risks, analytical priorities, industry actions, and areas requiring additional assessment. Represent NERC before FERC, DOE, EIA, state and provincial regulators, RTOs/ISOs, utilities, trade organizations, research institutions, and other reliability stakeholders providing technical briefings, testimony, presentations, and subject-matter expertise. Serve as a senior NERC spokesperson on reliability assessments, system performance, and emerging reliability risks, providing technical background and briefings to media and other external audiences. Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing engineering, analytical, data science, and technology professionals while developing future technical and organizational leaders. Establish rigorous quality-control, documentation, and review processes to ensure NERC analytical products are technically defensible, reproducible, transparent, and consistent with NERC's role as the independent Electric Reliability Organization. Collaborate across NERC departments including Reliability Standards, Compliance Monitoring and Enforcement, Security, Legal and Regulatory, Information Technology, and external affairs to ensure analytical findings appropriately inform broader organizational priorities. title: Remote data analyst
description: What is data analyst ? A data analyst is a professional who collects, cleans, and analyzes data to answer questions or solve problems. They work in many industries, including business, finance, science, medicine, and government To excel as a remote data analyst, professionals must possess a combination of technical skills, soft skills, and industry-specific expertise. These essential skills enable analysts to effectively work with data, collaborate with remote teams, and provide valuable insights that drive business growth. Skills; Analytical and problem-solving skills Knowledge of statistics and mathematics Experience with spreadsheets Experience with statistical languages Experience with scripting languages Knowledge of database management systems Data visualization skills Data Analyst Job Description: Key Responsibilities Remote data analysts play a crucial role in driving business growth and decision-making by transforming raw data into actionable insights. Their key responsibilities include: Collecting and interpreting data from various sources: Data analysts are responsible for gathering data from multiple sources, such as databases, APIs, and spreadsheets. They then interpret this data, identifying patterns and trends that can provide valuable insights for the business. Analyzing data to identify trends and patterns: Once the data has been collected and interpreted, data analysts use various statistical methods and tools to analyze it. By identifying trends and patterns, they can provide insights that help businesses make data-driven decisions. Creating reports and visualizations to present findings: Data analysts use data visualization tools like Tableau and Power BI to create clear and engaging reports that effectively communicate their findings to stakeholders. These visualizations help businesses understand complex data and make informed decisions. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support business objectives: Data analysts work closely with various teams within the organization, such as marketing, sales, and product development. By collaborating with these teams, they can provide data-driven insights that help support the company's overall business objectives. Ensuring data accuracy and compliance with relevant regulations: Data analysts must ensure that the data they collect and analyze is accurate and reliable. They must also comply with any relevant regulations, such as data privacy laws, to protect the organization from potential legal issues. Technical Skills Data manipulation and analysis tools: Proficiency in tools like Excel, SQL, Python, and R is crucial for data analysts to efficiently collect, clean, and analyze data from various sources. Data visualization tools: Mastery of visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI helps analysts create impactful visual representations of their findings, making it easier for stakeholders to understand complex data. Knowledge of statistical methods and machine learning algorithms: A deep understanding of statistical methods and machine learning algorithms allows data analysts to identify trends and patterns, providing valuable insights for decision-making. Soft Skills Effective communication and collaboration: Remote data analysts must be able to clearly and concisely communicate their findings and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business objectives. Attention to detail and problem-solving abilities: A keen eye for detail and strong problem-solving skills are essential for identifying data anomalies and ensuring data accuracy. Time management and organization: Remote work requires excellent time management and organizational skills to stay on track and meet deadlines. Adaptability and self-learning capabilities: As technology and industry trends evolve, remote data analysts must be adaptable and committed to continuous learning to stay ahead of the curve. Experience with performance tuning, complex queries, indexing, and database optimization. Experience managing replication, clustering, failover, and backup/recovery operations. Technical Knowledge (Required) Strong expertise with relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL). You will work closely with several teams across the business including Finance, Tech, Operations, Sales, and Marketing and 3rd Party consultants to develop and enhance our regulatory risk framework and provide mentoring and education across the business on risk monitoring and financial compliance and to promote a culture of awareness and diligence with regards Financial Risk and Compliance throughout the organisation. Liaise with our Acquirers, Suppliers and 3rd parties to ensure Financial Compliance is incorporated throughout the whole eco system. Provide Audit Reports to any of our Acquirers as requested. Take on and own new challenges that arise in any area of the Financial compliance programme on a project basis. Take a problem-solving approach, whether designing a new process to be implemented or driving an effort for multiple teams to work together to meet new regulatory requirements. Enhance our controls library and evaluate and document our regulatory risk assessment process. Implement and embed the regulatory compliance Risk Framework, Standards and Procedures. Build trust within our teams: manage and coordinate meaningful risk assessments - helping to educate on the methodology and approach. Proactively communicate solutions to address control gaps or how our processes can be enhanced. Design and work with other teams to implement and maintain management information (MI) that enables the Board and leadership team to make informed decisions and contribute to the Compliance framework. Job Skills: Coming from a background in either: financial regulation, compliance or legal you will be familiar with regulatory expectations of the FCA and Fraud and Risk Management You have worked in a Financial Regulation Advisory, Risk or Governance role. Diligent, methodical, and always looking for the best ways of working to increase efficiency. You translate the benefits of financial compliance into intuitive propositions that demonstrate customer value. You can break complex problems into smaller logical ones and prioritise them with data. You build strong rapport with people and quickly make them feel at ease. You are curious in nature and interested in making an impact. You can demonstrate the influence you have had on projects you have been involved in. You can make a good business case and convince people to help you execute. Ability to thrive in fast moving, changing, highly dynamic and unstructured environments. You have an analytical approach with the ability to identify insights to reduce risk. You hustle, take ownership, and get things done. What can we offer? Flexible working – you choose the hours you work, providing the required hours per week are met and the tasks achieved then how you do it is at your discretion. Remote working – we have a central office in Harlow but many of our colleagues continue to work from home and are geographically dispersed, but there may be a need to travel as the needs of the business dictate. Total ownership of the role, this is a new position with limitless possibility on how it is structured. An excellent opportunity to join an exciting and innovative company, past the growing pains of a start-up and now enjoying the challenges of a scale up. The chance to do some good, every single organisation we work with is fundraising for amazing, worthwhile causes, we must take a step back sometimes to recognise that every day, we are helping people who are helping others. Hard work and challenge but always fun – we are a close “family” who support each other personally and professionally and genuinely love what we do and those we work with. title: SCRUM MASTER
description: Overview Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai. Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees. Responsibilities Description Empower AI is seeking a Scrum Master to enable Agile delivery for DCSA Customer Support Services. The Scrum Master guides cross-functional teams delivering customer support, IT service management, automation, analytics, and application capabilities against a government-prioritized backlog. The role serves as a servant leader and Agile coach, facilitating transparent planning and delivery, removing impediments, protecting team focus, and helping Government stakeholders, product owners, and delivery teams maintain a shared understanding of priorities, dependencies, risks, and outcomes. Work is performed in a compliance-driven environment requiring documented testing, stakeholder demonstrations, formal acceptance, and controlled releases. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers. THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE BASED WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED. JOB DUTIES Facilitate Agile ceremonies for assigned delivery teams, including sprint planning, daily scrums, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release-planning activities. Partner with Government product owners and technical leads maintaining a prioritized, well-defined backlog of epics, features, user stories, defects, and technical-debt items aligned to mission outcomes. Coach teams and stakeholders on Scrum values, Agile practices, estimation, acceptance criteria, Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, and continuous improvement methods. Identify, track, and remove impediments; coordinate resolution of cross-team dependencies, environmental constraints, approvals, and resource conflicts that affect sprint commitments. Maintain transparent delivery metrics and dashboards, including sprint velocity, burndown or burnup, backlog health, work in progress, release readiness, and impediment status; communicate meaningful trends and risks to program leadership and Government stakeholders. Coordinate demonstrations of completed work, support User Acceptance Testing, and ensure stories are closed only after documented stakeholder acceptance and required evidence are complete. Facilitate retrospectives and maintain actionable improvement plans; track commitments through completion and promote measurable improvements in team predictability, quality, and customer outcomes. Support planning and coordination across application development, ITSM platform development, automation, analytics, UX, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and service management teams. Ensure Agile delivery aligns with Government change, configuration, release, security, and quality-management processes, including required test evidence, release notes, rollback plans, and approvals. Assist with dependency mapping, risk management, capacity planning, and roadmap development for iterative delivery and larger releases. Promote disciplined use of approved work-management and collaboration tools; maintain accurate sprint artifacts, decision records, action items, and status reporting. Support the transition of work from development through deployment and operational support, including knowledge transfer and post-implementation review activities. Qualifications REQUIREMENTS Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 5 years of related experience; an additional 4 years of related experience may be substituted for the degree. Must be a U.S. Citizen. Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start. Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting. Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision. Minimum of 3 years of experience serving as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or Agile Coach for software development or IT-service delivery teams. Demonstrated experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies, managing impediments and dependencies, and coaching cross-functional teams and stakeholders in Agile practices. Experience translating business needs into well-formed user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlog items with product owners and technical teams. Experience with Agile work-management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow Agile Development, or comparable platforms. Experience with Agile metrics, delivery reporting, risk management, sprint forecasting, and stakeholder communications. title: Open call: freelancers and collaborators
description: This is a remote position. Sustainability is changing fast, and the work required to make it real inside large organisations has become more demanding, more specific, and more deeply embedded in business operations. As a result, Nordic Sustainability is building a pool of freelance experts and specialist collaborators we can draw on when client projects require a particular depth of knowledge we want to bring in. This is not a call for generalists. It's a call for people who know their area well, whether that's a technical sustainability discipline, a business function, or a sector, and who understand how large organisations actually work from the inside. This call is open until 31 August 2026 and applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We're looking for individuals operating as freelancers (or willing to set up a freelance structure) and specialist companies of 2 to 5 people interested in a closer collaboration. What we're looking for Sustainability specialists We're particularly interested in deep technical knowledge across: Climate transition planning and corporate climate strategy Climate risk assessment (physical and transition risk) Biodiversity and nature-related impacts and dependencies Chemicals management and product-related environmental compliance Circularity, waste, and materials strategy Supply chain due diligence and human rights (aligned with CSDDD, OECD Guidelines, and UNGPs) Carbon accounting, Scope 3 methodology, and GHG inventory design Corporate function specialists We're equally interested in people who have worked inside large companies in functions where sustainability now sits — even if sustainability has not been their primary focus. Understanding how commercial decisions are made, how procurement works, or how products are developed is exactly the kind of knowledge that makes sustainability advice land. Relevant backgrounds include: Commercial strategy, finance, or business development •Product design, innovation, and R&D Procurement, sourcing, and supply chain management •Risk management and legal •Operations and manufacturing An understanding of sustainability is a bonus. A thorough understanding of how the business function actually operates is the baseline requirement. Sectoral expertise Sector knowledge helps us deploy the right person at the right moment. The following sectors are particularly relevant to our current and anticipated client base: Manufacturing and industrial production Pharmaceuticals, chemicals, and life sciences •Energy and utilities •Financial services and investment •Retail and consumer goods What collaboration with Nordic Sustainability looks like We work with large multinationals on complex, high-stakes sustainability challenges. Projects typically sit at the intersection of regulatory requirements, commercial strategy, and operational change. Freelance collaborators are brought in to add specific expertise — you'll work alongside our core team, not independently. This is project-based engagement. There is no guarantee of ongoing volume, but our intent is to build relationships that work over time for the right people. Important: this call is for freelance or independent collaboration only — it is not a route into permanent employment at Nordic Sustainability . Applicants must either already operate as a freelancer or be willing to set up a freelance structure. For small companies Companies of between 2 and 5 people with a strong specialism that would complement Nordic Sustainability 's work are also welcome to register interest in closer collaboration. This is a different conversation, not the freelancer pool described above, and should be directed to: How to apply To be considered for the freelance pool, please submit the following: 1.Your CV (maximum 2 pages) 2.A short letter of motivation (maximum half a page) — tell us briefly what you do, why it's relevant to the work Nordic Sustainability does, and how you prefer to work 3.Completed questionnaire (following on the next pages) ​ We will review all applications on a rolling basis and reach out to those whose profiles are a strong match for our pipeline.
