You will partner closely with the orbital hardware system architecture team, drive customer use cases with constellation operators, align architecture with mission requirements, and bring the best orbital AI products to market. Join us at the forefront of technological advancement. What you'll be doing: Own system architecture for inference stack and other applications running on this class of products and make it resilient to any fault happening in space. Co-architect with the orbital hardware system architecture team to define interfaces, partitioning, and trade-offs across silicon, board, firmware, OS, and AI workload layers for 5-year LEO missions. Own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor Orbital Data Center modules — covering data center stack, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, GPU/CPU drivers, CUDA, DCGM, and manageability telemetry as a single integrated stack. Define the manageability architecture for an unreachable, autonomous data center: remote bring-up, in-orbit firmware update, dual-module redundancy, fault containment, recovery from SEU/SEFI events, and telemetry for fleets ranging from tens to millions of nodes. Architect rad-tolerant system software behaviors — ECC handling, memory scrubbing, latch-up mitigation, deterministic recovery, and graceful degradation through 5 years and up to ~8,000 thermal cycles in dawn–dusk sun-synchronous orbit. Drive Redfish, MCTP, PLDM, and constellation-level management protocols across BMC, BIOS, and host software so customers can operate orbital fleets with the same tools they use on the ground. Define minimum BMC feature set, pin budget, boot architecture (rugged M.2 / VPX-class options), and dual-module redundancy strategy in partnership with platform and mechanical engineering. Partner with cloud and constellation customers (SpaceX, Blue Origin, Starcloud, Planet, Cowboy Space, and others) to translate mission requirements — orbit, duty cycle, NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking (CX9), inference SLAs — into actionable platform software architecture. Drive reliability and optimization in the system software architecture from an orbital data center viewpoint, including correct operation through eclipse periods and idle-power retention strategies. Work closely with the bring-up team and resolve issues at Speed of Light from first silicon through first launch.Own quality, reliability, and telemetry performance of the system software delivered with each ODC module shipped to customers. What we need to see: 15+ years of relevant experience in server/platform system software — spanning compute libraries, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, drivers, and manageability BS, MS, or PhD in EE/CS or related field of education (or equivalent experience). Working experience in building AI infrastructure and systems in space. Proven record of architecting and delivering platform software for large-scale data centers or mission-critical embedded systems. Strong knowledge of server architecture, data center manageability, and full-stack integration of firmware with OS and accelerator software. Hands-on experience with data center health management workflows, telemetry, and fault management at scale. Solid understanding of hardware management interfaces (USB, SMBus/I2C, PCIe) and proficiency with modern management protocols including Redfish, MCTP, and PLDM. Strong and demonstrable skill in C/C++ and Python. Experience programming and debugging server platforms, including pre-silicon and platform bring-up environments. Experience in SCM (e.g. Git, Perforce) and project management tools like Jira. Excellent written and oral communication skills, good work ethics, high sense of team-work, love to produce quality work, and commitment to finish your tasks every single day. You are a self-starter who loves to find creative solutions to complicated problems and hands on with coding. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience architecting platform software for space, aerospace, defense, or other radiation, thermal, and vibration-constrained environments — including SEU/SEFI mitigation, ECC strategy, TID/SEE qualification, and rad-hard design partitioning. Being a part of a start up or initiative directly related to space data centers. Hands-on experience with autonomous, remote, or unreachable data center operations — in-orbit or in-field firmware update, dual-module redundancy, and recovery without physical access. Hands-on with x86 or ARM (Grace/Vera) system architecture and the NVIDIA AI software stack (CUDA, DCGM, DOCA/OFED, GPU drivers, DGX OS). Familiarity with NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking, and aerospace standards (VPX, MIL-STD shock/vibe, NASA EEE-INST-002). Proven technical leadership driving large complex programs with 50+ engineers across firmware, OS, driver, and AI stack teams. Skilled in reviewing hardware schematics and PCB layouts for debugging, design verification, and collaboration with hardware engineers. NVIDIA 's invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern deep learning — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” We're looking to grow our company and establish teams with the most thoughtful people in the world. NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. title: Senior Auditor Contract Compliance (Retail-Construction)
description: Overview The Senior Auditor Contract Compliance (Construction) performs contract compliance and cost control audits on construction and capital projects, with a focus on distribution center, data center, corporate office, and retail construction, remodel, and build-out programs. This role applies working knowledge of construction audit practices, including AIA billing formats, job-cost reconciliation, GMP and CMAR contract structures, subcontract reviews, insurance cost validation, and lease and developer cost audits. The Senior Auditor executes audit testing independently, quality-checks and mentors other auditors on assigned engagements, and communicates findings clearly to clients and suppliers. This is a US-based remote role with periodic travel to construction project sites as needed (up to 20%). Responsibilities Contract Compliance and Cost Control Perform detailed contract compliance audits to assess alignment with AIA billing standards, GMP/CMAR contract terms, unit-price schedules, cost-plus arrangements, and negotiated allowances. Validate that billed costs —general conditions, general requirements, subcontractor, developer, and landlord — comply with contract requirements and industry norms. Identify cost recoveries, billing errors, non-allowable charges, and process improvement opportunities Construction Technical Proficiency Apply working knowledge of AIA billing formats (G702, G703, continuation sheets) to identify anomalies or unsupported values. Support insurance auditing on construction projects, including reviewing policy documents (GL, Builders Risk, OCIP/CCIP, Workers' Compensation) and validating contractually allowable insurance costs. Perform subcontract audits, including T&M validations, change order support, negotiated buyouts, and back-charge review. Conduct job cost reconciliations, matching committed costs, actuals, payments, and cost-to-complete details. Support developer and landlord cost verification, including audits of land acquisition, soft costs, carrying costs (interest, equity), lease costs, tenant improvement allowances, and pass-through expenditures. Conduct monthly pay application reviews, including verification of percent complete, stored materials, retainage, and subcontractor flow-down compliance. Support construction procurement and bid analysis, including bid leveling, identifying scope gaps, and alternate pricing. Claim settlement support experience — including work related to disputed amounts between owners, contractors, subcontractors, or developers — is a plus. Legal preparation support experience is a plus, including working with counsel on arbitration, litigation, or expert-witness documentation. Procurement and Supply Chain Audit material purchases and subcontractor billings for compliance with procurement requirements and pricing terms. Assess buyout savings, material escalations, equipment rentals, and service procurements; flag opportunities to strengthen procurement controls and reduce cost leakage. Communication and Reporting Communicate audit results clearly and concisely, in both written and verbal form, to internal, client, and supplier personnel. Help draft and issue audit reports summarizing completed audit activities, findings, and recoveries. Present and support audit claims in a manner that is clear, concise, and persuasive. Manage conflict and maintain professionalism with clients, contractors, and suppliers at all times, including when other parties are not. Project Management, QC, and Team Support Work independently, balancing priorities across multiple audit engagements and ensuring each project moves toward timely completion. Maintain production goals and strong project management skills, advancing a group of audits forward each day. Delegate, train, and quality-check audit work performed by other auditors; participate in and lead team knowledge sharing on contract interpretation, audit techniques, and cost-control practices. Exhibit personal initiative in learning new analytic tools and construction audit techniques; accept and provide constructive feedback in a collaborative team environment. Quality Assurance Implement self-check and peer review practices to eliminate calculation errors and maintain high-quality, consistent work product. Ensure detailed documentation and proper use of Cotiviti tools and construction audit software. Governance and Compliance Ensure compliance with Cotiviti policies, confidentiality requirements, data security standards, and relevant industry standards, including those promoted by the National Association of Construction Auditors (NACA). Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Construction Management and/or Business Administration or related field required Certified Construction Auditor (CCA) preferred. CFE, PE, CCM, or PMP are pluses 5+ years of hands-on experience in construction auditing, construction project management or project engineering Experience auditing AIA-format billings, GMP and CMAR contracts, job-cost structures, tenant improvement projects, data centers, distribution centers, or large capital portfolios preferred. Experience reviewing insurance costs, subcontracts, cost-plus agreements, change orders, or developer/landlord cost submissions preferred. Experience conducting completed project audits and monthly pay application reviews Exposure to bidding processes and bid leveling, and how bids translate into contract risk and audit focus areas, is a plus. Experience supporting claim negotiation or legal counsel in disputes or arbitration preparation is a plus. Strong project management skills required May require travel up to 20% Mental Requirements: Communicating with others to exchange information. Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned. Physical Requirements and Working Conditions: Ability to sit or stand for extended periods and repeat hand motions in computer-based work. No adverse environmental conditions expected in the primary work location. Ability to visit active job sites safely, including adherence to site-specific safety and PPE requirements. Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area. Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance. Base compensation ranges from $85,000 to $100,000. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration. title: Network Engineer
description: Job Title: Network Engineer Reports to: Manager of Cloud Operations Job Summary The Infrastructure Services team provides systems engineering and operational support for network-based server and software. The Network Engineer designs, manages, and administers networks and systems, including servers (physical and virtual). Responsibilities include assessment, design, implementation, configuration, documentation, coordination, control, maintenance, troubleshooting, security, usage monitoring, and the development of specialized procedures for systems. This role is also responsible for capacity planning, tuning, system monitoring, system performance, and problem resolution across all aspects of the infrastructure. Duties and Responsibilities Install, configure, maintain, and manage network devices (including firewalls, switches, wireless), servers, and their associated operating systems. Evaluate and recommend procurement of network devices, servers, peripheral equipment, and systems monitoring/alerting software. Investigate problems, identify their source, determine possible solutions, test, and implement solutions. Guide complex issues from identification to resolution across different departments, clients, employees, and systems. Troubleshoot networks, systems, and applications to identify and correct malfunctions and other operational difficulties. Investigate, recommend, and install enhancements and operating procedures that optimize network/system availability. Document system problems and resolutions for future reference. Participate in and contribute to the planning and execution of business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities. Contribute meaningfully to organizational processes, teams, and products. Adhere to organizational processes and procedures. Work independently while also collaborating effectively as a team member. Exhibit initiative and drive to complete tasks promptly, while adapting to change management processes with proper planning. Communicate effectively with clients, internal teams, and leadership. Demonstrate leadership qualities and take ownership of assigned responsibilities. Complete special projects or other duties as assigned. Availability for occasional off-hour, evening, weekend, and overtime work is required. Participation in a cyclic on-call rotation and carrying an on-call phone is required. Occasional travel to remote data centers within the United States is required. Assist in the migration of on-premises systems to AWS. Design and implement AWS architecture solutions that meet business requirements, including potential use of Infrastructure as Code. Set up and manage monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using AWS CloudWatch, AWS Config, and third-party tools. Ensure cloud infrastructure complies with security standards and best practices. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to AWS infrastructure and applications. Experience with the use of VMware ESXi, vCenter, and vSphere. Palo Alto Firewall administration. Experience with Cisco devices, including Nexus core switches and perimeter defense mechanisms. Cisco certification is a plus. Knowledge of TCP/IP-based LANs, VLANs, iSCSI and Fiber Channel SANs, and VPNs. Familiarity with current Red Hat/CentOS Linux operating systems is a plus. Experience in systems monitoring and management in a high-availability data center environment. Understanding of federal IT standards, guidelines, and programs such as NIST, DISA, and DIACAP/RMF. Experience optimizing cloud resources for performance and cost efficiency. Experience implementing AWS IAM policies and securing AWS environments is a plus. Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and Ansible is a plus. Experience with vulnerability management programs and patch management. Ability to think and act independently to resolve complex systems issues. Ability to provide technical and professional leadership, guidance, and training to others. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with designing, implementing, maintaining, scaling, and capacity management. Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related field or equivalent work experience. Two or more industry-standard job-related certifications are preferred. Ability to stand and sit for extended periods of time. Ability to lift up to 10 lbs. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects. Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software. AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve. We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company. Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them. You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently. Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important. This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend. Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations. Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review. Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria. Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations. Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures. Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting. Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks. Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies. Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners. Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification. Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes. Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies. Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback. Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead. Required Qualifications Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications. Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling. Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs. Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified. Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery. Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies. Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents. Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills. Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery. Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly. Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams. The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget. Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility. Especially Valuable Experience Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup. Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time. Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation. Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments. Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation. Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring. Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team. Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years. For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment. What We Offer A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives. The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team. Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery. Close collaboration with startup leadership. The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops. Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process. Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup. How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning. Please submit your CV and a short overview covering: A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions. An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results. Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities. A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes. Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables. Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer inform

Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants. Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health "I love seeing health plan members at home. Job highlights The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants. Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health “Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD “The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. title: Data QA Engineer - Remote
description: At Zyte , we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte . Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data. Role Overview Data QA is how we make sure the data we deliver is right before the customer sees it. As a Data QA Engineer, you will check the data our spiders and AI-assisted projects produce against what the customer asked for, find what is wrong and tell the team exactly what you found. Quality assurance is more useful as a question asked at the start than a gate at the end. Is this requirement testable and how would we know if it were wrong? Part of this role is asking that question early, so problems are fixed before they reach the customer. Key Responsibilities Turn customer scraping and data requirements into a clear test approach and own QA from the start on new projects. Combine exploratory manual and visual testing with automated tests where automation pays for itself. Run test cycles on extracted data and report the results clearly. Write up defects with enough detail that a developer can reproduce and fix them without a conversation. Use descriptive statistics, summaries and charts to show how good the data is: completeness, accuracy, consistency and drift. Produce test reports and quality scores that give the team, and the customer where needed, a true picture. Say what was tested, what was not, and what risk that leaves. Work with project managers and clients to clear up unclear or untestable requirements before QA begins. Feed into our test automation framework, with a focus on coverage and performance. Suggest and take ownership of improvements to QA process and tooling, including browser add-ons, spreadsheet add-ons and UI-based test automation tools. Work with QA leadership, project managers and developers, with minimal supervision. Requirements 5+ years in a QA Engineer or similar role - testing software or data. Python preferred language - Pandas and Jupyter for data analysis and validation. SQL: basic to intermediate queries, and comfort with at least one relational database and its tools. A solid grasp of web technologies and protocols: HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP and CSS. Experience writing tests against HTTP/REST APIs. Proactive and detail-oriented QA professional with a strong sense of ownership over project quality. Fast learner adept at rapidly understanding complex project domain requirements and adapting to new technologies. Leveraging AI and LLM tools to optimize test case generation and accelerate data validation processes. Good test case design and test data management. Experience working in an agile team (Scrum or Kanban) alongside developers. An understanding of data quality concepts such as completeness, accuracy, consistency and drift. Strong attention to detail, and the confidence to hold the quality line under delivery pressure. Clear written and spoken communication in English. Nice to Have Working knowledge of Scrapy and other Python-based scraping frameworks. Experience with test automation frameworks. Interest in data science concepts as they apply to data analysis and validation. Interest in using AI and LLM tools to speed up data validation. Benefits As a new Zytan, you will: Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team. Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work. Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools. 35 days paid holidays Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Green Bay Job Location: Work at Home, Wisconsin, United States Job Location Type: Remote Job Contract Type: Part time Job Seniority Level: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care. You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors. Job highlights The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen. In this role, you will: Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed Conduct virtual visits as needed Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.) A Note on Our Work Environment: As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants. Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health “Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD “The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD Per diem employees qualify for: Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply) Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities) Supplies and other perks Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs) Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s) Multi-state licenses (preferred) Anticipated Weekly Hours 12 Time Type Part time Pay Range The typical pay range for this role is: $83.69 - $180.25 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. title: Staff Engineer, Imunify360 (remote work)
description: CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful. Check out our website for more information: We are currently hiring Staff Engineers for various projects within the Imunify360 product. Imunify360 is CloudLinux 's multi-layer security suite for Linux web servers: antivirus and malware cleanup, WAF, IDS/IPS, Proactive Defense, patch management (KernelCare/Patchman), and IP/domain reputation. It runs on hundreds of thousands of shared, VPS and dedicated hosting servers, under cPanel, Plesk, DirectAdmin and standalone. The engineering org is 60+ engineers in squads covering backend, core, server agent, malware research, WAF/WebShield, and Patchman. Core services are Python; agents and performance-critical paths are Go and Rust. We run on Hetzner and our own bare metal. Check out our website for more information: Role Mission & Scope Most complex technical challenges in Imunify360 go beyond individual squads. A single detection change can impact the scanner, agent, UI, reputation backend, and release process. While squad leads own delivery within their teams, the Staff Engineer ensures technical alignment across the product. As a Staff Engineer, you'll be a hands-on technical leader working across the entire product , focusing on the most critical and high-impact challenges as priorities evolve. You'll drive technical decisions, improve architecture, establish engineering standards, and help teams build sustainable solutions. This is an individual contributor role , without direct people management responsibilities. You'll remain actively involved in development, spending approximately 30–50% of your time writing production code , rather than focusing solely on architectural design. While deep expertise in a particular area is valued, this role requires the flexibility to work across different components, collaborate with multiple squads, and tackle challenges wherever your expertise can make the greatest impact. What you will own Architecture and technical direction Own the end-to-end architecture of Imunify360 as a product: agent ↔ server ↔ cloud backends, data flows, and the contracts between them. Write and drive ADRs and RFCs for cross-squad changes. Run the Wed/Fri architecture sync together with the Technical Director. Keep a living tech-debt and risk register (security / compliance / uptime) with owners and dates, and get the top items funded on the roadmap. Hard cross-cutting problems (examples of what lands on your desk) Agent resource footprint on dense shared hosts: CPU, memory and I/O budgets for scanning, file monitoring (inotify/fanotify) and WAF, measured on real kernels, not benchmarks from elsewhere. Detection pipeline quality: false positive / false negative rates, signature and ML model rollout with staged gates and rollback. Upgrade and release safety across a large, heterogeneous fleet (CentOS/AlmaLinux/ CloudLinux /Ubuntu, multiple control panels, old kernels). Backend scale and cost of reputation, ThreatIntel and telemetry services. Migrating hot paths from Python to Go/Rust where the data shows it pays off, and saying no where it doesn't. Engineering standards Set the bar for design reviews, code review, testing strategy, observability (Prometheus/Grafana/Sentry) and secure SDLC (OWASP ASVS, CIS Benchmarks as relevant). Lead or co-lead SEV1/SEV2 incidents when the cause is unclear or cross-squad; make sure the blameless post-mortem ships within 24 h and its actions get closed. Drive the AI-augmented SDLC in practice: show what good agentic coding looks like (prompt specificity, context provision, review quality, tool boundaries) on real changes, not slides. People multiplier (no direct reports) Mentor senior engineers and squad leads toward staff-level scope. Act as the technical bar-raiser in hiring loops for senior and lead roles. Be the engineering voice in product and sales discussions: estimates, feasibility, and no dated customer commitment without a written squad-lead estimate. Key Milestones 30 days: Shipped at least one non-trivial change to production. Can explain the full request path from agent to backend. Has a personal list of top 10 technical risks. 90 days: Owns one cross-squad initiative with an approved ADR, a measured baseline, and a staged rollout plan. Published risk register reviewed in arch sync. 6 months: That initiative is in production with before/after metrics. At least one engineering standard (e.g. release gating, agent perf budget, design review template) is adopted by 3+ squads. 12 months: Recognized by squad leads as the default escalation point for cross-cutting technical decisions. title: Senior Director, Business Design
description: We are looking for a Senior Director, Business Design to join our team. At Runyon, Business Designers drive the analysis of the viability of products and ventures, and articulate how optimal business models shape the experience, and vice versa. They consider a series of monetization opportunities, operational considerations as well as the growth implications to scale into market while maintaining a firm understanding of the underlying market dynamics of incumbent position, emergent players and value exchange across key stakeholders in the ecosystem. This role requires someone who is highly strategic, detail-oriented, and experienced in financial modeling, performing competitive analyses, creating growth strategies and testing value hypotheses and growth hypotheses from low to increasing live fidelity. They have the ability to develop a deep understanding of a partner’s business and translate those into a plan of action. They develop strong relationships and build trust with core decision-makers, both internally and externally. About Runyon Runyon is a product design and venture studio that helps companies grow. We are a team of customer-centered designers, researchers, and strategists that crafts new products, experiences and ventures. Our approach combines customer needs and behaviors with leading edge business strategy. Our work is sprint- and prototype-driven and we think about how we can craft strategies and products into the market in ways that are meaningful and measured from the start. Our team has decades of experience working with some of the largest global partners including Disney, The New York Times, American Express, Target and others. We're prototyping-led. We lead with tangible assumptions in the form of prototypes and test them with real stakeholders to validate and refine our strategy and design. Regardless of discipline, we think and communicate in concepts, and use those to move further, faster. We're detailed and intentional. We always back up our design decisions with sound reasoning—be it user research, market research, or both. We make things that make sense and that have a clear through line. We're fast. We work almost exclusively in sprints, and with lean teams. We need folks who like to run. We're collaborative. We jam as a multidisciplinary team of specialists who collectively contribute to the full spectrum of work across user research, strategy and design to arrive at high quality outcomes. RESPONSIBILITIES Actively participate in ideation sessions with cross-functional teams to conceptualize new experiences, products, services, and ventures that create differentiated market opportunities Collaborate with internal teams and senior client partners to define strategic success criteria, business objectives, and opportunities for growth Design profitable new products, brands, services, business models, and ventures, translating strategic opportunities into tangible, market-ready solutions Shape growth and go-to-market strategies for new products and ventures, aligning business, financial, and operational objectives Craft design-driven market and competitive analyses that uncover opportunities, inform strategic direction, and position our partners for differentiation Develop financial models that establish what needs to be true for revenue growth, product and venture success, and long-term business sustainability Shape operational plans, resource strategies, and strategic partnerships that support product development, venture incubation, and business growth Develop and lead experiments that generate actionable insights, validate opportunities, and inform strategic product and venture roadmaps Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, and identify opportunities to integrate them into meaningful product, service, and venture solutions Establish deep partnerships with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders, ensuring alignment and collaborative progress toward key strategic and product milestones QUALIFICATIONS 7+ years of experience as a business designer, business strategist, or business analyst at a design studio, consultancy, or internally within an organization Fluent in business acumen, including knowledge in strategy, marketing, finance, operations and product development Ability to build and interpret financial models to quantify business impact Ability to interpret and communicate complex business ideas to different audiences, in addition to listening and modifying your thinking based on the contributions and perspectives of others Ability to easily adapt, and switch between different projects, businesses and industries A desire to engage with collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams which include our partners A proven track record of successfully launched products as a business designer, product manager, product growth strategist, and/or as a startup founder Great communication and time management abilities, including the skill to direct and manage small teams and judiciously involve investors, experts, and stakeholders You thrive in ambiguity, and have a propensity to experiment with generative ideas in order to identify the most innovative and disruptive solutions Please note that this job posting remains active as part of our ongoing effort to build a network of talented designers, strategists, researchers, and other creative professionals. As a result, it may not correspond to an immediate opening. Runyon’s dynamic, fast-paced environment makes this ideal for candidates who thrive in flexible, project-based roles. Salary: $750 - $1,300 / day based on experience and skill level Originally posted on Himalayas

We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD “The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. title: Sales Closer
description: This is a remote position. Executive Sales Summary I am looking for a few highly skilled and sophisticated sales leaders to manage “Make A Deal Meetings” where we propose partnership terms, negotiate terms and close deals with high-producing and established real estate businesses and small service-based businesses, over Zoom Meetings. Our successful candidates will represent Fusion in these negotiations with individuals who have already been through an “Explanation of Investment” who have self-identified as someone who would like to have our investment IF we can arrange the financial terms in such as way that it will fit into their business. The goal is to help the person make a decision in that meeting at terms that are agreeable to our firm and execute the agreement. The meetings last between 1 and 3 hours and we will arrange 2 to 4 meetings per day. Our current closing ratio is just under 50% when the prospect shows for the meeting. The income range is $180,000 to $300,0000 annually. If you have an interest, PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE AD BEFORE APPLYING. WE PROVIDE EXTENSIVE INFORMATION ABOUT THE COMPANY AND THE POSITION. Job Description Our Sales Leader is a closer and a negotiate. We generate business from cold calls and set up meetings for our Partnership Development Executives to walk them through a VERY DETAIL explanation of our business model and how we invest into these small business operations. At the end of the Investment presentation our Executives pose two primary questions, 1. Does the Prospect “love” the business model concept? And 2. Does the Prospect believe that over time that if we provide all the services we covered consistently over months, would their business significantly improve? Only if a prospects answers affirmatively to both questions will the meeting continue. IF the answers are yes, we then explain our “Make A Deal” meeting process. The “Make A Deal Meeting” is basically a meeting where both parties come together in one meeting to try and figure out agreeable terms to both parties and close the deal and execute the meeting ideally in one meeting. We start by proposing reasonable terms and a financial model for our investment of resources and then we are willing to improve pricing IF they are ready to move forward. To help lubricate the sales process, we offer a two-week rescission period and a guarantee of income growth of hundreds of thousands of dollars if they follow our program. About the Company Fusion Growth Partners is a business incubator and micro venture capital company. We invest resources in businesses that are experiencing success at certain levels but have a high desire to grow a lot more. We invest in a unique way where most investors would never consider these types of businesses. When we partner with small service-based businesses of individual real estate agents, we invest heavily into their businesses to them significantly grow their clientele and scale business profits. We consider ourselves as a “Partnership as a Service” business similar to, but different than, a SaaS business. Fusion was recently ranked as the 813th fastest-growing business by Inc. 5000. Therefore, we consider this role to be one of the best opportunities for sales professional business advisors available today. Our partners benefit from Fusion providing their business with sophisticated growth planning, a full suite of back-office services and SaaS resources, plus the support of our experienced staff. Fusion is the only company in the country that currently offers these services and is compensated in a way that conveniently accommodates the cash flow challenges of a real estate agent. We have over 300 team members and are growing very quickly. We need more talent to enter untouched markets. Fusion invests in companies through strategic revenue-sharing growth partnerships. Our investment resources include, but are not limited to, thousands of dollars of business building systems and processes and the staff to operate those business systems which are all provided as an investment into our partners' businesses. Fusion’s income is primarily generated from a small share of the revenue generated by our partner’s businesses. Our company is looking to hire additional Partnership Development Executives to support our rapidly growing volume of new partnership investments. Requirements Desired Candidate Attributes We are looking for individuals who are of the highest negotiation and closing skill level possible. We have a great position for those who love to close sales enjoy the satisfaction of accomplishing the desired goal. However, we are selling a relationship, not a product and therefore our candidate(s) must not embellish in anyway, or mislead in anyway, create expectations that will not be realized, because this will create service and investment scenarios that will hurt our company’s reputation and brand. Our sales process has already been engineered and the closing ration is high, BUT it takes finesse and requires awareness of the nuances of prospects emotional decision-making processes. We want professionals who have the highest level of closing skill for true sales professionals, but we do not want “know it all’s” who are not coachable or not willing to learn our playbook. Our individuals must be willing to be team players. We want individuals who have business savvy and acumen, extensive experience in closing sales with a short sales cycle. We are looking for individuals who we can rely on. They do what they say they will do every time. We want hungry people. We want salespeople who have finesse, confidence and yet carry themselves with an air of humbleness. For the benefit of those who are reading this ad, you can view an example of the presentation we provide for Real Estate Agents at: (PASSWORD- FusionRocks123! ) and you can view the rest of our website at: Please provide a resume if you are interested in learning more about this opportunity.
